title: Full Stack Developer — Next.js and Supabase
description:
About Us

We run an AI-powered sales operation for 30+ online coaches with 20 full-time employees. We have built a custom internal CRM in Next.js and Supabase that tracks setter conversations, real-time lead activity, pre-call notes, lead scoring, call metrics, and a full sales tracker — all in one place. Clients use it daily. The app is live, scaling fast, and we need someone to own it with us long-term.



Compensation

$10–$15/hr depending on skill and experience.

30–40 hours per week. Long-term ongoing role — not a one-off project.

Hours are verified via screen recording software. We value trust and transparency, and we set that expectation from day one.



Schedule and Availability

Outcome-based, not clock-in. You manage your own schedule with enough overlap to sync with the founder on priorities and reviews.



What You Will Own

Security: audit and tighten RLS policies, route protection, auth flows, and any exposed endpoints or service-role keys

Self-serve access: implement Supabase Auth so clients can log in directly — no more manual account management

Performance: identify and fix slow queries, unnecessary re-renders, and structural debt

UI/UX: clean up rough edges so the app reads as client-grade, not an internal tool — this matters a lot to us

New features: as we scale from 30 to 100+ clients, you will be building the next wave with us



You Are a Fit If

You have shipped a complete Next.js and Supabase app — not just features inside someone else's codebase

You can implement and explain real auth and RLS security, not just copy-paste from docs

You have audited and improved an existing codebase before — not only built new things from scratch

You scope your own work and figure out what needs to happen without being told

You are comfortable with screen-recorded hours tracking — we need honesty and transparency from the start

You want to grow

with a company long-term, not just complete a contract



TO APPLY YOU MUST SEND A LOOM AND ANSWER THE 2 QUESTIONS



Send us:



1. Send a loom walking through an app you built. Show the backend architecture, not just the UI. Explain one technical decision you made and why.



2. An existing Next.js and Supabase app has no auth layer and service-role keys are used client-side. Walk us through your exact fix sequence — what do you do first, second, third?



3. You are handed a codebase you did not write. What are the first 3 things you do before touching any code?



FINISH ALL 3 TASKS 



If you are looking for a short-term or project-based contract, this role is not for you. We are building a long-term team.

title: Corporate Admin & Payroll Manager
description:
Role Summary

Company: REMBOX Philippines

Role: Corporate Admin, HR & Payroll Manager

Reports to: CEO

Location: Manila, Philippines

Employment type: Full-time

Work setup: Hybrid (remote and onsite as required)

Target start: October 2025 (entity launch)

Contract type: B2B Contract



This is a critical founding role responsible for establishing the REMBOX Philippines legal entity from the ground up. You will manage all government registrations, compliance filings, and corporate administrative requirements, reporting directly to the CEO.



About REMBOX

REMBOX is an international architectural and engineering company serving as a strategic partner for leading design organizations in Israel and the United States. With over 500 professionals across four offices in Belarus, REMBOX is launching its Philippines entity in October 2025 as part of its global expansion strategy. The Philippines entity will serve as the base for REMBOX's growing team of architects, engineers, BIM specialists, and GIS professionals in Manila.

Follow us: 
/rembox_ltd



About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Corporate Admin, HR & Payroll Manager to lead the establishment of REMBOX Philippines. This role involves managing ongoing corporate administrative and compliance requirements, full-cycle HR administration and record keeping, and processing monthly payroll from scratch. You will own entity registration, corporate administration, HR documentation, record management, and payroll – excluding performance management, recruitment, and employee engagement. You will work closely with the CEO to ensure a successful October 2025 launch.



Key Responsibilities

Entity Registration & Government Compliance

Lead the full company registration process with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) via eSPARC, including Articles of Incorporation, By-laws, and all required documentation.

Handle Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) registration, including BIR Form 1903, books of account, and authority to print official receipts and invoices.

Secure all local government unit (LGU) permits and clearances, such as barangay clearance, mayor's permit, fire safety clearance, and zoning clearance.

Register the company with statutory agencies (SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG) as an employer.

Open and manage the corporate bank account in coordination with the CEO.

Coordinate with legal counsel, notaries, and government liaison officers as needed.

Monitor and track all registration timelines and deadlines to ensure the October 2025 entity launch target is met.



Corporate Administration

Maintain complete and organized corporate records, including minutes, resolutions, certificates, permits, and filings.

Manage annual compliance requirements, such as SEC annual reports (GIS), BIR annual filings, and LGU permit renewals.

Prepare and file required government reports and disclosures on time.

Coordinate with external accountants, auditors, and legal counsel for ongoing compliance.

Draft and manage corporate documents, including board resolutions, secretary's certificates, and authorization letters.

Build and maintain a compliance calendar to track all filing deadlines across agencies.



HR Administration & Record Keeping

Maintain complete, accurate, and organized employee records (201 files, contracts, government IDs, SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG numbers, TINs, and employment history).

Manage employee onboarding administration, including government number registration, requirements collection, and contract preparation under legal counsel direction.

Draft and maintain employment contracts, B2B contractor agreements, and offer letters in compliance with Philippine labor law and under legal counsel guidance.

Maintain a leave management system to track leave credits, absences, tardiness, and time off.

Manage employee timekeeping and attendance tracking for accurate payroll processing.

Process and record government-mandated benefits claims (SSS sickness/maternity/disability, PhilHealth reimbursements, Pag-IBIG loan applications).

Handle employee offboarding administration, including clearance processing, final pay computation, BIR Form 2316 preparation, and government number deregistration.

Maintain a central, organized, and version-controlled HR document repository.

Ensure compliance with DOLE reporting requirements and labor law standards.

Keep an updated organizational chart and employee directory.



Payroll Management

Set up and manage the full payroll process for REMBOX Philippines from scratch, including computation, payslip generation, and salary disbursement.

Process monthly payroll accurately and on time, including basic pay, allowances, overtime, holiday pay, and deductions.

Manage statutory contributions and remittances (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG) for all employees accurately and on time.

Handle BIR tax compliance related to payroll, including withholding tax on compensation (BIR Form 1601-C) and year-end BIR 

Form 2316 preparation and filing.

Maintain accurate payroll records, payslip history, and employee compensation schedules.

Coordinate with external accountants or payroll service providers as needed.



Executive Support (CEO)

Serve as the primary point of contact for all corporate admin and compliance matters, reporting directly to the CEO.

Provide regular status updates on registration progress, compliance deadlines, and corporate admin tasks.

Coordinate meetings, government appointments, and notarial services as required.

Handle confidential corporate documents with discretion and professionalism.



Registration Process Overview

The candidate must be fully capable of managing the following registration sequence end-to-end:

| 1 | SEC | Company name reservation, Articles of Incorporation, By-laws, Treasurer's Affidavit, eSPARC online filing, Certificate of Incorporation |

| 2 | Corporate Bank | Open corporate bank account, deposit paid-up capital, obtain bank certificate |

| 3 | BIR | BIR Form 1903, books of account registration, authority to print receipts and invoices, TIN issuance |

| 4 | LGU | Barangay clearance, mayor's permit, fire safety clearance, zoning clearance |

| 5 | SSS / PhilHealth / Pag-IBIG | Employer registration with all three statutory agencies prior to first hire |

| 6 | Ongoing compliance | SEC GIS annual report, BIR annual filings, LGU permit renewals, corporate records maintenance 



Must-have

Proven experience managing Philippine company registration (SEC, BIR, LGU, SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG).

Hands-on payroll management experience, including payroll computation, payslip generation, statutory remittances, and BIR withholding tax compliance.

Strong knowledge of the Philippine Labor Code, DOLE regulations, and HR compliance requirements.

Experience managing employee records (201 files), leave tracking, timekeeping, and HR documentation.

Experience handling government-mandated benefit claims (SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG).

Experience processing employee offboarding, including clearance, final pay, and BIR Form 2316.

Strong knowledge of Philippine corporate law, SEC regulations, and BIR compliance requirements.

Experience with the SEC eSPARC online registration system.

Experience filing BIR payroll-related returns (BIR Form 1601-C and BIR Form 2316).

Ability to work directly with and report to C-level executives.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple processes simultaneously.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Ability to work independently and take full ownership across all areas of the role.

Trustworthy and discreet with sensitive corporate and employee information.



Nice-to-have

Experience registering a foreign-owned or internationally funded company in the Philippines.

Background in corporate law, accounting, or business administration.

Experience with payroll software (e.g., Sprout HR, GreatDay, PayrollHero, or similar Philippine payroll systems).

Experience managing HR and payroll for a newly established company from scratch.

Familiarity with foreign investment regulations and the Foreign Investment Negative List (FINL).

Experience with BOI or PEZA registration for international companies.

Network with SEC, BIR, and LGU government liaisons.



What REMBOX Offers

Direct reporting line and daily collaboration with the CEO.

The opportunity to build something from scratch – be the founding admin of REMBOX Philippines.

A high-visibility, high-impact role within a growing international company.

Official employment through a B2B contract arrangement.

Long-term career opportunity as REMBOX Philippines grows.

Exposure to an international company culture across Israel, Europe, and North America.



Timeline & Urgency

REMBOX Philippines is targeting an October 2025 entity launch. This role needs to be filled urgently to allow sufficient time to complete the full registration process before that date.

Target entity launch: October 2025

Estimated registration timeline: 4-6 weeks for full registration (SEC ? BIR ? LGU ? statutory agencies)

Ideal start date: August/September 2025

Priority: High – this role is critical to the October launch.



Recruitment Process

| 1 | Initial Interview | Background, experience, and knowledge assessment with Ged |

| 2 | CEO Interview | Direct interview with Nadim (CEO) – role expectations, company vision, and fit assessment |

| 3 | Offer | Compensation discussion and offer upon successful completion of both interviews |



? This is a direct-to-CEO hire. Speed is critical – we need this person in place as soon as possible to meet the October 2025 entity launch target.

title: AI Chatbot Specialist — Prompt Engineer and n8n Automation
description:
About Us

We run AI-powered Instagram DM setters for 30+ online coaches with 20 full-time employees. The setters run through ManyChat, connect to n8n, store conversation history in Supabase, and book calls directly through Relevance.ai — no booking link, fully automated. Every single client we have came through a referral. The system works. We are bringing in someone to own the engine and make it sharper, long-term.



Compensation

$10–$15/hr depending on experience.

20+ hours per week. Long-term ongoing role — not a one-off project.

Hours are verified via screen recording software. We value trust and transparency, and we set that expectation from day one.



Schedule and Availability

Async-first. You manage your own time with enough overlap to collaborate on strategy and fixes.



What You Will Own

Prompt engineering: write, test, and iterate on AI setter prompts that build rapport, qualify leads, and book calls — not generic chatbot scripts



Performance: find and fix the drop-off points in the conversation flow that are costing bookings



n8n automation: build and improve workflows that handle message routing, classification, disqualification logic, and lead management



Tracking and reporting: monitor booking rates per client, flag what is working and what is not, own the improvement loop



Scaling: as we grow from 30 to 100+ clients, your work multiplies — you are building the foundation, not just patching



You Are a Fit If

You have built or managed AI DM setters with appointment setting as the actual goal — not just chatbots



You understand how online coaches sell and how buying decisions happen through Instagram DMs



You have hands-on n8n experience and can build or fix automations yourself without being guided



You can work with Claude, Relevance.ai, or similar LLM tools — not just prompt templates



You are comfortable with screen-recorded

hours tracking — we need honesty and transparency from the start



You want to grow with a company long-term, not just pick up a one-time gig



TO APPLY YOU MUST FOLLOW ALL OF THE STEPS BELOW



Send us:



A Loom showing an AI DM setter you have built — walk through the conversation flow, the logic, and the actual calls booked. No results shown means no consideration.



AND ANSWER THESE 2 QUESTIONS



1. A setter prompt is booking calls but leads are unqualified and cancelling at 50%. Walk us through exactly how you would diagnose and fix it.



2. Describe a setter and sales disqualification workflow you have built in n8n: what triggers it, what does it check, and what happens when a lead fails?



PLEASE FOLLOW ALL OF THE STEPS ABOVE TO APPLY



If you do not have direct experience building AI chatbots for appointment setting, please do not apply. If you are looking for a short-term contract, this role is not for you.

title: Bodycam Arrest Researcher
description:
FOIA Researcher Needed — Bodycam True Crime Channel (Ongoing, 2 Cases/Week) I run a true crime YouTube channel focused on bodycam and interrogation footage, and I'm looking for an experienced FOIA researcher to source cases on an ongoing basis. What I need: You will deliver two (2) fully sourced cases per week. Each case must include enough material to support a 20–40 minute video. In practice, that means:



Bodycam, dashcam, and/or interrogation footage already obtained (not "requestable" — obtained) For each video file: exact runtime clearly stated Strong narrative potential: the case needs a story worth telling — an arc, a twist, escalation, an unusual outcome. Not routine traffic stops or generic arrests. If the footage is long but nothing happens, it's not a case. A short case summary (who, what, where, outcome/current status)



Supporting documents (police reports, court records, 911 audio) are appreciated but not required — footage and story come first. Case freshness matters: Strong preference for recent cases that haven't already been covered on YouTube. Before pitching a case, do a quick search — if the footage is already uploaded on multiple channels, I'm not interested. Fresh FOIA releases and under-the-radar cases are exactly what I'm looking for. Hard requirements — read before applying:



I will not accept pitches like "I can get footage from X case" without specifying the exact runtime of the footage and what actually happens in it. If you don't know what the material looks like, don't pitch it. Footage must be public record and legally obtained through FOIA / public records requests. No leaked or pirated material. Consistency matters more than one-off finds. This is a weekly, long-term collaboration.



To apply, send: Include the word Chocolate in your application, One example case you could deliver right now, including footage runtime and a 2-3 sentence summary of why it makes a good video Your experience with FOIA / public records requests (which states/agencies you've worked with) Your rate per case or per week. I prefer Midwest Safety style bodycam cases. 



Applications that don't include footage runtime and case details will be ignored.

title: Long Term Virtual Assistant for Social Media Outreach (UK Marketing Agency)
description:
ABOUT US



We are a UK-based marketing and sales agency. We work with online coaches and consultants, and we handle everything for them: content, funnels, copy, and sales. Our goal is to hit seven figures before the end of the year. We are small, we move fast, and we treat our team well. We are looking for one person to join us long term and grow with us.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING



You will run our social media outreach. Every day you will:



•  Find and collect potential leads on Instagram based on criteria we give you

•  Check each one against our rules to d
 whether they are a good fit

•  Send first messages to the ones that qualify

•  Send follow-up messages to people from previous days

•  Log everything in a shared tracker

•  Send a short daily report at the end of your shift



You do not need to have done outreach before. We will train you properly and you will have SOPs, training calls, and someone to ask when you are unsure. What matters is that you are reliable, careful, and you follow instructions closely.



HOURS



•  4 hours per day, Monday to Friday

•  Between 12:00 and 16:00 UK time

•  Weekends off



PAY



$5 to $10 per hour depending on experience.



We start hourly. After the first month, once we both know how long the work actually takes, we move you to a fixed monthly salary. Most people prefer this and it usually works out better for you.



LENGTH



Long term. More than 6 months. We are hiring someone to stay, not for a short project.



ROOM TO GROW



This role starts with outreach, but it does not stay there. As you get comfortable, we will give you more hours and a wider range of work across the business. More responsibility comes with a higher rate.



We would rather promote someone we already trust than hire someone new. If you do well here, that is the path.



REQUIREMENTS



•  Excellent English, both spoken and written

•  Reliable and consistent, you show up at the same time every day

•  You follow instructions closely and ask when unsure rather than guessing

•  Comfortable doing the same task every day to a high standard

•  Looking for something long term



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



•  Laptop/computer less than 5 years old

•  Fast and reliable internet connection



When you fill out the form below, for “Where did you see this job posted?”, include the word LONDON in your answer. We read every application and this is how we know you read the post properly.



START DATE



On or before Tuesday 25 August.



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in this form: 
 



Please apply through the form. Applications sent by message will not be read. If you have a genuine question about the role, you can message me, but do not use it to apply.

title: Social Media & Marketing Manager — Aesthetics Clinic & Academy
description:
# Social Media & Marketing Manager — Aesthetics Clinic & Academy



We are looking for a reliable, creative and proactive **Social Media & Marketing Manager**, preferably with previous experience or strong knowledge of the **aesthetics, beauty, skincare or cosmetic treatment industry**.



You will be responsible for growing the online presence of both our **aesthetics clinic and training academy**, attracting new clients and students, promoting our treatments and courses, and building awareness within London.



**Pay:** $250 USD every 2 weeks

**Posting:** 7 days per week

**Daily posting deadline:** Content must be live by **5–6 PM UK time**



## Platforms



* Instagram

* TikTok

*

* YouTube Shorts

* WhatsApp Status

*

* Nextdoor/local community platforms

* Relevant London
 groups and communities



## Full Responsibilities



### Social Media Management



* Manage the clinic and academy's social media accounts across all required platforms.

* Create, plan and maintain a consistent weekly/monthly **content calendar**.

* Ensure agreed daily content is published by **5–6 PM UK time**.

* Adapt content appropriately for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, YouTube Shorts, 
 and
 rather than simply uploading identical posts everywhere.

* Write engaging captions, hooks, calls-to-action, hashtags, titles and descriptions.

* Schedule content in advance whenever possible.

* Maintain a professional and consistent brand image across all platforms.



### Aesthetics Clinic Marketing



* Create and promote content around our aesthetic treatments and services.

* Understand how to market an aesthetics clinic professionally and responsibly.

* Turn treatment footage, educational information, FAQs, client-approved content and clinic footage into engaging social media content.

* Develop content designed to turn followers into genuine enquiries and bookings.

* Create educational content that builds trust and demonstrates the clinic's expertise.

* Help promote new treatments, special campaigns and clinic announcements.

* Ensure treatment-related marketing is accurate and avoids misleading or inappropriate claims.



### Academy & Course Marketing



* Promote our aesthetics training courses and academy.

* Create content aimed at potential students who are interested in entering or developing within the aesthetics industry.

* Promote upcoming training dates and course availability.

* Showcase appropriate behind-the-scenes training content and student experiences where permission has been obtained.

* Create educational posts explaining courses, training opportunities and what students can expect.

* Help generate enquiries and potential student leads through social media.



### London Community Promotion



* Research and join relevant **London
 groups and local online communities**.

* Engage genuinely with local discussions and identify appropriate opportunities to introduce our clinic or academy.

* Promote the business in groups where business advertising is permitted.

* Manage and promote the business through **Nextdoor and other suitable local community platforms**.

* Identify posts from people looking for relevant aesthetic services or training and respond appropriately.

* Keep a record of groups and communities being used and which ones generate enquiries.

* Never spam groups or post advertisements where promotional content is prohibited.



### Community Management



* Monitor comments and social media engagement.

* Respond professionally to general enquiries within agreed guidelines.

* Flag important, sensitive or treatment-specific questions to the clinic rather than giving medical advice.

* Encourage appropriate engagement with followers and potential clients/students.

* Help develop an active local community around the clinic and academy.



### Content Creation & Editing



* Perform basic editing of Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts.

* Add appropriate subtitles, text, hooks and calls-to-action to videos.

* Create simple social media graphics and promotional material when required.

* Organize raw videos, edited videos, photos, graphics and completed posts within **iCloud**.

* Maintain clearly labelled folders so content can easily be found and reused.



### Growth & Strategy



* Develop separate social media strategies for the **clinic** and **academy**.

* Research aesthetics and beauty trends that could be relevant to our audience.

* Monitor competitors, particularly successful aesthetics clinics and academies in London.

* Research trending content formats, hooks and ideas.

* Suggest new campaigns and content ideas rather than waiting to be told what to post.

* Focus on meaningful results such as enquiries, bookings and academy leads—not only followers and likes.



### Analytics & Reporting



* Provide a **daily analytics screenshot** showing performance.

* Track reach, views, engagement, follower growth, enquiries and other relevant metrics.

* Provide a simple **weekly performance summary** explaining:



  * Best-performing content

  * Lowest-performing content

  * Follower growth

  * Reach and engagement

  * Enquiries/leads generated

  * What should be changed or tested the following week

* Use performance data to continually improve the content strategy.



## Must-Have



* Previous social media management experience.

* **Knowledge or experience within aesthetics, beauty, skincare, cosmetic treatments or a closely related industry is strongly preferred.**

* Good understanding of Instagram, TikTok,
 and short-form video.

* Strong written English and copywriting ability.

* Ability to create strong hooks, captions and calls-to-action.

* Basic short-form video editing skills.

* Understanding of social media analytics.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.

* Reliable enough to maintain a **7-day-per-week posting schedule**.

* Ability to work independently without needing daily reminders.

* Own computer/phone and reliable internet connection.



## Preferred Experience



* Previous work with an **aesthetics clinic, beauty clinic, cosmetic treatment provider or aesthetics academy**.

* Understanding of how to market treatments while keeping advertising accurate and responsible.

* Experience generating local leads for London businesses.

* Experience marketing training courses or educational businesses.

* Experience with Meta Business Suite and social scheduling tools.

* Experience growing a clinic or beauty brand's social media presence.



## What We Expect



We don't want someone who simply uploads the content we send them.



We are looking for someone who can **think strategically, bring us ideas, understand the aesthetics industry, identify opportunities to promote the clinic and academy, and actively work towards generating more enquiries, bookings and students.**



Reliability, consistency and communication are extremely important.

title: Digital Marketing Assistant
description:
We are looking for Tea
mbers who pursue a life of excellence & integrity.  



Excellence definition = You don't wait for others to teach you how to improve your craft. You invest your own time and money to develop your skills instead of waiting for the company to do it for you.



Integrity definition =  You are honest and transparent. You don't hide mistakes or talk behind your employer's back. You do what you say you're going to do—no exceptions.



Application Process:



1.

2.

> What are the 3 most important things that the company you work for MUST do to show you that they care about you? 

> For example, if they don’t give me these 3 things then that means they don’t care about me.

mbers, we have very low turnover, we need new tea
mbers for a new branch of our company. Because we are highly selective you will see our job ad on this job board all the time.

mbers.

mbers achieve their professional, financial, and personal goals. 



We're Seeking Individuals Who Are Aligned with Our Core Values...

• Other Benefits: Paid-Time off and medical insurance for qualified tea
mbers after successfully completing the 90-day training period.



Key Responsibilities:

title: Business & Commercial Representative – Attend Meetings & Close Deals | Web3 & iGaming | Philippines | Female Preferred
description:
Title:

Remote KOL Commercial Representative – Attend Meetings & Close Deals | Web3 & iGaming | Philippines | Female Preferred



————————————————————————



About us



We are a growth company in Web3 and iGaming / Slot. We work with global KOLs, MCNs, agents, and affiliate partners.



Our internal team will handle:

• KOL research and screening

• Initial outreach

• Scheduling commercial meetings (calls / video meetings)



We are hiring one person whose main job is to ATTEND these meetings ON BEHALF OF OUR COMPANY and negotiate until all cooperation details are agreed.



————————————————————————



Your main job



When our team books a commercial meeting with a KOL, agent, or MCN, you will:



1. Join the meeting on time (video or voice)

2. Represent our company professionally

3. Present the campaign proposal we provide

4. Negotiate all commercial terms, including:

   - Price / rate

   - Deliverables (content format, posting schedule, platforms)

   - Payment terms

   - Hybrid / CPA / CPS structures when applicable

   - Repeat collaboration and long-term partnership options

5. Answer questions, handle objections, and push toward a clear agreement

6. Send a written recap after the meeting (terms agreed + next steps)

7. Follow up until the deal is fully confirmed and ready for execution



You are the company’s face in the meeting. Our team supports you with proposals, background info, and internal approval — but YOU lead the conversation and drive the deal to close.



————————————————————————



What you do NOT need to do



• Find KOL lists from scratch

• Send mass cold
s or cold DMs

• Book meetings (our team schedules them for you)



Your focus is 100% on showing up, negotiating well, and closing.



————————————————————————



Requirements



• Excellent English — very fluent, natural, and confident in live video/voice meetings (required)

• Strong professional presence — well-presented on camera, clear communication, trustworthy image

• Female candidates preferred for this client-facing representative role

• Based in the Philippines, available full-time

• Flexible schedule for meetings across different time zones (including evenings when needed)

• 2+ years experience in BD, account management, KOL/influencer commercial talks, affiliate, crypto, or iGaming

• Experience discussing CPA, CPS, hybrid deals, or repeat KOL partnerships is a strong plus

• Able to take brief notes during calls and write clear follow-up summaries in English

• Stable internet, quiet workspace, professional background for video calls



————————————————————————



Ideal candidate



You are comfortable representing a company in front of KOLs and agents. You can explain an offer clearly, negotiate calmly, and close details without needing someone else on every call. You treat each meeting as a real business negotiation, not a casual chat.



————————————————————————



Hiring process



Step 1 — Application review

We review your CV, photo, and English video intro.



Step 2 — Live mock negotiation (required)

Shortlisted candidates will join a live video call with our team. You will role-play as our company representative in a sample KOL / agent negotiation (e.g. rate discussion, deliverables, CPA/CPS terms). This is to test your English, confidence on camera, and negotiation style.



Step 3 — Paid trial period (required before full offer)

Candidates who pass the mock call will enter a paid trial period (typically 2 weeks).



During the trial you will:

• Join real or simulated KOL meetings scheduled by our team

• Represent the company using our proposals and talking points

• Send post-meeting recaps in English

• Receive feedback after each call



Our management may join some calls to evaluate your performance. Trial compensation will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.



Step 4 — Full-time offer

If the trial goes well, we will extend a long-term full-time offer with base pay plus commission on closed deals.



Salary and full compensation package will be discussed during the interview and before the trial period starts.



————————————————————————



What we offer



• Remote, full-time, long-term role after successful trial

• Performance-based commission on closed deals

• Support from our execution and operations team (KOL info, proposals, meeting schedule)

• Growth path to Senior Partnership Manager for strong performers



————————————————————————



How to apply



Please send:



1. CV / resume

2. Recent professional photo

3. A 2–3 minute English video: introduce yourself + describe one time you represented a company or client in a business meeting or negotiation

4. Your weekly availability for calls (including evening slots if possible)

5. Earliest start date



Only candidates comfortable with a live mock negotiation and a paid trial period should apply.



————————————————————————

title: HEAD OF SALES & MARKETING – INTERNATIONAL LUXURY FASHION BRAND
description:
We are looking for an exceptional Head of Sales & Marketing to take full ownership of the international growth of our luxury fashion brand.



This is not a narrow marketing role.



You will lead the complete Sales & Marketing operation, manage a growing team of currently 5 team members, build the systems, drive execution and work directly with the founders.



We are looking for someone highly commercial, analytical, creative and extremely hands-on.



YOUR MISSION



You will be responsible for building and managing the complete commercial engine of the company:



MARKETING & BRAND GROWTH



* Lead the complete international marketing strategy.

* Manage and follow up the existing marketing and sales team.

* Build and manage the daily, weekly and monthly marketing planning.

* Develop Instagram, TikTok and other relevant social channels.

* Build TikTok into a serious growth and sales channel.

* Coordinate content creation, Reels, video, photography and campaigns.

* Help organize fashion shoots and content productions.

* Manage influencer, blogger, PR and creator collaborations.

* Develop
 marketing and CRM through Klaviyo.

* Coordinate launches, events, store activations and international campaigns.

* Maintain consistent luxury brand positioning across all channels.



AFFILIATE & AMBASSADOR PROGRAM



* Lead and scale our international Ambassador Program.

* Strong knowledge of UpPromote or comparable affiliate platforms.

* Recruit and activate ambassadors, concierges, wedding planners, influencers and other commercial partners.

* Develop commission structures, incentives and performance systems.

* Track activity, sales and ROI.

* Manage the team responsible for recruitment and follow-up.



Affiliate marketing is an important part of the role, while only one part of the complete Sales & Marketing operation.



B2B SALES & FASHION WEEKS



* Lead international B2B development.

* Build prospect lists and sales pipelines.

* Manage the team securing appointments with premium fashion buyers.

* Prepare our commercial activities for New York Fashion Week and Paris Fashion Week.

* Drive appointments before the shows.

* Follow up buyers after the shows.

* Help develop and optimize our B2B sales platform and private B2B websites.

* Negotiate partnerships and commercial opportunities.



E-COMMERCE & DIGITAL SALES



* Strong understanding of Shopify.

* Develop and optimize our D2C and B2B websites.

* Coordinate website content, collections, campaigns and commercial updates.

* Identify and develop additional sales channels.

* Explore and activate relevant marketplaces and commerce platforms.

* Develop opportunities through TikTok Shop, Meta commerce, affiliate channels and other international platforms.

* Improve online conversion and customer acquisition.



SALES CHANNEL DEVELOPMENT



You will continuously identify new ways to generate revenue.



This includes:



* D2C

* B2B wholesale

* Affiliate marketing

* Ambassador sales

* Influencer commerce

* Marketplaces

* TikTok Shop

* Social commerce

* Luxury hotels and resorts

* Concept stores

* International retail partnerships

* New digital sales platforms



We expect active execution, not only research.



TEAM & OPERATIONS



You will initially manage approximately 5 team members and help us build a stronger international commercial team.



You will:



* Set daily priorities.

* Assign responsibilities.

* Follow up execution.

* Conduct performance reviews.

* Build SOPs and workflows.

* Monitor productivity.

* Coach the team.

* Intervene quickly when results are below expectations.

* Recruit additional people when necessary.



SYSTEMS, KPI’S & REPORTING



We want a data-driven commercial operation.



You will build and manage dashboards covering:



* Sales

* Leads

* B2B appointments

* Ambassador recruitment

* Ambassador activity

* Affiliate revenue

* Conversion

*
 performance

* Social media growth

* Content production

* Campaign performance

* New sales channels

* Team productivity

* ROI



Experience with ClickUp is a major advantage.



Our objective is to have one clear system where management can immediately see:



What is happening ? Who owns it ? What is overdue ? What is producing results ? What needs attention next.



REQUIREMENTS



We are looking for someone with:



* Proven Sales & Marketing leadership experience.

* Strong international commercial mindset.

* Excellent sales and negotiation skills.

* Experience managing a team.

* Strong Shopify knowledge.

* Experience with Klaviyo or advanced
/CRM marketing.

* Affiliate / ambassador marketing experience.

* UpPromote experience is a major advantage.

* Strong understanding of social media and content marketing.

* Strong understanding of TikTok.

* Experience with B2B sales and lead generation.

* Excellent analytical skills.

* Ability to build KPI dashboards and systems.

* Excellent English communication skills.

* Strong ownership mentality.

* Very high level of organization.

* Comfortable working in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment.

* Available 40 hours per week.

* Comfortable working with Hubstaff.

* ClickUp experience is highly preferred.



Experience in fashion, luxury, beauty, hospitality or premium lifestyle brands is a major advantage.



WHAT WE OFFER



* Competitive base salary.

* Attractive performance bonuses.

* High commissions based on results.

* Direct collaboration with the founders.

* Significant responsibility and autonomy.

* Opportunity to build and lead an international commercial team.

* International career growth.

* Optional travel opportunities to Ibiza, Mallorca, New York and Paris.



This role is for someone who wants to build, lead and grow, not simply execute a small part of a marketing department.



If you love sales, marketing, fashion, negotiations, systems, international growth and building high-performing teams, we would love to hear from you.



Send us:

* Your experience managing Sales & Marketing teams

* Your Shopify / Klaviyo / affiliate marketing experience

* Examples of measurable commercial results you have achieved

title: Talent & HR Leader – Recruitment, Hiring, HR & Candidate Endorsement | Full-Time | Remote
description:
Talent & HR Leader – Recruitment, Hiring, HR & Candidate Endorsement | Full-Time | Remote

Location: Remote, Philippines-based preferred

Schedule: Full-Time

Work Hours: U.S. business hours

Compensation: $7-8+/hour, based on experience

Type: Long-Term | Full-Time



About the Role

We are looking for a strong Talent & HR Leader to lead recruitment, hiring, candidate endorsement, and HR/people operations for our Virtual Assistant workforce, especially healthcare-related roles. This is not just a recruiter role, and it's not just an HR role — it's both, combined into one seat. This person will own the full employee lifecycle: building strong talent pipelines, assessing candidate quality, endorsing candidates quickly and accurately, and then carrying that relationship forward through onboarding, employee relations, performance management, policy, and offboarding.



The ideal candidate has experience recruiting Virtual Assistants or remote talent and experience running HR functions for a remote or distributed team — policies, employee relations, performance, compliance — and can manage a disciplined process across both functions with clear metrics, strong follow-through, and high standards. This role requires someone who can balance speed with quality, and who can shift comfortably between hiring mode and people-management mode.



What You'll Own

Talent Acquisition & Hiring

- Recruit capable, culturally aligned Virtual Assistants based on client demand

- Build proactive talent pipelines for current and future roles

- Screen candidates for job capability, communication, professionalism, reliability, and culture fit

- Support hiring for key healthcare, dental, medical, orthodontic, administrative, client-facing, and operations roles

- Maintain strong candidate communication throughout the hiring process

- Negotiate, coordinate, and support hiring decisions as needed

Candidate Endorsement & SLA Management

- Ensure qualified candidates are endorsed to match client demand within required timelines

- Monitor endorsement timelines and intervene when candidates are at risk of missing deadlines

- Keep candidate movement organized and visible across the hiring pipeline

- Escalate stalled candidates, assessment concerns, or client-demand changes quickly

- Support smooth handoff from recruitment into onboarding or placement

HR & People Operations

- Own onboarding from offer acceptance through first 90 days, including documentation, account setup coordination, and orientation

- Serve as the primary HR point of contact for the VA workforce — answering policy questions, handling day-to-day employee relations issues, and escalating serious matters appropriately

- Maintain and evolve HR policies, employee handbooks, and standard operating procedures for a remote Philippines-based workforce

- Manage performance review cycles, PIPs, and documentation of performance or conduct issues

- Track and administer time-off, attendance, and any benefits or incentive programs

- Handle offboarding: exit conversations, knowledge transfer, access revocation coordination, and exit documentation

- Maintain accurate, compliant employee records

- Partner with leadership on compensation bands, promotions, and role changes

- Help build a strong internal culture, employee engagement practices, and retention initiatives across the VA team

Recruiting Operations & Process Improvement

- Manage and improve recruiting workflows, playbooks, templates, and SOPs

- Maintain accurate candidate records and pipeline updates in the ATS

- Use recruitment tools, dashboards, reports, and AI tools to improve hiring efficiency

- Identify bottlenecks in the hiring funnel and recommend improvements

- Standardize how candidates are screened, evaluated, endorsed, and handed off

Team Leadership & Coaching

- Coach recruiters and/or HR team members on screening quality, candidate communication, employee relations handling, and internal standards

- Review quality-of-hire concerns or culture/job-fit misses

- Support consistent evaluation and people-management standards across the team

- Lead with clear communication, accountability, and professionalism

Funnel Management & Reporting

- Review pipeline volume, funnel movement, and time-to-fill across open roles

- Track application volume, assessment pass rates, interview-to-offer conversion, and endorsement timelines

- Report hiring and HR metrics, risks, and recommendations to leadership (turnover, retention, time-to-fill, employee relations trends)

- Identify early patterns by role, client, cohort, source, or recruiter

Onboarding-to-Pool & Retention Support

- Own the full onboarding-to-tenure arc for newly hired VAs, not just the handoff

- Partner with VA Success and Client Success on early-tenure risks

- Monitor 90-day and long-term retention and early performance trends

- Identify whether hiring filters, sourcing channels, screening, or HR/onboarding processes need improvement

- Support long-term retention by improving both hiring quality and the employee experience from day one through tenure



Required Experience

- Experience in talent acquisition, recruiting leadership, or VA hiring

- Experience running HR functions — employee relations, performance management, policy, offboarding — ideally for a remote or distributed team

- Experience assessing both job capability and culture fit

- Strong understanding of high-quality candidate screening and evaluation

- Experience managing hiring pipelines and recruitment metrics

- Strong written and spoken English communication

- Strong judgment and decision-making skills, especially with sensitive employee matters

- Ability to coach recruiters and/or HR team members

- Strong documentation, follow-up, and reporting habits

- Comfortable working with U.S.-based clients, teams, or leadership

- Able to manage multiple open roles, HR cases, and competing priorities simultaneously

- Comfortable using an ATS or recruiting platform, plus HR/HRIS tooling



Healthcare Hiring Experience Preferred — Experience recruiting for healthcare, dental, orthodontic, medical, patient support, insurance, billing, administrative, or healthcare-adjacent roles is a plus. Understanding how to evaluate candidates for healthcare environments — communication, reliability, privacy awareness, documentation, professionalism, and patient/client service standards — is valuable.



What Success Looks Like

- Strong candidates are hired based on client demand and endorsed within required timelines

- Hiring pipelines are clear, active, and well-managed

- New hires have a smooth, well-documented onboarding experience

- Employee relations issues are handled promptly, fairly, and with proper documentation

- HR policies and processes are clear, consistent, and compliant

- Recruiters and/or HR team members are coached toward stronger performance

- Leadership has clear visibility into both hiring and HR metrics and risks

- Retention improves because candidates are better matched to the role and better supported once hired



To Apply

Please submit the following:

1. A viewable link to your updated resume

2. A short paragraph describing your experience with:

   - Recruiting or talent acquisition

   - VA or remote talent hiring

   - HR / people operations (employee relations, performance management, policy, offboarding)

   - Managing hiring pipelines or recruiting metrics



Subject Line: Talent & HR Leader – [Your Full Name]



We are looking for a Talent & HR Leader who can build a strong, scalable recruiting function while also owning the people side of the employee lifecycle — from first endorsement through long-term retention.

title: Full Time AI Community Newsletter Writer and Content Creator and Curator
description:
We are looking for a talented, dependable, and creative **AI Community Newsletter Writer and Content Curator** to join our team full time.



Our company manages several active communities focused on artificial intelligence, entrepreneurship, professional development, and business growth. We are not looking for someone who simply writes generic newsletters. We need someone who can enter our communities, identify the most valuable conversations, interview our members, review training content, and turn everything into newsletters people are excited to open and read.



You will manage up to **five weekly community newsletters and one daily newsletter**.



## What You Will Do



- Write, edit, format, and prepare engaging newsletters for multiple communities

- Review
 Groups, Skool communities, live training sessions, event recordings, Zoom calls, transcripts, and other community content

- Identify important discussions, questions, wins, announcements, resources, and opportunities that should be featured

- Interview community members, instructors, experts, team members, and special guests

- Prepare thoughtful interview questions before each interview

- Review interview recordings and transcripts and turn them into compelling newsletter stories

- Use AI tools to summarize, organize, repurpose, edit, and improve content

- Highlight and celebrate community member accomplishments, breakthroughs, testimonials, launches, promotions, and business wins

- Create educational newsletter sections that teach readers something useful

- Find and feature relevant opportunities such as grants, speaking opportunities, events, jobs, partnerships, tools, programs, and business resources

- Turn live trainings and long form content into short, clear, actionable newsletter content

- Write strong subject lines, headlines, introductions, calls to action, and community announcements

- Maintain the unique voice and personality of each community

- Coordinate with our team to collect information, confirm details, and meet publishing deadlines

- Maintain an editorial calendar for all newsletters

- Track upcoming events, deadlines, promotions, and important community dates

- Proofread every newsletter carefully before submission

- Recommend new newsletter sections, story ideas, engagement strategies, and content improvements



## What We Are Looking For



You must be an excellent writer and storyteller who knows how to make information clear, useful, interesting, and easy to read.



You must also be:



- Highly proficient with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms

- Experienced in using AI without producing robotic, repetitive, or inaccurate writing

- Comfortable creating prompts and AI workflows for research, writing, editing, summarizing, and repurposing content

- Skilled at interviewing people and asking questions that uncover meaningful stories

- Able to work from audio recordings, video recordings, transcripts, notes, and community conversations

- Experienced with
 Groups, Skool, or other online community platforms

- Excellent in written English, grammar, spelling, editing, and proofreading

- Able to capture someone else’s brand voice instead of writing everything in the same style

- Highly organized and capable of managing multiple newsletters and deadlines at the same time

- Proactive and able to identify great content without waiting for someone to assign every story

- Comfortable communicating with community members in a warm, professional, and respectful manner

- Able to verify names, dates, links, opportunities, and factual information before publishing

- Dependable, responsive, detail oriented, and committed to meeting deadlines



## Our Newsletter Philosophy



Our newsletters should make community members feel informed, valued, inspired, and connected.



Every newsletter should include a thoughtful combination of:



- Community member celebrations

- Educational tips and practical lessons

- Highlights from trainings and community conversations

- Important announcements and upcoming events

- Valuable tools, resources, and recommendations

- Relevant business, career, speaking, funding, partnership, or growth opportunities

- Clear next steps that encourage members to participate



We want our readers to finish each newsletter feeling like they learned something, discovered an opportunity, and became more connected to the community.



## Work Schedule



This is a **full time, long term position**.



You must be able to manage up to five weekly newsletters and one daily newsletter while maintaining excellent quality and meeting every deadline.



Some availability during United States business hours will be required for team meetings, interviews, and communication. The remaining work may be completed during your regular working hours in the Philippines.



## Performance Expectations



Your success will be measured by:



- Newsletters being completed accurately and on time

- Quality of writing and storytelling

- Ability to find valuable stories and opportunities

- Member engagement with newsletter content

- Accuracy of names, links, dates, and information

- Ability to maintain the voice of each community

- Strong organization and communication with the team

- Consistent use of AI to improve efficiency without lowering quality



## How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A short introduction explaining why you are a strong fit for this role

2. Links or attachments to two or three writing samples

3. An example of a newsletter you have written, if available

4. A description of the AI tools you currently use and how you use them

5. An example of how you would turn a one hour training or interview transcript into newsletter content

6. Your experience interviewing people or writing profile stories

7. Your expected monthly salary for a full time position

8. Your availability and preferred working hours in Philippine Time

9. The words **Community Newsletter Pro** at the beginning of your application so we know you read the complete job description



Applicants may be asked to complete a short paid writing test using a sample transcript or community discussion.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with our company, become deeply familiar with our communities, and help us create newsletters that our members genuinely look forward to receiving.

title: Sales & Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
Sales & Operations Virtual Assistant



Full-Time | U.S. Pacific Time



Are you a confident salesperson who can close deals AND take ownership of day-to-day operations?



SoCal Signature Clean is a rapidly growing premium cleaning company serving Southern California. We're looking for a sharp, ambitious Sales & Operations Virtual Assistant to become a key member of our team.



This is not a typical VA or customer service position.



We're looking for someone who can confidently speak with U.S.-based customers, turn inbound leads into booked jobs, solve problems without needing constant direction, and help ensure our daily cleaning operations run smoothly.



Your primary responsibility will be sales and converting inbound leads, but you'll also play an important role in operations, customer communication, scheduling, and social media.



If you're competitive, organized, dependable, and looking for a long-term opportunity where your responsibilities and income can grow with the company, we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do:



SALES & CUSTOMER GROWTH



* Answer inbound calls from prospective customers interested in our cleaning services

* Follow up aggressively and professionally with warm leads by phone, text, and

* Build rapport quickly with U.S.-based customers

* Understand each customer's needs and recommend the right service

* Explain our pricing and value confidently

* Handle objections related to price, scheduling, competitors, and trust

* Ask for the sale and confidently close customers over the phone

* Convert one-time customers into recurring weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly clients

* Follow up with past customers to generate repeat business and referrals

* Maintain accurate notes and follow-up tasks in our CRM



**There is no cold calling.** Most sales conversations will be with customers who have already expressed interest in our services.



DAILY OPERATIONS



You'll also help manage the day-to-day operations of our cleaning business.



This includes:



* Monitoring the cleaning schedule throughout the day

* Communicating with cleaners before, during, and after jobs

* Confirming that teams arrive on time and jobs are completed successfully

* Communicating schedule updates and instructions to customers and cleaners

* Helping resolve last-minute scheduling changes or operational issues

* Coordinating new bookings with cleaner availability

* Following up with customers after their cleaning

* Identifying problems before they become bigger issues

* Keeping our systems, schedules, and customer information organized



We don't want someone who simply waits to be told what to do. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, notices problems, and helps solve them.



SOCIAL MEDIA & ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT



As part of the role, you'll also help with:



* Posting and scheduling content across our social media accounts

* Responding to basic social media messages and inquiries

* Organizing customer photos and content

* Assisting with review generation and customer follow-up

* CRM updates and administrative tasks

* Helping with other projects as the company grows



Who We're Looking For



Our ideal candidate is:



*Excellent in spoken and written English

* Confident and natural speaking with American customers

* Experienced in phone sales, appointment setting, closing, or high-converting customer service

* Comfortable asking for the sale

* Strong at handling objections without sounding scripted

* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Calm under pressure and good at solving problems

* Able to manage multiple conversations and priorities at once

* Dependable and punctual

* Self-motivated and comfortable working independently

* Coachable and interested in improving

* Comfortable being measured on performance and results

* Looking for a **long-term position**, not a temporary job



Experience working with a U.S.-based home service company is a major plus, but not required.



Technical Requirements



You must have:



* Reliable computer

* Wired high-speed internet connection of at least 30 Mbps

* Quiet, professional workspace with minimal background noise

* High-quality headset and microphone

* Backup internet connection

* Backup computer/device in case of emergencies



Because this position involves answering live inbound sales calls, reliable internet and attendance are extremely important.



Compensation



Starting Pay: $5.00 USD/hour - 40 hours per week



PLUS:



* Uncapped sales commissions

* Performance bonuses

* Opportunities for raises based on performance

* Opportunities for increased responsibility and advancement as the company grows



We want someone who is motivated by results. Strong performers will have the opportunity to earn significantly more than their base hourly pay.



Schedule



* Full-time position

* Must be available during U.S. business hours

* Schedule will follow Pacific Time (California)



Please make sure you're comfortable working these hours from the Philippines before applying.



Why Join SoCal Signature Clean?



We're building a company, not just filling a VA position.



You'll have the opportunity to:



* Join a growing U.S.-based company

* Work with warm inbound leads instead of cold calling

* Earn additional income through sales commissions and performance bonuses

* Develop skills in sales, operations, customer experience, and business management

* Take on more responsibility as you prove yourself

* Grow into a leadership position as our team expands

* Directly impact the growth and success of the company



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us for years, not months.



How to Apply



*Applications without a recording will not be considered.*



Please submit a 1–2 minute video or audio recording introducing yourself and answering the following:



1. Tell us about your previous sales experience.

2. Why are you interested in joining SoCal Signature Clean?



Please also include your resume



We're excited to meet you!

title: Front Office Assistant
description:
Front Office Specialist

Location: Remote, Philippines

Schedule: Full-time during United States Eastern Time business hours

About the Role

We are hiring a friendly, dependable, and organized Front Office Specialist to serve as the first point of contact for homeowners and prospective customers.

You will answer inbound calls, understand what each caller needs, capture accurate information, and help qualified customers schedule appointments. You will also return missed calls, respond to messages, update the CRM, confirm appointments, and coordinate with sales and operations.

This is a phone-first role for someone who communicates naturally in English, stays composed during busy periods, and understands that every call shapes the customer’s impression of the business.

What You Will Do

Answer inbound calls promptly with a warm, confident, and professional tone. Identify the purpose of each call and guide the customer to the correct next step.

Collect accurate names, phone numbers,
 addresses, service addresses, project details, preferred timing, referral sources, and notes. Ask approved qualification questions to confirm the requested service and service area.

Schedule estimate appointments in the company calendar and CRM. Select the correct appointment type, territory, representative, date, and time while preventing conflicts.

Return missed calls and respond to voi
s, texts, and
s. Follow up quickly with new inquiries, warm leads, unscheduled customers, and previous estimates.

Confirm appointments and handle routine cancellations or rescheduling requests. Communicate changes promptly to customers and internal team members.

Answer common questions about services, the estimate process, scheduling, appointment preparation, and next steps using approved information. Do not guess, provide unauthorized pricing, or make promises outside company policy.

Document every interaction in the CRM. Maintain accurate contact details, call notes, appointment information, lead status, follow-up dates, and outcomes.

Coordinate with sales representatives, estimators, project managers, installers, and office staff. Monitor inboxes, voi
 queues, messages, and CRM tasks, complete follow-ups on time, and route concerns to the correct person.

What We Are Looking For

You have at least two years of experience in customer service, call-center support, virtual reception, appointment setting, front-office administration, or a similar phone-based role.

You speak clear, professional English and communicate naturally with customers in the United States. You listen carefully, ask focused questions, and explain next steps without sounding scripted or rushed.

You can handle a steady volume of calls while entering accurate information. You can speak, listen, type, review a calendar, and update a CRM without losing important details.

You have experience with CRM, scheduling, call-center, or customer-support software. Experience with home services, construction, property services, or appointment-based businesses is strongly preferred.

You verify names, contact information, service addresses, dates, appointment windows, and notes before saving them. You remain calm with frustrated customers and know when to solve, transfer, or escalate an issue.

You use approved information and do not make promises the company cannot keep. You can follow procedures, meet response-time expectations, maintain reliable attendance, and communicate consistently with a remote team.

title: Personal Assistant – Medicare Lead Follow-Up & Dating App Support (PST) + $10 Show Bonus
description:
We're looking for a sharp, fluent-English Personal Assistant for two connected parts of the role: helping activate and follow up with opted-in Medicare leads, and personally collaborating with me live on dating apps. This is a part-time, ongoing role (20 hrs/week, 4 hrs/day, with flexible timing between 9am–7pm PST) — and here's the headline: you can earn a $10.00 USD bonus per Qualified Appointment, on top of your hourly base.



PART 1 — MEDICARE LEAD ACTIVATION & SMS FOLLOW-UP (about half your time):

This is NOT cold calling or lead generation. Every lead you contact has already opted in — your job is speed-to-lead response and long-term nurturing, activating leads who raised their hand, not prospecting strangers.

- Speed-to-Lead Outbound Calling: call new Meta ad leads within 5 minutes of their form submission, any time between 9am–7pm PST, up to 5 times a day (via power dialer)

- Long-Term SMS Nurturing & GHL Inbox Management: GoHighLevel is already set up with an extensive
/SMS/FB Messenger nurture sequence — maintain two-way text engagement, keep leads warm, and convert that engagement into a booked appointment once their enrollment window opens

- Multi-channel follow-up: move fluidly between phone, SMS/text, and app messaging depending on how each lead responds

- Re-engaging no-shows and cold/stalled leads via text to get them rescheduled

- Booking appointments and following up to maximize show rate (confirmation texts/calls, reminders, reschedules)

- Logging every interaction, lead status, and appointment detail accurately in GoHighLevel (GHL)



PART 2 — PERSONAL ASSISTANT: DATING APP COLLABORATION & CALENDAR (about half your time):

This is collaborative, not autonomous. I stay logged into and in control of my own dating app accounts at all times — you're not messaging or swiping as me, you're advising me live while I do it.

- Join live video calls (Zoom) where we go through matches and messages together in real time — you advise on who to prioritize based on my preferences, and can suggest message wording for me to review and send myself

- Help me spot red flags or inconsistencies in profiles, and flag the matches most worth pursuing

- Once we agree a date should happen, schedule and confirm evening dinner/drink dates on my personal Google Calendar, making sure times and locations work with my schedule

- Support broader executive calendar coordination — resolving conflicts and prioritizing my appointments across GHL and Google Calendar



YOU'RE A STRONG FIT IF YOU HAVE:

- Fluent English, spoken and written — this is required

- Personal or professional experience with dating apps (Tinder, Bumble, Hinge, etc.) and genuine comfort giving real-time opinions on profiles and messages over video

- Experience with speed-to-lead response, inbound follow-up, or SMS/text-based customer engagement — Medicare or insurance experience is a plus

- Hands-on comfort with GoHighLevel (GHL) — especially the unified inbox — power dialers, Google Calendar, and Zoom

- A quiet, reliable home office setup, dependable internet, and a professional headset/webcam

- Genuine, real-time reachability for speed-to-lead calls any time between 9am–7pm PST, Monday–Friday — able to drop what you're doing and call a fresh lead within 5 minutes, up to 5 times a day. Still a 4 hrs/day, 20 hrs/week role — the timing of those hours just flexes across this window rather than sitting in one fixed block

- A warm, natural communicator (by voice AND by text) who can keep a conversation going without sounding scripted, plus good judgment and discretion with personal matters



COMPENSATION:

$4.00–$5.00 USD/hour base pay ($5/hr is the top of this range), PLUS a $10.00 USD Qualified Appointment Bonus.



A "Qualified Appointment" is a scheduled Medicare consultation the lead actually attends during — or within 90 days of — their active enrollment window (Initial Enrollment Period, Turning-65 month, or Annual Enrollment Period), i.e. a window where a valid application can actually be taken. If a lead submits a form early (5+ months before eligibility), you'll keep them warm in the SMS/GHL nurture sequence — the bonus isn't triggered by that early info call itself, it's earned once you've kept the lead engaged and get them booked when their active window opens.



TO APPLY:

Please include a 30–60 second voice intro (Vocaroo, Loom, or a phone voice memo link) so we can hear your spoken English. Applications without a working voice link will not be considered.

title: Help Wanted: Senior GoHighLevel (GHL) /Claude/ Automation
description:
Warning: This is not a role for beginners. We use a strict 15-point technical rubric to screen all applicants.



***MUST HAVE PREVIOUS EMPLOYER REVIEWS**** NO REVIEWS DONT APPLY 



Are you a true GoHighLevel master who lives and breathes workflows, snapshots, and SaaS mode? We are looking for a highly technical, strategic GoHighLevel Expert with a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience to lead our platform architecture, client onboarding, and complex automation builds.



If you know the difference between a trigger link and a custom value, understand how to build scalable snapshots, and can troubleshoot A2P 10DLC compliance in your sleep, we want you on our team.



The Role



As our Senior GHL Expert, you will be the technical backbone of our CRM and marketing automation operations. You will not just be building basic funnels; you will be architecting complex, multi-step workflows, integrating third-party tools via webhooks and APIs, and ensuring our white-labeled SaaS offering runs flawlessly for our clients.



You will take ownership of the entire GHL ecosystem, from initial sub-account setup and domain configuration to deploying advanced AI chatbots and database reactivation campaigns. We need a problem-solver who can translate business goals into seamless, automated technical solutions.



Key Responsibilities



We expect our GHL Expert to handle high-level technical execution and strategic planning. Your primary duties will include:



Platform Architecture & Snapshots: Designing, building, and maintaining master snapshots that can be deployed across dozens of client sub-accounts. You will utilize custom values, custom fields, and smart lists to ensure scalable, error-free onboarding.



Advanced Automation & Workflows: Architecting complex workflows for lead nurturing, appointment booking (round-robin and collective), missed call text-back, and automated review requests. You must be proficient in using if/else logic, wait steps, and inbound/outbound webhooks.



Technical Setup & Compliance: Managing the unglamorous but critical backend tasks. This includes configuring LC
/Mailgun, LC Phone/Twilio, domain DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and ensuring strict adherence to A2P 10DLC SMS compliance.



Funnels & Integrations: Building high-converting, two-step sales funnels and landing pages. You will also connect GHL to external platforms using Zapier, Make (Integromat), Pabbly, or native APIs to ensure data flows seamlessly between systems.



How to Apply (The 15-Point Test)



We do not want generic cover letters. To apply, you must answer this single question:



"Explain the most complex workflow or snapshot you have ever built. Include specific details about the triggers, actions, and integrations you used."



We will score your answer using our internal 15-point rubric:



•

0-5 Points for Complexity: Are you building basic auto-responders, or advanced multi-step logic with if/else conditions and round-robin routing?



•

0-5 Points for Terminology: Do you use specific GHL terms correctly (Custom Values, Inbound Webhooks, LC
), or generic marketing fluff?



•

0-5 Points for Integrations: Can you connect GHL to the outside world using Catch Hooks, JSON payloads, or native APIs?



Note: If you mention the legacy "Triggers" tab, or if you tell us you use ClickFunnels and ActiveCampaign instead of building natively in GHL, your application will be instantly rejected.



If you score a 12 or higher, we will contact you immediately for a live technical interview.



Please submit your resume and your technical answer to

You’ll work closely with Video Editors, Static Designers, and the wider performance marketing team to turn ideas into scroll-stopping creatives that drive measurable results.

Schedule: Flexible (8 hours/day)

Performance Bonus: Available for top-performing strategists

Develop creative angles, hooks, messaging frameworks, scripts, and ad concepts for DTC/eCommerce brands.

Create clear creative briefs for Video Editors, Static Designers, and UGC creators.

Stay updated on paid social trends, platform changes, competitor ads, and emerging creative formats.

Experience developing direct-response ad concepts that are designed to drive conversions.

Strong understanding of customer psychology, buyer objections, awareness levels, hooks, offers, and messaging.

Ability to interpret creative performance data and use it to improve future concepts.

Excellent written communication skills, including ad copy, hooks, scripts, and creative briefs.

Highly organized, self-motivated, and able to manage multiple projects at once.

Experience collaborating with Video Editors, Designers, UGC creators, or marketing teams.

Stable internet connection and a reliable computer.

Portfolio or examples of creative briefs, ad concepts, scripts, campaigns, or performance results.

Experience writing landing page copy,
 copy, or product messaging.

Background in copywriting, media buying, growth marketing, or brand strategy.

Experience managing or mentoring creative teams.



Application Review

Strategy Interview

Paid Creative Test

One-Month Performance Evaluation

Full-Time Offer



Important Notes

The creative test is mandatory and must be completed using original work only.
