title: Accounting Manager
description:
The Accounting Manager is responsible for managing accounting, bookkeeping, financial reporting, and advisory services for a portfolio of clients. This role oversees client engagements from planning through completion, reviews work prepared by accounting staff, ensures compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulations, and serves as a trusted advisor to clients.



The Accounting Manager also supports firm growth, manages client relationships, develops team members, and helps ensure engagements are delivered accurately, efficiently, and profitably.



Key Responsibilities

Client Accounting and Advisory Services

Manage a portfolio of clients across various industries and business sizes.

Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting and financial reporting engagements.

Review general ledger activity, journal entries, reconciliations, and adjusting entries.

Prepare and review financial statements and management reports in accordance with applicable accounting standards.

Analyze financial information and provide clients with meaningful business insights.

Assist clients with budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow analysis, and financial planning.

Advise clients on accounting policies, internal controls, process improvements, and financial procedures.

Assist with accounting system implementation, cleanup, and process optimization.

Identify and communicate accounting issues, risks, and opportunities to clients and firm leadership.

Engagement and Quality Management

Plan, schedule, and manage client engagements to meet deadlines and budgets.

Review workpapers, reconciliations, reports, and other deliverables for accuracy and completeness.

Ensure engagement work complies with firm policies, professional standards, and regulatory requirements.

Monitor engagement budgets, billing, realization, and profitability.

Coordinate with tax, audit, payroll, and advisory teams as appropriate.

Resolve complex accounting and client-service issues.

Maintain complete, organized, and well-documented client files.

Team Leadership

Supervise, train, coach, and evaluate accountants and other engagement staff.

Assign work based on team capacity, experience, and engagement requirements.

Provide timely feedback and technical guidance.

Review staff work and support professional development.

Promote consistent use of firm processes, technology, and quality-control procedures.

Client Relationship Management

Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned clients.

Build and maintain strong, long-term client relationships.

Communicate engagement status, deadlines, findings, and recommendations clearly.

Lead or participate in client meetings and presentations.

Identify additional service opportunities and collaborate with partners on business development.

Respond promptly and professionally to client questions and requests.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

[5–8] years of progressive public accounting or client accounting experience.

Previous experience supervising accounting staff or managing client engagements.

Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP or applicable local accounting standards.

Experience preparing and reviewing financial statements.

Solid understanding of general ledger accounting, reconciliations, month-end close, and financial reporting.

Proficiency with accounting software and Microsoft Excel.

Strong project management, analytical, and organizational skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to manage multiple clients and meet competing deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

CPA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent professional qualification.

Experience in a public accounting, outsourced accounting, or CAS environment.

Experience with accounting platforms such as QuickBooks Online, R365, or similar systems.

Knowledge of audit, tax, payroll, and advisory services.

Experience serving clients in industries such as professional services, construction, nonprofit, real estate, healthcare, or technology.

Experience with practice-management and workflow systems.

Strong business-development and client-advisory experience.

title: Digital Learning & Enrollment Technology Specialist
description:
Position Overview

ATTN: introductory video, your résumé, and your portfolio is required to apply for this position.



Digital Learning & Enrollment Technology 

Specialist



Position Summary



Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute is seeking a highly organized, innovative, technology-driven Digital Learning & Enrollment Technology Specialist to support the development, implementation, management, and growth of our online and hybrid educational programs.



This position will be responsible for building and maintaining high-quality courses within Kajabi, supporting Google Classroom, assisting students with technology needs, developing interactive learning experiences, supporting landing pages and enrollment funnels, organizing prospective student leads, and working closely with our team to improve enrollment conversions.



The ideal candidate is not simply someone who can upload course content. We are seeking someone who can think strategically about the entire student journey—from initial interest and landing page engagement through enrollment, onboarding, course participation, and completion.



The individual must be comfortable learning new technologies, utilizing artificial intelligence, solving technical problems, managing multiple projects, meeting strict deadlines, and proactively bringing ideas to leadership that improve our programs and the student experience.



Primary Responsibilities



Kajabi Course Development & Management



* Build, organize, launch, and maintain online courses within the Kajabi platform.

* Create course modules, lessons, categories, learning pathways, assessments, downloads, resources, videos, and other educational materials.

* Upload and properly organize videos, presentations, PDFs, worksheets, assignments, links, and supporting course materials.

* Structure courses so students can easily understand where to begin, what to complete next, and how to progress through the program.

* Create professional and visually appealing course layouts consistent with the Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute brand.

* Set up course access, student enrollment, automated communications, notifications, certificates, completion requirements, and other Kajabi features when applicable.

* Regularly review existing courses and recommend improvements.

* Test courses before launch to ensure links, videos, lessons, downloads, automations, and student access are functioning properly.

* Maintain accurate course information and make updates when curriculum or program requirements change.



Student Engagement & Interactive Learning



The Digital Learning & Enrollment Technology Specialist will be expected to continuously identify ways to make our online programs feel engaging, supportive, and interactive rather than simply providing students with videos to watch.



Responsibilities include:



* Develop creative methods for increasing student participation and course completion.

* Recommend quizzes, assessments, assignments, discussion activities, challenges, progress checkpoints, and interactive exercises.

* Develop opportunities for students to apply what they are learning.

* Assist with incorporating live sessions, recorded demonstrations, student discussions, projects, milestone celebrations, certificates, and other engagement strategies.

* Identify students who may be experiencing difficulty navigating the learning platform and assist with resolving those barriers.

* Research new educational technology and recommend tools that can improve the online learning experience.

* Help create systems that encourage students to continue progressing through their programs.

* Review student engagement patterns and recommend improvements when participation begins to decline.



Google Classroom



The candidate must have working knowledge of Google Classroom and be comfortable assisting instructors and students with the platform.



Responsibilities may include:



* Creating and organizing Google Classroom courses.

* Adding and managing students.

* Posting assignments, announcements, resources, and instructional materials.

* Organizing classwork by topics or modules.

* Assisting instructors with classroom organization.

* Helping students locate assignments and course materials.

* Troubleshooting common Google Classroom issues.

* Helping maintain consistency between Kajabi, Google Classroom, and other systems used by the school.



Student Technology Support



This position will serve as an important technology resource for students after they enroll.



The specialist must be comfortable providing patient, professional technical support to students who may have limited technology experience.



Responsibilities include:



* Assist students with accessing Kajabi, Google Classroom, online courses, and other required platforms.

* Help students understand how to log in and navigate their programs.

* Troubleshoot password, login, access, video, assignment, browser, and basic platform issues.

* Assist students with locating lessons, assignments, resources, and course requirements.

* Develop easy-to-understand technology instructions, tutorials, FAQs, and student onboarding resources.

* Help ensure newly enrolled students receive appropriate access to their programs.

* Escalate complex technical problems when necessary and follow through until an appropriate resolution is reached.

* Maintain professional and supportive communication when assisting students.



Artificial Intelligence & Technology



The candidate must have a strong working background in artificial intelligence and modern digital productivity tools.



Responsibilities include:



* Utilize AI to improve productivity, course development, student engagement, marketing, lead management, and internal processes.

* Assist with creating course outlines, educational resources, quizzes, assignments, communications, marketing materials, and other content using AI responsibly.

* Identify AI tools that may improve the school’s operations or educational delivery.

* Develop repeatable AI-assisted workflows that save the organization time.

* Remain current on emerging AI and educational technology.

* Bring new technology recommendations to leadership rather than waiting to be instructed on every improvement.

* Help the organization determine where automation can replace repetitive manual processes.



Landing Pages, Funnels & Enrollment Technology



The candidate must have experience with or strong knowledge of landing page and funnel-building platforms such as GoHighLevel, Leadpages, Kajabi, or similar systems.



Responsibilities include:



* Build and update landing pages for programs, events, courses, and enrollment campaigns.

* Assist with creating high-converting enrollment funnels.

* Ensure landing pages clearly communicate program benefits, calls to action, and next steps.

* Connect forms, landing pages, lead databases,
/SMS communications, and enrollment processes when required.

* Test funnels regularly to ensure leads are being properly captured.

* Identify broken links, missing automations, incorrect forms, or other problems that could cause the school to lose prospective students.

* Recommend improvements to landing pages and enrollment processes based on performance and student behavior.

* Work with admissions and marketing staff to continually improve the prospective student’s journey from inquiry to enrollment.



Lead Organization & Enrollment Conversion



This position will also support the organization and management of prospective student leads.



Responsibilities include:



* Organize incoming leads from landing pages, advertising campaigns, websites, forms, and other sources.

* Ensure leads are accurately entered into the appropriate lead-management system.

* Maintain accurate lead statuses and follow-up information.

* Help prevent prospective students from being lost due to poor organization or lack of follow-up.

* Assist with creating automated
 and SMS follow-up sequences.

* Work with admissions personnel to identify high-interest prospective students.

* Help track leads through the enrollment process.

* Assist with re-engagement strategies for prospective students who previously expressed interest but did not enroll.

* Help analyze where prospective students are dropping out of the enrollment process.

* Recommend improvements designed to increase the percentage of inquiries that become enrolled students.



The goal is not simply to collect leads—it is to help create an organized system that moves qualified prospective students toward enrollment.



Marketing & Program Promotion



The specialist will work collaboratively with leadership, admissions, instructors, and marketing personnel to properly promote school programs.



Responsibilities include:



* Understand the primary benefits and selling points of each assigned program.

* Assist with developing digital assets needed to promote programs.

* Ensure marketing campaigns connect to the correct landing pages and enrollment funnels.

* Coordinate course launches with the appropriate team members.

* Assist with promotional campaigns for new programs.

* Help ensure that prospective students receive consistent messaging from advertisement through enrollment.

* Provide technology and implementation support for special enrollment campaigns, webinars, virtual information sessions, open houses, and program launches.



Innovation & Continuous Improvement



We expect the person in this position to bring ideas—not simply wait for assignments.



The specialist should regularly evaluate our technology, courses, student experience, and enrollment processes and ask:



* How can we make this easier for the student?

* How can we make this more interactive?

* How can we automate this process?

* How can we improve student engagement?

* How can we improve course completion?

* How can we capture more leads?

* How can we follow up with leads more effectively?

* How can we increase enrollment conversions?

* How can AI help us accomplish this more efficiently?

* What technology should we be using that we are not currently using?



Recommendations should be practical and include a proposed method for implementation whenever possible.



Project & Time Management



Strong time-management skills are an essential requirement of this position.



The employee must:



* Manage multiple projects simultaneously.

* Maintain an organized project schedule.

* Understand project priorities and deadlines.

* Complete assignments by the assigned due date and assigned due time.

* Communicate immediately when a legitimate issue may affect a deadline.

* Avoid waiting until a deadline has passed to communicate problems.

* Provide appropriate progress updates on larger projects.

* Follow through on assignments from beginning to completion.

* Test completed projects before reporting that they are finished.

* Maintain organized digital files, folders, course assets, passwords/access information, and project documentation according to company procedures.

* Demonstrate strong attention to detail and accuracy.



Teamwork & Communication



The Digital Learning & Enrollment Technology Specialist must work effectively with leadership and other team members.



The employee will be expected to:



* Communicate professionally with students, instructors, staff, and leadership.

* Participate in planning and project meetings when requested.

* Accept constructive feedback and make requested revisions promptly.

* Collaborate with admissions and marketing teams to support enrollment goals.

* Work with instructors to transform educational materials into organized online learning experiences.

* Clearly explain technology to team members who may not have a technical background.

* Maintain confidentiality regarding student, employee, business, and proprietary information.

* Maintain a positive, solution-oriented approach when challenges occur.



Required Skills & Qualifications



Candidates should demonstrate strong knowledge or experience in several of the following areas:



* Kajabi

* Google Classroom

* Artificial intelligence and AI productivity tools

* GoHighLevel

* Leadpages

* Landing page development

* Sales and enrollment funnels

* CRM and lead-management systems

*
 and SMS automation

* Online course development

* Learning management systems

* Basic technology troubleshooting

* Student technology support

* Digital marketing

* Lead nurturing and conversion

* Google Workspace

* Online forms and digital workflows

* Project management

* Content organization

* Strong written communication

* Strong verbal communication

* Excellent attention to detail

* Strong problem-solving abilities



Preferred Experience



Preference may be given to candidates with experience working within:



* Online education

* Career schools

* Google Ads, Meta Ads

* Membership-based education

* Digital course companies

* Admissions or enrollment departments

* Digital marketing agencies

* CRM/funnel management

* Education technology



Performance Expectations



Success in this position will be evaluated based on measurable results, including:



* Courses completed accurately and on schedule.

* Projects completed by assigned deadlines.

* Quality and organization of Kajabi courses.

* Student ease of access to online programs.

* Speed and professionalism of student technology support.

* Student engagement within online programs.

* Accuracy of lead organization and management.

* Functionality of landing pages and enrollment funnels.

* Improvement of automated processes.

* Contribution to lead-to-enrollment conversion.

* Quality of new ideas presented and successfully implemented.

* Communication and collaboration with the team.

* Ability to independently identify and solve problems.



Our Expectation



Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute is continuing to expand its educational reach through online, hybrid, and technology-supported programs. This position will play an important role in helping us build the infrastructure necessary for that growth.



We are looking for someone who sees technology as more than software. Technology should make education easier to access, make students more engaged, make our team more efficient, and help more prospective students successfully move from interest to enrollment.



The right individual will be organized, creative, dependable, technology-driven, solutions-focused, and excited about helping us build educational programs that can grow and serve students at a high level.

title: Executive Assistant, Sales & Student Success Coordinator

Executive Assistant, Sales & Student Success Coordinator

Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute is seeking a highly organized, professional, articulate, dependable, and sales-minded Executive Assistant, Sales & Student Success Coordinator to work closely with the Director of the Institute.

The successful candidate must be comfortable speaking with prospective students by telephone and helping them understand both our in-person and online educational opportunities. They must also be able to confidently promote the Director’s coaching programs, schedule appointments and consultations, follow up with leads, and help turn interest into enrollment or sales.

Direct Support to the Institute Director

Responsibilities include:

The employee must be able to receive an assignment, understand the expected outcome, organize the necessary steps, and follow the assignment through to completion.



Punctuality, Responsiveness & Organization



Because this individual will work directly with the Director, promptness and reliability are non-negotiable expectations of this position.



The employee must:



* Be punctual and prepared to begin work at the scheduled time.

* Respond promptly to communications from the Director.

* Complete assignments by the assigned due date and due time.

* Maintain an organized task-management system.

* Keep accurate notes regarding assignments and follow-ups.

Telephone Communication & Professional Representation

Responsibilities include:

* Communicate confidently with prospective students.

* Conduct follow-up calls with leads.

* Explain programs accurately and enthusiastically.

* Listen carefully to prospective students’ goals and concerns.

Sales & Enrollment Support



Although this position includes executive-assistant responsibilities, sales is an important component of the role.



The employee must be comfortable discussing tuition, program value, schedules, online options, career goals, payment options, and next steps with prospective students.



Responsibilities include:

* Understand the primary benefits and selling points of each assigned program.

* Help prospective students identify programs aligned with their goals.

* Help move prospective students from inquiry ? conversation ? appointment ? application ? enrollment.



The employee should be comfortable asking for the next step and helping a qualified prospective student move forward rather than simply providing information and ending the conversation.



Coaching Program Sales & Marketing



A major responsibility of this position will be assisting the Director with the promotion and growth of coaching programs and other professional offerings.



Responsibilities include:

, text, social media, and other promotional campaigns.

 marketing platforms

title: YouTube Channel Manager - Operations Manager
description:
We are looking for an intelligent, highly reliable and proactive YouTube Channel Manager to help oversee the day-to-day operations of a growing portfolio of YouTube channels.



This is not a role for someone who simply waits for instructions.



We need someone with excellent english, strong judgment, critical thinking and attention to detail who can understand our systems, identify problems, keep team members accountable and make sensible decisions without needing constant supervision.



You should be comfortable questioning something when it does not make sense rather than blindly agreeing with it.



If a deadline is going to be missed, a video contains a mistake, a team member has forgotten something or you notice something unusual on a channel, we expect you to identify it and take action before management has to find it.



Main Responsibilities:

* Providing clear progress updates to management

* Assisting with other YouTube operations when required



## The Type of Person We Want



We care significantly more about **how you think and work** than how impressive your CV looks.



You must:



* Have excellent written and spoken English

* Have experience using YouTube Studio

* Experience using proxies is welcome 

* Have strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills

* Be extremely organised

* Have excellent attention to detail

* Be dependable and consistent

* Be comfortable managing several deadlines simultaneously

* Communicate problems rather than hiding them

* Ask questions when something genuinely does not make sense

* Be willing to respectfully challenge an instruction if you believe something has been overlooked

* Be able to prioritise important problems

* Take initiative without needing permission for every small decision

* Be capable of working independently once trained

* Be comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude

* Be willing to learn new software and online systems

* Have good availability during UK GMT/BST working hours

* Have a reliable computer and internet connection

* Be comfortable attending Zoom or Google Meet calls



Previous experience with YouTube channel management, project management software such as Asana, content scheduling, remote-team coordination or community management is highly desirable.



Previous management experience is useful but not essential.



**Good judgment, reliability and initiative are more important to us than having a management title on your CV.**



## Training



During your first week, you will work closely with me through Zoom calls and Loom training videos while learning our systems, SOPs, workflows and publishing standards.



Once trained, you will be expected to take increasing ownership of your responsibilities rather than waiting to be reminded about every task.



## Salary



The salary is **$250 per month**. This is initially a part-time position.



There is significant potential for the role to develop into a larger, higher-paid and potentially full-time operations management position as the business continues to grow.



Increased responsibilities and working hours will be reflected in future compensation.



How to Apply



Please include:

   * Project-management software

   * ChatGPT

   * Claude

   * Other AI tools



4. Tell us about a situation where you had multiple important tasks due at the same time. Explain **how you d
 what to prioritise**.

6. Tell us about a time you disagreed with a manager, client or instruction because you believed there was a better way of doing something. How did you handle it?



7. Answer the following scenario:



**It is 3 PM. A video is supposed to be published tomorrow at 6 PM. The editor has missed their deadline and has not delivered the video. The thumbnail designer has delivered a thumbnail containing a mistake. You also notice that the script for the following day's video has still not been assigned to an editor. What would you do?**

8. Your computer specifications and average internet speed.

Hiring Process

title: EXPERIENCED VIDEO EDITOR (FAST-GROWING ECOMMERCE BRAND))
description:
Role:

The Performance Ads Video Editor is the tactical engine behind our brand Enjuvie’s paid media performance. This role sits at the intersection of creative sourcing, rapid execution, and sales psychology. You turn raw UGC, AI assets, and found footage into high-converting video ads at scale.



You combine technical editing mastery with a deep understanding of direct response marketing. You understand pacing, pattern interrupts, and why an ad converts. You are not just an editor; you are a "hunter" who knows how to scour the internet for the perfect clip and use AI to create just about any Broll needed. Your job is to translate our marketing angles into world-class video ads that generate measurable revenue and allow Enjuvie to dominate the beauty feed.



Responsibilities:

- Direct Response Strategy & Execution

- Deliver 5 completely new ad concepts per week, with 3 hook variations for each concept (Total ~15 deliverables/week).

- Transform raw footage into high-performing video ads for Meta 
/Instagram), TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and YouTube In-Stream.

- Engineer "scroll-stopping" hooks and visual pattern interrupts to maximize viewer retention in the first 3 seconds, blending sourced clips with brand content.

- Collaborate with the media buying and creative teams to analyze ad performance data and iterate immediately on what is working.

- Creative Sourcing & Post-Production

- Actively source third-party clips from TikTok/YouTube/Instagram to find specific reactions, Brolls, or satisfying visual 
nts as needed.

- Handle end-to-end post-production: assembly, pacing, sound design, color correction, and motion graphics.

- Adapt editing style, structure, and pacing to platform-specific formats, audiences, and performance goals

Systems, AI, & Workflow

- Maintain an impeccable file organization system within Google Drive and 
. You ensure every asset is tracked, named correctly, and accessible to the team.

- Leverage AI tools daily to speed up production. Must be proficient with tools like Nano Banana Pro, ElevenLabs (voiceovers), and Veo3 (or similar).

- Utilize AI avatars & Broll to test new creative angles and scripts without needing new physical UGC.

- Proactively identify bottlenecks in your editing workflow and build systems to solve them.



Requirements:

English Proficiency (Written & Verbal): You must be fluent in English. You need to be able to catch subtle grammar mistakes in captions, understand the nuance of English voiceovers, and communicate complex creative ideas clearly with the team.

Proven experience specifically as a Direct Response Video Ads Editor for e-commerce, info-products, or performance marketing agencies. (Cinematic narrative experience is great, but ads experience is non-negotiable).

Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, hooks, and modern content platform dynamics. You know how to structure an ad to retain attention.

Expert understanding of YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and platform best practices.

Clear, fast communication skills and the ability to implement feedback efficiently in a high-performance environment. You don't take feedback personally; you take it as data to improve the next edit.

Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects (or DaVinci Resolve). CapCut mastery is a bonus for rapid trending content.



Results:

A consistent flow of high-converting video assets that directly contribute to ROAS (Return on Ad Spend).

Predictable output of 5 new concepts +10 variations weekly without sacrificing quality.

Seamless file management where no asset is ever lost and revisions are executed rapidly.

A high percentage of creatives that hit KPI targets and trigger performance bonuses.

A library of "winning creatives" that can be iterated upon for months.

Ongoing collaboration with the Creative Director and founder to support business objectives.



Schedule:

Monday - Friday, with the flexibility to work additional hours or weekends during high-traffic events (Black Friday, product launches, etc.) or if the situation warrants it.



Location:

- Remote



Compensation:

- Base Salary: $2,000 – $3,000 USD / Month

- The salary range may be inclusive of several levels that would be applicable to the position. Final salary will be based on a number of factors including, level, relevant prior experience, skills, and expertise.

- Performance Bonuses: $250-$500 bonus per "Winning Ad."

- This role is designed for high performers. If you produce ads that scale, your compensation increases significantly.



Haus of Brands Core Values:



- Relentless Drive

Be the person who runs toward the fire. The enjoyment of a hard challenge and the sheer grit to do "whatever it takes. Whether that means working late, missing sleep, or learning a new skill overnight. A refusal to let "lack of knowledge" be an excuse, bridging every gap through aggressive effort and self-directed evolution.



- Intellectual Honesty

The ability to separate your ego from the data. View harsh feedback not as an attack, but as objective truth required for improvement. A refusal to defend mediocrity or hide behind "good enough." If the work is flawed, we admit it immediately, fix it instantly, and never make the same error twice.



- Uncompromising Integrity

True character is revealed in the dark. Be the person who acts with absolute honesty when unobserved. The courage to speak the truth even when it is expensive or uncomfortable, and the refusal to hide failures or fudge numbers. A commitment to an ethical standard that requires zero policing.

description:

Applications sent through this site are not reviewed. To be considered, you must apply through our own form here: 
tion.site/3b70d95da57c80ec9e3ff25ac24cd60a

Hi, I'm Dr. Abrar Al-Shaer, PhD, RD, LDN: a registered dietitian nutritionist and herbalist in the United States. I run Precision Women's Care, an integrative practice where we help women get to the root of their health issues — PCOS, fertility, hormones, gut health, perimenopause — and feel like themselves again.



We're a small, close team, fully remote, and we care a great deal about the women who come to us.



Women find us, reach out, and genuinely want help — and then some of them quietly slip away because nobody followed up well enough. I'm looking for someone to own our front door: the leads, the phone, the follow-up, and the conversation that turns an interested woman into a patient.



This is a sales role, and it's also the first voice a woman hears from our practice. Both have to be true at once.



About the pay, before anything else. Your base is $7/hour, but this role is built so your income follows your results, not the clock. You earn a bonus on every patient and member you bring in, so $1,000+ a month is well within reach if you convert well. Do this properly and you should out-earn the hourly rate comfortably.



What you'll do

- Follow up quickly with every woman who reaches out, and guide her toward booking

- Have the real conversation: what we offer, what it costs, and what's holding her back

- Turn interested women into patients and members

- Keep following up with the ones who say "let me think about it" — this is where most of the value lives

- Answer and return calls on our practice phone during US hours

- Schedule patient follow-ups and make sure nothing sits unanswered



Who I'm looking for



Near-native English comes first, and it isn't negotiable. You'll be on the phone with American women talking about deeply personal things. You need to sound warm, natural, and completely at ease — able to hear hesitation in someone's voice and respond to it. Not scripted. Not stiff.



- You've actually sold something and closed it. Health, wellness, coaching, or memberships is a real plus

- You're comfortable with money. You can say a price out loud and then stay quiet

- You're warm, not pushy. Hard-closing will damage the trust our patients place in us

- You run yourself. You'll own the follow-up. Nobody will chase you

- You can work a consistent 4-hour block each weekday, on US Eastern time

- This role is open to women only. Our patients are women discussing fertility and hormones, and they've told us plainly that they're more comfortable speaking with another woman



The details

- Pay: $7/hour base, plus a bonus on every patient and member you bring in. A strong month lands around $1,000+ per month

- Hours: 20 per week to start — the same 4-hour block each weekday, US Eastern

- Growth: 4-week paid fellowship ? 3 months part-time ? full-time based on performance

- We provide: our practice phone system, Notion, and Toggl



How to apply

1. Application and voice recording: 
tion.site/3b70d95da57c80ec9e3ff25ac24cd60a.

2. Interview. A real conversation, with some role-play.

3. Fellowship. A paid 4 weeks working alongside us. That's how we both find out if this is right.



If you're wonderful on the phone and you want your work to genuinely change how a woman feels in her own body, I'd love to hear from you.



— Abrar

title: TikTok Account Executive

The TikTok Account Executive is responsible for the overall success and growth of an assigned portfolio of TikTok Shop clients. * Present actionable recommendations based on performance data.

Qualifications

Required

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

* Ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

* Self-motivated with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment.

, Asana, or similar project management platforms.

* Maintain a client retention rate of 95% or higher.

* Ensure 100% on-time delivery of client reports, campaign launches, and business reviews.

* Increase affiliate and creator participation while improving overall account performance.

* Maintain excellent client satisfaction through proactive communication and strategic partnership.

* Deliver accurate forecasting and identify new revenue opportunities for assigned brands.

title: Facebook Ads Video Editor

We're looking for an editor who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, UG-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



— WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING —



You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

nts, and social proof

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations

NOOR COMPANIES

Real Estate Development  ·  General Contracting

POSITION ANNOUNCEMENT

Executive Assistant to the CEO

Full-Time  |  Remote  |  Direct Support to the Chief Executive Officer

REPORTS TO Chief Executive Officer

EMPLOYMENT Full-time, 40 hours per week. Exclusive — the successful candidate may not hold other employment or clients.

SCHEDULE 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Central Time, Monday through Friday

Equivalent to 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Manila. Night-shift availability is mandatory.

COMPENSATION $500 – $800 USD per month, commensurate with experience

Performance review at 90 days · 13th month pay · Paid Philippine holidays

LOCATION Fully remote



  THE ORGANIZATION



Noor Companies is a real estate development and general contracting firm headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota. We develop and build affordable housing, civic institutions, healthcare facilities, libraries, and mixed-use projects, and we are among the largest woman-owned firms of our kind in the country, with more than $500 million in completed work.

Development and construction operate on immovable deadlines. Permits, inspections, closings, draw schedules, and subcontractor commitments do not wait. The Executive Assistant to the CEO works at the center of that environment.

  POSITION SUMMARY



This is a critical, high-trust position functioning as a mini chief of staff to the Chief Executive Officer. The Executive Assistant manages the CEO’s inbox, calendar, meetings, events, correspondence, and social media presence, fields inbound requests on the CEO’s behalf, and supports the analysis and reporting the CEO relies on to make decisions.

The environment is fast-paced and the priorities change throughout the day. The successful candidate operates with a pronounced sense of urgency, responds quickly, communicates continuously, and takes full ownership of every item entrusted to them. Nothing is permitted to fall through the cracks.

Prior experience as an Executive Assistant reporting directly to a busy CEO, president, or owner is required. General administrative, customer service, and virtual assistant experience does not substitute for this requirement. Applications that do not demonstrate it will not be considered.



  ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES



Calendar & Inbox Management

• Own and protect the CEO’s calendar; schedule, reschedule, and resolve conflicts proactively and defend blocks of focused work

• Manage the CEO’s
: triage daily, escalate what is urgent, draft responses for approval, and independently handle routine correspondence

• Field inbound requests directed to the CEO, determine what requires their attention, and redirect or resolve the remainder

• Set up meetings with internal staff, clients, consultants, subcontractors, lenders, and community partners, including agendas and prepared materials

• Provide a written start-of-day plan and end-of-day summary, with status updates throughout the day

Communications & Written Work

• Draft, edit, and format professional correspondence, memoranda, letters, and internal communications

• Assist in the preparation of proposals, qualifications packages, and responses to requests for proposal

• Prepare and format presentations in PowerPoint for clients, partners, lenders, and board or community meetings

• Maintain document organization and version control across active projects

Events & Meeting Coordination

• Coordinate company events, groundbreakings, ribbon cuttings, client functions, and community engagements end to end

• Manage logistics, vendor coordination, invitations, RSVPs, run-of-show, and follow-up

• Arrange business travel, itineraries, and accommodations; prepare and submit expense reports

Marketing & Social Media

• Manage the CEO’s and the company’s social media presence, including drafting, scheduling, and publishing content

• Produce simple graphics and marketing collateral using Canva or comparable design tools

• Support marketing initiatives, project announcements, award submissions, and website content updates

Analysis, Reporting & Bookkeeping Support

• Build and maintain spreadsheets, trackers, and reports supporting project timelines, budgets, vendors, and expenses

• Compile and summarize data for the CEO, identifying discrepancies and drawing attention to items that require action

• Provide bookkeeping support including invoice processing, expense coding, receipt reconciliation, and coordination with the accounting team

Human Resources & Administrative Support

• Support recruiting logistics, including scheduling interviews and coordinating candidate communications

• Assist with onboarding documentation, personnel file maintenance, and administration of company policies

• Maintain confidentiality of sensitive personnel, financial, and business information without exception

• Document standard operating procedures for recurring responsibilities

  REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Minimum three (3) years of experience as an Executive Assistant reporting directly to a CEO, president, or business owner in a fast-paced environment. This requirement is not waivable.

• Demonstrated ability to manage a demanding executive calendar and inbox independently, exercising judgment about priority and urgency without direction.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel — formulas including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIF and IF statements, pivot tables, filtering, and professional formatting. Must be able to build a tracker or report from a blank worksheet.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Word — able to produce polished, client-ready decks and professionally formatted documents.

• Strong numerical literacy — comfort working with budgets, invoices, schedules of values, and financial summaries, and the ability to identify an error in a set of numbers.

• Working knowledge of bookkeeping fundamentals — invoicing, expense coding, and reconciliation. Familiarity with QuickBooks preferred.

• Exposure to human resources administration — interview scheduling, onboarding coordination, and personnel recordkeeping.

• Marketing and social media experience — managing business accounts, drafting content, and maintaining a consistent professional voice.

• Basic graphic design capability — Canva or comparable tools, sufficient to produce clean marketing materials and simple layouts.

• Superior written English. Written work is issued under the CEO’s name and must be correct in grammar, tone, and punctuation without revision.

• Fluent, clearly articulate spoken English, suitable for daily calls and direct contact with US clients, consultants, and subcontractors.

• Reliable home office — computer with a minimum of 8GB RAM, internet service of 25 Mbps or greater, a secondary internet source, a headset, and a quiet, professional work environment.

  PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Experience supporting an executive in real estate development, construction, architecture, or a related industry

• Familiarity with Procore, Buildertrend, AppFolio, or comparable construction and property management platforms

• Experience with proposal and RFP response preparation

• Working knowledge of QuickBooks, Asana, ClickUp, Notion, Slack, or the Adobe Creative Suite

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, communications, or a related field

  CORE COMPETENCIES



• Sense of Urgency. Responds promptly and moves work forward without being prompted. Understands that in this industry a delayed response carries a cost.

• Ownership and Accountability. Assumes full responsibility for assigned matters through completion. Raises problems early rather than concealing them.

• Continuous Communication. Maintains frequent contact throughout the workday regarding completed work, obstacles, and changes in status. Silence is not acceptable in this role.

• Attention to Detail. Catches errors in dates, figures, names, and documents before they are transmitted.

• Adaptability. Adjusts to shifting priorities throughout the day without losing track of work already in progress.

• Professionalism and Discretion. Represents the CEO and the firm appropriately in all communications and safeguards confidential information absolutely.

• Sound Judgment. Determines what warrants the CEO’s attention and what does not, and knows when to ask rather than assume.

• Aptitude for Learning. Absorbs new systems and procedures quickly, takes independent notes, and does not require repeated instruction.

  APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Applicants must complete all four steps below. Adherence to instructions is evaluated as part of this application, as it is a core requirement of the position. Incomplete submissions will not be reviewed.

Step 1 — Subject Line

Use the following subject line exactly as written:

CEO EA — Chicago Skyline



Step 2 — Written Responses

Answer each of the following in the body of your message. Number your responses.

1. Name the executive you most recently supported, their title, the size of the organization, and the length of your tenure.

2. Describe the scope of your responsibility for that executive’s calendar and
. What did you handle without their involvement?

3. Describe a specific instance in which you identified a conflict, error, or missed deadline before your executive did, and the action you took.

4. Describe your experience with bookkeeping, human resources support, and marketing or social media.

5. Rate your proficiency in Excel and identify one report or tracker you have built from scratch.

6. Confirm your availability from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time, Monday through Friday, on a long-term basis.

7. Confirm that this position would be your sole employment and that you hold no other clients.

8. State your internet speed and your backup connection.

9. State your expected monthly compensation in USD.

Step 3 — Video Introduction

Record a video of two to three minutes and provide a link (Loom or Google Drive). Do not attach a video file. Appear on camera and address the following:

1. Introduce yourself and describe the executive you most recently supported.

2. Describe a workday in which priorities changed substantially, and how you managed it.

3. Read the following aloud, exactly as written:

“Good morning — the 10:15 walkthrough moved to 2:30, the permit inspector is confirmed for Thursday, and I have flagged three invoices requiring your approval today.”



Step 4 — Work Samples

Attach two samples of your work from the categories below. Remove or replace all confidential information.

• An Excel report, tracker, or budget you constructed

• A PowerPoint presentation you prepared

• Professional correspondence, a proposal section, or a memorandum you drafted for an executive

• A graphic, social media post, or marketing piece you designed

  SELECTION PROCESS



1. Application review. Complete submissions are reviewed on a rolling basis.

2. Skills assessment. A short, paid exercise consisting of one Excel task and one drafted communication.

3. Interview with the Chief Executive Officer. Thirty minutes by video.

4. Reference verification. Contact with at least one prior employer.

5. Offer and introductory period. A thirty-day paid introductory period.



Qualified applicants will be contacted within one week of submission.



Candidates should not apply if any of the following apply:

You hold other employment or clients  ·  You are unable to work the specified night-shift hours on a long-term basis  ·  You have not previously supported a CEO, president, or owner directly  ·  You are seeking part-time, project-based, or short-term work.

title: Website Designer, Copywriter & Digital Brand Builder
description:
Scope of Work



The successful freelancer will be responsible for the complete website development process.



This includes:



1. Website Strategy



Before designing the website, the freelancer should assist with determining:



Website objectives

Primary target audiences

User journeys

Website architecture

Navigation

Page hierarchy

Content categories 



2. Website Structure



The proposed website will likely include the following pages or sections.



1. Home Page: The home page should quickly communicate:



What the brand stands for

Who the content is for

The problems the brand addresses

Key areas of expertise

Featured resources

Latest insights

Newsletter subscription



The homepage should guide visitors naturally through the site rather than simply present information.



2. About page



Develop a professional About page that establishes expertise and credibility without becoming overly autobiographical.



The page should communicate:



Professional background

Organisational-development expertise

Management and leadership experience

Approach to organisational effectiveness

Philosophy regarding people, culture and management

Purpose behind the platform



The freelancer will be expected to assist with drafting and structuring this copy.



3. Resource library that can be managed by me once the site is complete. 



Resources should be:



Professionally presented

Categorised

Easy to browse

Easy to download

Mobile friendly



Where appropriate, selected resources should be used as lead magnets to encourage newsletter subscriptions. The resource structure should allow new resources to be uploaded easily in future.



4. Blog/Insights page: Create a content hub for newsletters or blog posts. 



The successful candidate will also be responsible for the website copy. 



3. Website Copywriting



The successful freelancer will be responsible for assisting with the copy across the website.



This is a critical part of the project.



I will provide:



My professional background

Existing content

Notes

Voice notes

Articles

Frameworks

Brand ideas

Existing social-media content

Examples of the tone and positioning I want



The freelancer should then transform this information into concise, professional and compelling website copy.



This may include:



Homepage copy

Headlines

Sub-headlines

Positioning statements

About-page copy

Resource-page copy

Newsletter copy

Calls to action



4. Brand & Visual Design



The freelancer should establish a professional visual identity for the website.



This should include recommendations regarding:



Typography

Colour application

Page layouts

Visual hierarchy

Buttons

Icons

Imagery

Graphic elements

Resource thumbnails

Blog imagery

Website components



Website Handover



At the end of the project, I should be able to manage the website independently.



The freelancer should therefore provide:



Full website ownership and access:



Login credentials

Domain and hosting information

Platform access

Newsletter platform access

Analytics access

Design assets

Brand assets

Any relevant source files



A short recorded handover or training session should also be provided explaining how to:



Add blog posts

Upload new resources

Edit basic page content

Change images

View newsletter subscribers

View website analytics

Update navigation where necessary

title: Real Estate Analyst
description:
NOOR COMPANIES

Real Estate Development  ·  General Contracting

POSITION ANNOUNCEMENT

Real Estate Development Analyst

Full-Time  |  Remote  |  Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer

REPORTS TO Chief Executive Officer

EMPLOYMENT Full-time, 40 hours per week. Exclusive — the successful candidate may not hold other employment or clients.

SCHEDULE 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Central Time, Monday through Friday

Equivalent to 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Manila. Night-shift availability is mandatory.

COMPENSATION Commensurate with experience

Performance review at 90 days · 13th month pay · Paid Philippine holidays

LOCATION Fully remote



  THE ORGANIZATION



Noor Companies is a real estate development and general contracting firm headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota. We develop and build affordable housing, civic institutions, healthcare facilities, libraries, and mixed-use projects, and we are among the largest woman-owned firms of our kind in the country, with more than $500 million in completed work.

Our pipeline spans market-rate and affordable housing, public and civic solicitations, and mixed-use redevelopment, financed through conventional debt and equity as well as housing tax credits, tax increment financing, and public agency programs.

  POSITION SUMMARY



The Real Estate Development Analyst supports the Chief Executive Officer across the full development lifecycle — from identifying and screening potential development sites, through underwriting and financing, entitlement, design coordination, and construction close-out.

The Analyst is responsible for the financial models that determine whether a project proceeds, the budget tracking that governs every dollar spent once it does, and the coordination and follow-up that keeps architects, engineers, consultants, lenders, and municipalities moving on schedule. This is a research-, analysis-, and follow-through-intensive position requiring precision with numbers and persistence in pursuit of information.

This position requires a technical foundation. Candidates must have education or working experience in architecture, engineering, construction, or real estate, and must be able to read and interpret architectural and civil drawings. Applications without this background will not be considered.



  ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES



Site Identification & Market Research

• Search brokerage and listing platforms — LoopNet, Crexi, CoStar, Catylist, brokerage websites, and auction platforms — daily for land and redevelopment opportunities matching the firm’s criteria

• Screen candidate sites against acquisition criteria including zoning, parcel size, utility availability, access, topography, floodplain, and known environmental conditions

• Research parcel ownership, assessed value, tax status, sale history, and legal description through county assessor, recorder, and GIS systems

• Identify off-market opportunities including surplus public land, tax-forfeited parcels, obsolete or underutilized properties, and expiring-use affordable properties

• Compile land sale comparables, rent comparables, sale comparables, absorption data, and demographic and employment data for each submarket under consideration

• Prepare one-page site screening summaries with photographs, aerials, parcel maps, zoning summary, preliminary program, and order-of-magnitude economics

• Maintain the acquisition pipeline tracker recording every site reviewed, its status, owner and broker contacts, pricing, and the reason for pursuit or rejection

Financial Modeling & Proforma Analysis

• Build and maintain development proformas from scratch in Excel, including sources and uses, hard and soft cost budgets, development schedule, absorption and lease-up assumptions, stabilized operating proforma, and monthly cash flow

• Calculate and report the return metrics governing investment decisions — untrended and trended yield on cost, internal rate of return, equity multiple, cash-on-cash return, debt service coverage ratio, and loan sizing against loan-to-cost and loan-to-value constraints

• Model the full capital stack including senior construction debt, permanent debt, tax credit equity, tax increment financing, deferred developer fee, soft and gap loans, grants, and sponsor equity

• Run sensitivity and scenario analyses across construction cost, interest rate, rent, exit capitalization rate, absorption pace, and subsidy assumptions

• Update proformas as design, cost estimates, financing terms, and program change; maintain disciplined version control and document every assumption and its source

• Reconcile proforma assumptions against contractor estimates, consultant fee proposals, and lender term sheets

• Prepare summary financial exhibits for the CEO, lenders, investors, and public agency partners

Development Budget & Expenditure Tracking

• Maintain the master development budget for every active project, tracking each line item from original budget through committed, invoiced, paid, and remaining balance

• Track every dollar of spend across all projects and reconcile against the general ledger with the accounting team

• Monitor consultant and contractor contract balances, invoice against contracted fee, and flag any invoice exceeding contracted scope

• Prepare, assemble, and track predevelopment and construction draw requests to lenders and public funders, including supporting documentation, lien waivers, and inspector approvals

• Track change orders, budget amendments, contingency usage, and cost-to-complete; report variances promptly and identify the cause

• Produce monthly budget-versus-actual variance reports for each project and a consolidated report for the CEO

• Maintain the funding draw calendar and monitor sources and uses balance throughout construction

Architect, Engineer & Consultant Coordination

• Maintain the consultant roster for each project — architect, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, landscape, geotechnical, environmental, survey, traffic, and specialty consultants — with scope, fee, contact, and contract status

• Track consultant contracts, scopes of work, fee schedules, insurance certificates, and deliverable due dates

• Maintain the design deliverables calendar across schematic design, design development, construction documents, and permit set milestones, and monitor progress against it

• Follow up persistently with architects and engineers on outstanding deliverables, drawing revisions, and responses; escalate delays to the CEO before they affect the schedule

• Log and track requests for information, submittals, design decisions, and outstanding items requiring resolution

• Organize and version-control drawing sets, specifications, reports, and studies in the project document library

• Prepare agendas for design and coordination meetings, record minutes, and distribute and track action items to closure

Entitlements & Municipal Opportunity Development

• Research zoning ordinances, comprehensive plans, overlay districts, density and height limits, parking requirements, and design standards for candidate sites

• Identify municipalities, counties, housing authorities, and economic development agencies with active development priorities, surplus land, redevelopment districts, or announced solicitations

• Set up meetings between the CEO and city planning, economic development, housing, and public works staff to identify development opportunities; prepare briefing materials in advance and track follow-up commitments after each meeting

• Monitor city council, planning commission, HRA and EDA agendas and packets for relevant items, land dispositions, and emerging opportunities

• Track entitlement milestones for each project — pre-application conference, site plan review, rezoning, variance, conditional use permit, plat approval, and public hearings

• Maintain a master calendar of submission deadlines, hearing dates, and approval expiration dates

• Research and summarize impact fees, utility connection charges, park dedication requirements, and other municipal exactions affecting project economics

Public Financing & Funding Applications

• Track application cycles and deadlines for Minnesota Housing programs including the Multifamily Consolidated Request for Proposals, 9% and 4% Housing Tax Credits, and the State Housing Tax Credit, as well as city and county funding sources

• Assemble funding application materials, exhibits, narratives, and supporting documentation, and verify completeness against agency checklists

• Analyze projects against Qualified Allocation Plan scoring criteria and identify actions that improve competitive position

• Research and summarize available incentives including tax increment financing, tax abatement, brownfield and cleanup grants, historic tax credits, New Markets Tax Credits, and energy incentives

• Maintain a consolidated funding calendar covering every source, cycle, and deadline relevant to the pipeline

• Track awarded funding through commitment, closing, and compliance milestones

Due Diligence, Reporting & Project Administration

• Maintain due diligence checklists and trackers covering title commitment and exceptions, survey, Phase I and Phase II environmental assessments, geotechnical investigation, wetland delineation, utility availability letters, and zoning verification

• Track all critical dates including purchase agreement contingency periods, option and extension deadlines, earnest money conditions, and closing dates, and provide advance notice of each

• Prepare weekly and monthly pipeline reports and project status dashboards for the CEO

• Assemble lender, investor, partner, and public agency reporting packages

• Maintain organized project files, contact directories, and the central document library across all active projects

• Document standard operating procedures and templates for recurring analytical and tracking work

  REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Minimum two (2) years of professional experience in real estate development, architecture, civil or structural engineering, construction, property development, or commercial real estate analysis.

• Educational background in architecture, engineering, real estate, construction management, finance, or a closely related discipline.

• Ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings — site plans, floor plans, elevations, and civil and utility drawings — and familiarity with the schematic design, design development, and construction document phases.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency. Must be able to construct a development proforma and cash flow model from a blank worksheet without templates or add-ins, using formulas, lookups, and logical functions accurately.

• Working command of real estate finance fundamentals — net operating income, capitalization rate, yield on cost, internal rate of return, equity multiple, debt service coverage ratio, loan-to-cost and loan-to-value, amortization, and sources and uses.

• Demonstrated research capability using brokerage and listing platforms, public property records, GIS systems, and municipal planning documents, with the ability to locate information that is not readily indexed.

• Exceptional attention to detail with numerical information. Errors in a proforma or a budget carry direct financial consequence.

• Persistent, professional follow-up. A substantial portion of this position consists of pursuing consultants, brokers, and agency staff until a response is obtained.

• Superior written English sufficient to prepare summaries, memoranda, and application narratives issued to lenders, investors, and public agencies.

• Fluent, clearly articulate spoken English for participation in calls with US architects, engineers, brokers, lenders, and municipal staff.

• Reliable home office — computer with a minimum of 8GB RAM, internet service of 25 Mbps or greater, a secondary internet source, a headset, and a quiet, professional work environment.

  PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Licensure or licensure eligibility as an architect or civil engineer

• Experience with affordable housing finance, Low-Income Housing Tax Credits, or publicly subsidized development

• Prior work supporting United States real estate projects or United States based clients

• Familiarity with CoStar, LoopNet, Crexi, or comparable commercial listing platforms

• Working knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, Bluebeam Revu, ArcGIS or QGIS, Procore, or Argus

• Experience preparing responses to requests for proposal or public solicitations

• Competence in PowerPoint and Canva for the preparation of presentation and marketing materials

  CORE COMPETENCIES



• Analytical Rigor. Works accurately with numbers, checks results, and understands what a model is actually saying rather than merely producing one.

• Persistence and Follow-Through. Pursues outstanding items to resolution. Does not accept silence from a consultant or agency as an outcome.

• Sense of Urgency. Understands that entitlement calendars, funding deadlines, and closing dates do not move, and works accordingly.

• Attention to Detail. Identifies errors in budgets, drawings, applications, and dates before they are transmitted or relied upon.

• Continuous Communication. Reports progress, obstacles, and changes in status throughout the workday without being asked.

• Ownership and Accountability. Assumes responsibility for assigned projects through completion and raises problems early.

• Sound Judgment. Distinguishes material issues from immaterial ones and knows when to escalate.

• Discretion. Safeguards confidential financial, ownership, and transaction information absolutely.

• Aptitude for Learning. Acquires unfamiliar markets, programs, regulations, and systems quickly and independently.

  APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Applicants must complete all four steps below. Adherence to instructions is evaluated as part of this application, as precision is a core requirement of the position. Incomplete submissions will not be reviewed.

Step 1 — Subject Line

Use the following subject line exactly as written:

DEV ANALYST — Cedar Bluff



Step 2 — Written Responses

Answer each of the following in the body of your message. Number your responses.

1. Describe your education and professional background in architecture, engineering, construction, or real estate, including your employer, your title, and your tenure.

2. Describe the most complex financial model or proforma you have built. What did it analyze, what were the principal assumptions, and did you build it from scratch or modify an existing template?

3. Explain, in your own words, the difference between yield on cost and internal rate of return, and why a developer examines both.

4. Describe your experience reading architectural or engineering drawings. What drawing types have you worked with, and in what capacity?

5. Describe a time you were responsible for obtaining information or a deliverable from someone who was slow to respond. What did you do?

6. Describe any experience you have with development budgets, invoice tracking, draw requests, or construction cost reporting.

7. What research platforms, property databases, or GIS systems have you used?

8. Confirm your availability from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time, Monday through Friday, on a long-term basis.

9. Confirm that this position would be your sole employment and that you hold no other clients.

10. State your internet speed and your backup connection.

11. State your expected monthly compensation in USD.

Step 3 — Video Introduction

Record a video of two to three minutes and provide a link (Loom or Google Drive). Do not attach a video file. Appear on camera and address the following:

1. Introduce yourself and summarize your technical background in architecture, engineering, construction, or real estate.

2. Walk through one project or analysis you worked on, explaining what you were responsible for.

3. Describe how you would begin researching whether a vacant parcel is a viable development site.

Step 4 — Work Samples

Attach two samples of your work from the categories below. Remove or replace all confidential information.

• A financial model, proforma, feasibility study, or cost analysis you constructed in Excel

• A market study, site analysis, or research summary you prepared

• A project budget, cost report, or tracking spreadsheet you maintained

• A drawing, rendering, site plan, or design study you produced or contributed to

  SELECTION PROCESS



1. Application review. Complete submissions are reviewed on a rolling basis.

2. Technical assessment. A paid exercise requiring construction of a simple development proforma in Excel and a brief written site analysis.

3. Interview with the Chief Executive Officer. Forty-five minutes by video, including discussion of the technical assessment.

4. Reference verification. Contact with at least one prior employer or supervising professional.

5. Offer and introductory period. A thirty-day paid introductory period.



Qualified applicants will be contacted within one week of submission.



Candidates should not apply if any of the following apply:

You hold other employment or clients  ·  You are unable to work the specified night-shift hours on a long-term basis  ·  You have no education or working experience in architecture, engineering, construction, or real estate  ·  You are unable to build a financial model in Excel without a template  ·  You are seeking part-time, project-based, or short-term work.

title: Video Editor Needed – Cut Podcast/Interview Recordings into Vertical Clips (Ongoing)
description:
I record weekly Google Meet conversations (podcast-style, two people talking) and need an editor to turn each recording into a batch of short vertical clips for Instagram.



What I need per session:



- Watch the full recording (typically 30–60 min)

- Identify every viable standalone monologue or point made by either speaker (a complete thought, story, or take that works on its own)

- Cut each one into its own clip with clean start/end points and a few seconds of lead-in for context

- Reframe each clip to vertical (9:16) — speaker should be centered/well-framed

- Basic audio cleanup (consistent levels, remove dead air if needed)

- No captions needed 

- Deliver clips in a shared folder (Google Drive or Dropbox) labeled clearly (e.g., "Speaker1_Clip1_Topic.mp4")



What I'm NOT looking for: motion graphics, intro/outro branding, music, or heavy editing — just clean clip extraction and reframing.



Volume: One ~30-60 min recording per week to start, likely producing 8-15 clips per session depending on how much good material there is.



Turnaround: 48-72 hours from when I send the raw file.



To apply, please include:



- A link to 2-3 examples of similar podcast/interview clipping work you've done

- Your rate - per video/session flat rate preferred, but open to hourly

- How you typically turn around a 30-60 min recording

title: GoHighLevel Automation Specialist — Build the System That Books Our Calls (UK Client, Long-Term)
description:
We're a UK mentoring business for construction company owners. Our GoHighLevel account is a mess and it's costing us money.



That's the honest version. Here's the detail.



We have several thousand leads sitting in GHL — mostly from
 lead ads — and almost nothing is being done with them. There's no confirmation sequence before a discovery call, so people book and don't show up. There's no structured follow-up after the call, so people who were genuinely interested drift away and go quiet. There's no long-term nurture at all. We know we're losing clients who would have signed up eventually, and we know exactly why.



We're hiring one person to fix that and then run it. This is a builder role, not an assistant role. You'll be the owner of our CRM.



What you'll actually do



Own our GoHighLevel account: workflows, pipelines, calendars, tags, custom fields, reporting

Build the pre-call sequence that gets booked discovery calls to actually happen — confirmation, reminders, one-click reschedule, no-show recovery

Build the post-call follow-up that turns "not right now" into a client three months later

Segment and reactivate our existing database with proper campaigns

Set up a LinkedIn lead-capture and follow-up system (our founder posts; you build the machine behind it)

Send one weekly report: leads in, calls booked, calls held, show rate, conversions



You need



Real GoHighLevel experience — workflows with conditional logic and branching, not just contact management

title: Experienced QBO Bookkeeper (PST Hours)
description:
We are a Canadian cloud-accounting firm specializing in bookkeeping, payroll, fractional CFO, and fractional controllership services.



We are looking for an experienced Bookkeeper to join our team. This is a full-time remote position with a fixed monthly salary, averaging 40 hours per week. Hours WILL fluctuate week to week based on client needs and where we are in the month, busier during peak periods such as the beginning of the month and lighter at other times. Candidates should be comfortable with this ebb and flow, and with the workload evening out to full-time over the course of the month.



As a fully remote and growing firm in a startup environment, we foster a collaborative and flexible workplace, offering opportunities to take on new challenges, improve processes, and grow with us.



As a Bookkeeper, you will manage financial records for multiple clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with accounting standards. This role requires strong attention to detail, high ownership, the ability to work independently, and excellent communication skills.



This is a multi-client role. You'll be juggling several client files at once, each with its own deadlines, quirks, and priorities. We need someone who is genuinely comfortable with that, not just tolerating it, but able to stay organized when priorities shift or deadlines tighten.





DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES



• Maintain accurate client financial records, including bank and credit card reconciliations, GL entries, and receipts

Reconcile monthly client schedules and ensure tasks are completed on time and accurately



• Actively review client books, not just process transactions. We need someone who looks at the numbers, notices when something doesn't add up, and understands why, not someone who enters data and moves on.



• Proactively flag and triage issues. Once you're fully onboarded and trained, we expect you to identify discrepancies or red flags on your own, assess how urgent they are, and raise them appropriately without needing to be asked.



• Resolve discrepancies and provide timely client support



• Assist with month-end and year-end reporting and workpaper preparation



• Manage increased workload during month-end close periods (for example, the 1st to 18th of the month will be the busiest, closing out the prior month)





QUALIFICATIONS



• 3+ years of North American bookkeeping experience, with a solid understanding of general ledger accounting and full-cycle bookkeeping

• Philippine CPA designation is preferred but not required

• Proficiency in QuickBooks Online is required (not just familiarity). You should be comfortable working in QBO daily across multiple client files, along with strong Excel skills

• Experience working with multiple clients in an accounting firm is strongly preferred

• High ownership and agency. You take responsibility for your files, don't wait to be told what to do next, and follow through without needing reminders

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines across several clients simultaneously

• Responsive communication. We expect a response within the same business day on client and internal matters

• Analytical and critical thinking abilities to solve problems efficiently

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently while meeting multiple deadlines

• A commitment to exceptional customer service, with previous client-facing experience

• Previously have worked for an accountant or in a firm environment is preferred, not required.





LOCATION & HOME OFFICE REQUIREMENTS

• Our business are are 9 AM - 5 PM PST.  You are expected to work at 4 hours in a day that is within our business hours PST.

• This role is fully remote, allowing you to work from the comfort of your home.

• Reliable high-speed internet (50 Mbps minimum)

• Quiet workspace suitable for client calls and focused work.

• A modern laptop or desktop capable of running QuickBooks Online, spreadsheets, and video calls.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Attention to Detail: Accuracy and precision are ESSENTIAL

• Ownership & Agency: We're looking for someone who treats client files as their own, works consistently across the month • rather than in bursts, and doesn't need to be chased for updates

• Clear Thinking & Communication: The ability to explain issues, ask the right questions, respond promptly, and document work clearly is crucial

• Willingness to Learn: We look for people who are eager to grow, learn new tools, and take on new challenges

• Reliability & Follow-Through: We seek individuals who take responsibility for their work, meet deadlines, and follow through consistently

• Curiosity & Problem-Solving: Asking thoughtful questions, exploring discrepancies, and seeking better ways to complete tasks is important. Once trained, you should be able to spot and triage issues on your own, without waiting for direction





WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

• We're intentional about building a team of A-players: people with a strong desire to learn, grow, and level up their skillset

• You'll be supported by leadership who genuinely want to see you succeed and are fully invested in your professional development at the firm

• A collaborative and transparent team culture where questions are encouraged and support is always available

• A stable, permanent role with predictable workflows and steady client files





HOW TO APPLY



1. Submit your resume and a Loom video (2–4 minutes) using a URL link. Generic or template videos will not be accepted. Your video should specifically address:



a. A quick introduction

b. What you like doing in your spare time (hobbies, interests, etc.)

c. What made you apply for this role specifically



2. Video Interview with Management team to assess experience and skills
