title: Bookkeeper / Profit Tracker — E-commerce (Remote)
description:
Part-Time Bookkeeper / Profit Tracker — E-commerce (Remote)

Location: Remote

Type: Part-time · Flexible hours · Ongoing

Compensation $500



About us



We're a growing direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand running paid advertising across multiple markets. We move fast and spend daily on ads and inventory, so we need someone who can keep a clear, accurate, up-to-date picture of the money — what's coming in, what's going out, and what we're actually keeping.



The role



We're looking for a detail-oriented, reliable person to own our day-to-day financial tracking. You'll keep our expenses organised, track our real daily profit, and give us clear regular reports so we always know exactly where the business stands. This isn't strategy or forecasting — it's accurate, consistent tracking and reporting we can trust.



What you'll do



Track daily revenue, ad spend, cost of goods, shipping, fees, and other expenses

Calculate true daily and weekly profit (accrual-based — matching costs to the day of sale, not just when cash lands)

Keep a clean, organised record of all business expenses

Produce clear, consistent reports — daily snapshots and a weekly summary — in a format we agree on

Flag anything unusual: unexpected cost spikes, margin drops, discrepancies

Reconcile figures across our sales platform, ad accounts, and payment processors

Keep everything accurate and up to date without needing to be chased



What we're looking for



Experience with bookkeeping, financial tracking, or e-commerce accounting

Comfortable working with Shopify, Meta/Google ad spend data, and spreadsheets (or tools like TripleWhale)

Strong attention to detail — the numbers have to be right

Understands the difference between cash-basis and accrual-basis profit, and why payout timing isn't the same as profit

Self-directed and dependable — delivers reports on schedule without reminders

Clear communicator who can present numbers simply

Discreet and trustworthy with sensitive financial information



Nice to have



Experience with DTC / paid-ads businesses specifically

Familiarity with profit-tracking tools (TripleWhale, Lifetimely, BeProfit, or similar)

Understanding of COGS, contribution margin, and blended vs true profit



Hours & commitment



Part-time and flexible — this is a recurring role (likely [X hours/week] or a set daily/weekly reporting rhythm). Long-term, with room to grow as the business does.



To apply



Send a short note about your relevant experience, what tools you've used for e-commerce financial tracking, and your availability and rate. If you've done daily profit tracking for a DTC brand before, tell us about it — that's exactly what we need.



A few things to fill in or d
 before you post:



Rate/hours — I left placeholders. D
 whether it's hourly or a monthly retainer, and roughly how many hours (daily profit tracking for a single DTC brand is usually a few hours a day or a focused daily check-in — not a lot, but daily).



How much you want to reveal — I kept the brand unnamed and markets vague, consistent with how you've done other posts. Good for filtering before disclosing specifics.



Scope boundary — I deliberately framed it as tracking and reporting, not strategy/forecasting, so you attract a reliable numbers person rather than someone expecting to advise on the business. If you actually want someone more advisory (cash-flow planning, the credit-terms stuff we discussed), tell me and I'll widen it.

title: Technical SEO / Google Indexing Specialist
description:
# Technical SEO / Google Indexing Specialist



I run an established local service website in New Zealand that already ranks in Google, receives good organic traffic and generates real customers.



I have one specific problem that I need help solving.



A significant number of genuine pages on the website are sitting in Google Search Console as:



* **Discovered – currently not indexed**

* **Crawled – currently not indexed**



Many other pages on the same website are indexed and ranking normally.



We've already investigated some of the affected pages. Google can access them, crawling and indexing are allowed, they're included in the sitemap, canonical URLs are correct and Google can successfully render them.



**I want to understand why Google isn't indexing more of these pages and what we can realistically do about it.**



## What I'm NOT looking for



I'm not looking for:



* More blog posts — I already have plenty.

* A generic automated SEO audit.

* A backlink package.

* Someone to rewrite all my meta descriptions.

* Someone promising #1 Google rankings.

* Someone who simply tells me I need "better SEO."



And initially, **you will not be making changes to the website.**



I want someone who can investigate first.



## Paid trial – US$60



I will select a small number of applicants for a **US$60 paid technical trial**.



The trial will involve up to approximately **3 hours investigating the indexing problem**.



I will provide more detailed information and relevant Google Search Console data to the selected applicants.



I want you to tell me:



1. What you think is happening.

2. What evidence supports your conclusion.

3. What is fact and what is still only a theory.

4. What you would test first.

5. How we would measure whether that test worked.



You do **not** need to pretend you know the answer before investigating it.



If you don't know something, tell me.



I'd much rather work with someone who says **“I don't know yet, but here's how I'll find out”** than somebody who confidently gives me an answer they can't support.



## What I'm looking for



You should have genuine hands-on experience with:



* Google Search Console

* Google crawling and indexing

* Technical SEO

* WordPress / WooCommerce

* Sitemaps and site structure

* Diagnosing indexing problems



I'm much more interested in **what you can actually do** than certificates or qualifications.



### When applying, please answer this question:



**Tell me about ONE real Google indexing problem that you personally investigated. What was happening, what did you discover was causing it, and how did you work that out?**



Please answer that question in your own words.



I don't need a long list of SEO services you provide.



## Longer-term opportunity



This trial is also about finding the right person for possible **ongoing permanent part-time work**.



If you're technically capable, reliable, honest about what you do and don't know, and we work well together, I'd like to have someone who can learn the website over time and help me with its technical SEO.



The ongoing hours and rate would be discussed separately if we d
 to work together.



I'm not looking for someone to blindly run my website.



I'm looking for someone who can **investigate, explain, test and measure.

Your job is simple:



CALL LEADS ? CREATE INTEREST ? BOOK APPOINTMENTS



We provide the leads. You do NOT need to find or purchase leads.



Many of the people you contact already have life insurance. Your goal is to create interest in speaking with our licensed agent about their current coverage and whether other available options may be a better fit for them.



The licensed agent's primary appointment availability is:



Monday–Thursday | 2:00 PM – 8:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time 



Your main objective is to consistently fill these available appointment slots with qualified prospects.



RESPONSIBILITIES

Make outbound calls to leads we provide.

Speak confidently and professionally with U.S. consumers.

Generate interest in having their existing life insurance coverage reviewed and compared with available options.

Handle basic objections and keep the conversation moving toward an appointment.

Schedule interested prospects directly onto the agent's calendar.

Focus on filling appointment availability between 2:00 PM and 8:00 PM Eastern Time.

Follow all provided calling, opt-out, and Do Not Call procedures.

IMPORTANT



You are an appointment setter — NOT an insurance salesperson.



You will NOT sell insurance, recommend specific policies, quote premiums, take applications, advise someone to cancel or replace their existing policy, or provide insurance advice.



Your responsibility ends after generating interest and scheduling the prospect with the licensed agent.



The licensed agent handles the actual insurance consultation, recommendations, and sale.



WHO WE WANT



We are looking for someone who:



Has previous outbound cold-calling or appointment-setting experience.

Has excellent spoken English.

Is comfortable calling U.S. consumers.

Sounds confident, friendly, and natural on the phone.

Is comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.

Can handle rejection and basic objections.

Can follow a script without sounding robotic.

Is motivated by performance and wants to book appointments.

Has reliable internet, a computer, and a quiet working environment.

Is dependable and communicates well.



Previous U.S. cold-calling experience is strongly preferred.



Life insurance experience is a PLUS, but it is NOT required. 



COMPENSATION



$6 USD/hour guaranteed base pay.



Additional performance-based bonuses may be awarded for consistently generating high-quality appointments that show up and produce strong results.



Strong performers will have opportunities to earn additional compensation and potentially receive additional hours.



PERFORMANCE WE TRACK



We will track:



Number of outbound calls

Number of conversations

Appointments booked

Appointment show rate

Quality of appointments



HOW TO APPLY



Please include ALL of the following:



Your previous cold-calling/appointment-setting experience.

Industries you have previously called for.

Approximately how many outbound calls you made per day.

Your normal working availability in U.S. Eastern Time.

A short voice recording introducing yourself and describing your cold-calling experience.



Applications without a voice recording may not be considered.



We provide the leads, calling guidelines, script, and appointment calendar.



We are looking for someone who can become a reliable long-term member of our team if the initial trial goes well.

Overview

We are a growing Canadian construction and service company looking for someone who wants more than a traditional accounting role.



We're looking for a reliable, proactive, and highly organized professional who can take ownership of our finance and administrative operations. This person will play a key role in helping leadership make informed decisions, maintain healthy cash flow, and ensure the business runs smoothly behind the scenes.

Their:



Problems

Desires

Fears

Frustrations

Beliefs

Previous solutions

Objections

Awareness level

Language

Buying motivations

In your application:



Explain what an avatar means to you and give us an example of how you would research one before creating an advertisement.



Tell Us How You Research



This is extremely important.



Before creating a static ad, how do you figure out what the market actually cares about?



Tell us your actual research process.

Customer reviews

Reddit

Amazon

Competitor advertisements

Meta Ad Library

Forums

Product reviews

Scientific research

Search data

Customer comments

Existing advertorials

Competitor funnels



We want to understand how you arrive at a creative idea, not just how you execute somebody else's idea.



Long-Form Native Statics



You must understand long-form static advertising.



We're not only looking for:



Product + headline + button



We want someone capable of creating native-looking, information-heavy static advertisements that can communicate a story or argument visually.



For example:



Long-form advertorial-style statics

Educational advertisements

Mechanism-based advertisements

Problem/solution creatives

"News/article" style creatives

Doctor/expert-style educational creatives

Customer story creatives

Comparison creatives

Infographic-style advertisements

Native-looking editorial creatives



You need to understand how to make a lot of information visually digestible without making the creative look like garbage.



You Understand Direct Response



You don't need to be a copywriter.



But you must understand direct-response advertising.



You should understand concepts such as:



Awareness levels

Market sophistication

Customer objections

Mechanisms

Angles

Hooks

Benefits vs features

Social proof

Curiosity

Pattern interruption

Problem agitation

Belief building

Offer communication



Most importantly, you should understand that different angles require different visual executions.



We Want A Marketer, Not Just A Designer



If we give you:



Product + Avatar + Angle + Mechanism



you should be able to take that information and develop the visual concept yourself.



We don't want to explain every pixel.



We want someone who can say:



"I understand the customer. Here's how I would communicate this idea visually."



And then execute it at a very high level.



Your Portfolio



Don't send us a massive portfolio of random graphic design work.



Show us your best-performing ecommerce advertisements.



Especially:



Supplement / health creatives.



For each relevant example, tell us:



Product

Target avatar

Angle

Creative concept

Your role

Platform

Results, if available



If you have winning creatives, show us the winners.



APPLICATION — YOU MUST ANSWER THESE

1. What supplement/health brands have you worked with?



Give us the brand names and explain what you personally created.



2. What does "avatar" mean to you?



Explain it in your own words.



3. How do you research an avatar before creating an advertisement?



Give us your actual process.



4. How do you research new creative angles?



Where do you look?



5. What is a long-form native static ad?



Explain how you would approach designing one.



6. Show us 3 long-form/native static advertisements you've created.



Preferably for health or supplements.



7. Pick one of your advertisements that performed very well.



Why do you think it worked?



8. How would you visually approach the same supplement for three different avatars?



Give us an example.



9. How do you d
 whether an advertisement should look:

Native/editorial

Premium/branded

Educational

UGC-inspired

Direct-response

Clinical/expert

Problem-focused



Explain your thinking.



10. What tools do you use?



Photoshop, Figma, Illustrator, AI tools, etc.



The Ideal Candidate



We're looking for someone who is:



Designer + Marketer + Creative Strategist



You should have:



? Strong professional graphic design skills

? Supplement/health ecommerce experience

? Strong understanding of avatars

? Strong research skills

? Direct-response knowledge

? Experience creating static Meta ads

? Experience with long-form/native statics

? Ability to develop concepts independently

? Ability to understand mechanisms and angles

? Strong visual storytelling

? Understanding of ecommerce funnels



NOT WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



? Canva template designers

? Social media graphic designers

? Logo/branding-only designers

? Generalist designers with no ecommerce experience

? People who have never worked with supplements

? Designers who need every concept handed to them

? People who only make aesthetically pleasing creatives without understanding conversion



If you cannot answer the questions above, please don't apply.



We're looking for someone who can think commercially, understand the customer and then turn that understanding into high-level creative.

title: SENIOR EDITOR - ECOMMERCE VIDEO ADS AND VSL  ( AI EXPERTISE REQUIRED )

About Us



NOVA Digestive is a luxury wellness company dedicated to modern digestive health through ancient herbal rituals.

Our creative direction is rooted in:



raw nature

dark, minimal, cinematic visuals

emotional storytelling

ritual-driven branding

AI Capabilities

? Know how to generate seamless b-roll

Bonus Skills



Experience in wellness, beauty, skincare, supplements

Experience building brand identity systems

Experience directing UGC creators

Knowledge of behavioral psychology in advertising



???? What We Offer



Long-term position

Full creative freedom within brand identity

Access to paid AI tools

A brand with MASSIVE potential

A chance to create ads that reach millions



How to Apply



Send the following to us:



Your portfolio — ONLY Meta/TikTok ads + static ads (not random edits)

Your experience with AI tools (with examples)

title: [HIRING] Google Ads Specialist – Lead Generation & Conversion Tracking | Remote | $7–10/hour
description:
I’m looking for an experienced Google Ads Specialist to join my agency as a long-term freelancer.



We primarily work with lead generation businesses, and I’m looking for someone who is genuinely strong in both Google Ads and conversion tracking.



This is not an agency-to-agency position. I’m looking for one individual freelancer who will personally handle the work. No teams, no outsourcing, and no subcontracting.



The role

You’ll initially work around 15 hours per week and start by helping manage approximately 5 client accounts.



If things work well and you consistently deliver good work, I’ll gradually give you responsibility for more accounts. My intention is to eventually turn this into a full-time position for the right person after a couple of weeks



You’ll work entirely behind the scenes and report directly to me. You will not communicate with clients.



What I’m looking for

You should be highly experienced with:



Google Ads management and optimization



Lead generation campaigns



Google Ads Conversion Tracking



Implementing and troubleshooting tracking directly on client websites



Analyzing account performance and identifying opportunities/problems



Working with real conversion and lead data rather than simply optimizing for clicks or traffic



Experience working with European clients/markets is highly preferred.



Tracking is especially important to me. I spend a significant amount of time making sure our conversion tracking is accurate, so I need someone who is comfortable implementing, testing and troubleshooting Google Ads conversion tracking independently.



How we’ll work

I have my own philosophy and processes for how I manage Google Ads accounts.



I don’t expect you to know my exact approach from day one. You’ll gradually learn how I structure and optimize campaigns.



You should already be capable of independently analyzing an account and identifying what should be changed. However, especially in the beginning, I expect you to report your findings and proposed changes to me before making significant changes to client accounts.



As trust builds and you understand how I work, you’ll naturally receive more responsibility.



Case studies are important

Please don’t just send me a message saying:



“I have 5 years of Google Ads experience.”



I care much more about what you’ve actually achieved.

Requirements

Individual freelancer — no agencies or teams



Strong Google Ads knowledge



Strong lead generation experience



Strong Google Ads Conversion Tracking skills



Able to implement tracking on websites independently



Previous experience with European clients is preferred



Able to work around Swedish business hours - 8am to 4pm



Comfortable starting part-time at approximately 15 hours/week for 2 weeks then move to 40 hours



Interested in moving into a full-time role



$7–10 USD/hour, depending on experience



If that sounds like you, send me a message with a short introduction and your best Google Ads case studies/results.

title: B2B Sales Development Representative
description:
U.S. Cold Calling, Prospect Research & List Building



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Business Hours



Helpline Software is looking for an unusually strong B2B Sales Development Representative who can find the right prospects, research them intelligently, and cold call them confidently.



This is not a scripted telemarketing job.



This is not a role where someone gives you 200 phone numbers and asks you to dial through them.



You will learn our Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs), use tools such as Apollo, LinkedIn, company websites, Google, and other research sources to identify good accounts and decision-makers, find workable phone numbers, and then call those prospects yourself.



Your job is to create qualified sales conversations, learn from the market, and continuously improve who we target and how we approach them.



We are looking for someone who wants substantial ownership and a long-term role.



What You Will Own



You will be responsible for the complete outbound prospecting loop:



Understand the ICP ? find accounts ? research them ? identify the right people ? find phone numbers ? cold call ? qualify ? document ? learn ? improve the next list.



Your responsibilities will include:



Build your own high-quality cold-call lists based on our ICP criteria

Research companies to determine whether they are genuinely worth contacting

Use Apollo, LinkedIn, Google, company websites, directories, and other tools to identify prospects

Find accurate direct dials, mobile numbers, company numbers, branch numbers, or other useful ways to reach the right person

Identify likely decision-makers such as Operations leaders, Customer Service leaders, executives, and other relevant roles

Spend most of the core U.S. business-hours overlap actively cold calling carefully selected prospects

Open conversations naturally and explain why you are calling

Ask thoughtful discovery questions to understand the prospect's current process

Identify pain, urgency, decision ownership, and ICP fit

Handle resistance without becoming aggressive, defensive, or robotic

Record accurate call notes, objections, qualification information, and follow-up steps in our CRM

Review your own call recordings and improve through coaching and repetition

Notice patterns in the market and recommend improvements to targeting and messaging



We do not want someone who says:



"Apollo didn't have a phone number, so I couldn't call them."



We want someone resourceful enough to find another sensible way to reach the organization.



About Helpline Software



Helpline Software provides mission-critical software for organizations operating 24/7 hotlines, emergency lines, and after-hours support systems.



Our software helps organizations route calls to the correct on-call responder based on the live schedule, escalate when someone does not answer, and give management visibility into what happened.



Our customers include organizations operating services where a missed call can have serious consequences.



We already support paying customers across the United States and are expanding into additional markets where reliable after-hours communication matters.



Compensation



Base salary: $1,000–$1,333 USD per month, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



Target total compensation after ramp: approximately $1,417–$1,833 USD per month.



Variable compensation is based primarily on:



Qualified held meetings

Call quality

Accurate qualification

Reliable execution

Good prospect selection

Follow-up quality

Continuous improvement



We do not reward people simply for maximizing dial counts or putting unqualified meetings onto the calendar.



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote role.



The core calling window is:



8:30 a.m.–2:30 p.m. U.S. Central Time



For candidates in the Philippines, this is generally:



9:30 p.m.–3:30 a.m. Philippine Time while U.S. daylight saving time is in effect

10:30 p.m.–4:30 a.m. Philippine Time during U.S. standard time



Most of this six-hour window is active calling.



Prospect research, list building, preparation, CRM work, follow-up, and call review happen around the core calling block.



You must be able to work this schedule consistently.



Requirements



You should apply only if most of the following describe you:



You have at least 3 years of meaningful experience cold calling U.S. B2B prospects.

Your spoken English is excellent and immediately understandable to U.S. business buyers over the phone.

You sound natural, credible, confident, and conversational—not rushed, robotic, or overly salesy.

You have experience finding your own prospects, not only calling lists prepared by someone else.

You can research companies and decide which accounts are genuinely worth calling.

You have used tools such as Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, RocketReach, Lusha, Clay, or similar prospecting/data tools.

You are comfortable using online research to identify decision-makers and find ways to contact them.

You listen carefully and ask intelligent follow-up questions rather than racing through a script.

You take ownership of your calls, research, follow-up, CRM notes, commitments, and working hours.

You are highly coachable and willing to review recordings of your own calls.

You can receive direct feedback, change your approach, and demonstrate improvement quickly.

You remain composed when prospects are busy, skeptical, dismissive, or difficult to reach.

You are resourceful. When one approach fails, you intelligently try another.

You are honest. We have zero tolerance for fabricated activity, misleading prospects, fake research, or dishonest reporting.

What Success Looks Like



We are a quantitative team.



We track things such as:



Meaningful conversations

Qualified opportunities

Held meetings

Qualification accuracy

Account quality

Prospecting quality

Follow-up completion

CRM accuracy

Call quality

Objection patterns

Improvement over time



Raw dial volume matters, but it is not the goal.



High-quality conversations delivered consistently are the goal.



Growth Opportunity



You will initially spend much of your time executing: researching prospects, building lists, making calls, following up, and learning our markets.



If you perform well, we want you to become increasingly independent.



Over time, you may take greater ownership of:



ICP refinement

Account selection

Prospecting strategy

Talk tracks

Qualification standards

Outbound experiments

Coaching additional callers

Sales development performance



There is significant room to grow with the company.



How We Hire



We do not hire based on interviews alone.



Strong candidates should expect to:



Submit a short unedited voice recording so we can evaluate spoken English and communication

Walk us through previous cold-calling work they personally owned

Explain how they built or researched prospect lists

Complete a live cold-call role-play

Repeat part of the exercise after receiving feedback so we can evaluate coachability

Share prior cold-call recordings when available, with confidential information removed

Complete a short paid work sample or trial before a long-term offer when appropriate



We care much more about evidence of work you personally performed than impressive-sounding claims.



Culture



We want someone who could work with us for many years.



That requires both high standards and a healthy working relationship.



We give regular, direct feedback.

You are encouraged to give us feedback as well.

We expect people to honor their commitments.

We value independent thinking and intellectual honesty.

We want people who admit when something did not work and learn from it.

You will receive regular written and verbal performance feedback.

Strong performance leads to greater responsibility and autonomy.

Final Application Instruction



Please read this carefully.



Do not send us a generic cover letter.

title: Remote Accountant / Bookkeeper - Canadian Multi-Entity (QuickBooks Online + GST)
description:
READ THIS FIRST.

Your application must open with these two lines. Anything that doesn't gets deleted unread.



Line 1 - A dental practice in British Columbia is GST registered. It pays $2,400.00 plus $120.00 GST for clinical supplies. Is that $120.00 recoverable as an input tax credit? Yes or no, and one sentence why.



Line 2 - One thing you would need to ask me before you could answer Line 1 properly.



THE ROLE

I own a group of dental practices and related operating companies in British Columbia and Alberta, plus a holding company that owns a building. The books live in QuickBooks Online, one file per entity. I need one person to own all of it.



Day to day:

- Bank and credit card reconciliations across several entities

- Accounts payable - coding, bill entry, payment preparation

- Intercompany transactions between the operating companies and the holding company

- GST tracking and return preparation

- Month-end close, plus a short written summary I can actually read

- Chasing down what doesn't make sense instead of forcing it to balance



WHAT I ACTUALLY NEED

This is an operations accounting role, not data entry. I don't want to hand you a task list every morning. I want someone who notices an account looks wrong, investigates it, and comes back to me with a question and a recommendation.



REQUIREMENTS

- Real experience on Canadian books - GST, CRA remittances, provincial sales tax

- QuickBooks Online across multiple companies

- Full time, long term

- Enough overlap with Pacific time to have a conversation most days

- Written English good enough that your month-end summary needs no editing from me



NICE TO HAVE

- CPA or equivalent

- Dental, medical, or other health care clients

- Sage experience

- Books for a practice being acquired - opening balances, purchase price allocation



CONFIDENTIALITY

We operate healthcare-related businesses. You will not handle patient care or patient records, but professionalism and privacy are non-negotiable.



HOW HIRING WORKS

Applications that follow the instruction get read. Shortlisted people get a 25-minute unpaid exercise on fictional numbers - GST coding, a bank reconciliation, and an intercompany entry. Do well and we talk.



Don't send me a generic cover letter. I've read two hundred of them.

title: Litigation Paralegal
description:
Texas-based plaintiff-side personal injury firm seeking an experienced Litigation Paralegal. This is a fully remote position for a candidate who can independently manage a case from the moment a lawsuit is filed through trial preparation, with no training period required.



What We're Looking For



We are hiring specifically for post-filing litigation work — from petition through trial. This is not a pre-suit or intake-focused role, and we are not seeking anyone who needs to be trained on the fundamentals of personal injury litigation.



Minimum Qualifications



At least 3 years of demonstrated plaintiff-side personal injury litigation experience

Working knowledge of litigation from petition through trial

Working knowledge of Texas civil procedure and Texas law as it applies to personal injury litigation

Direct, hands-on experience with case management software

Experience managing a high-volume active caseload of filed litigation matters



Duties and Responsibilities



Draft original petitions and initiate new lawsuits

Draft and file amended petitions

Draft discovery requests, including interrogatories, requests for production, and requests for admission

Draft responses to discovery requests received from opposing counsel

Complete Defendant's Written Discovery Questionnaires (DWQs)

Identify appropriate expert witnesses for each case

Prepare and file designation of experts

Prepare initial disclosures

Prepare for and coordinate depositions, including scheduling, exhibit preparation, and logistics with opposing counsel, court reporters, and clients

Track and manage all case deadlines

Communicate directly with clients, opposing counsel, and insurance adjusters as needed



Schedule



This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be resourceful and capable of ensuring physical tasks get done even while working remotely — for example, coordinating with in-office staff to have documents printed, organized, or delivered, or arranging third-party legal support services to handle physical trial preparation, exhibit production, or courier needs. The ability to problem-solve and make these things happen without being physically present is essential. Candidates must be available and reachable approximately 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday. Some scheduling flexibility is available for the right candidate.



International applicants: this schedule is fixed to Central Time (United States), not your local time zone. If you are located in the Philippines, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time falls at approximately 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. Philippine time, meaning this would be an overnight shift for you. Please confirm you understand this before applying and that you are able and willing to work these hours on your local clock.



Compensation



Salary is commensurate with experience. Please include your minimum compensation requirement with your application.



To Apply



Please include the following with your application:



Number of years of plaintiff-side litigation experience?



Confirmation that you can independently handle litigation work from petition through trial preparation.



Your typical caseload volume and whether managed solo or as part of a team?



Your minimum hourly rate or salary requirement?



Confirmation that you are able to begin work without a training period?



A description of a time you had to ensure a physical task (printing, filing, document delivery, etc.) got completed without being on-site, and how you made it happen?



Confirmation that you are able to work 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday. If you are applying from outside the United States, please confirm you understand what this means in your local time zone and that you are able and willing to work those hours.

title: Content Editor & Strategist
description:
Content Editor & Strategist 



JOB TITLE: Content Editor & Strategist 



TYPE: Full time, remote, long term



HOURS: 40 hours per week, with some overlap with New York hours



SALARY: $800 to $1,100/month depending on experience



Read the whole post. There's an application instruction at the bottom and I skip anyone who misses it.



WHO WE ARE



A family-owned jeweler in New York City's Diamond District. Diamonds, engagement rings, and luxury watches, made in our own shop.



The footage is good and it's the kind most brands can't get. A real workshop, a real trading floor, and customers having the biggest day of their life on camera. Right now I shoot and edit all of it myself, and the editing is what's slowing everything down.



THE ROLE, IN ONE SENTENCE



I shoot. You make it good and tell me what to shoot next.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Editing:



Cut short-form video for Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

Turn one shoot into several genuinely different videos, each with its own hook

Captions, on-screen text, pacing, sound, hook timing

Native edits per platform, no watermarked cross-posts

Keep the footage library organized



Strategy:



Watch the market weekly and bring me formats that are working before I ask

Bring me shoot ideas every week, not just execution of mine

Watch retention, sends, and non-follower reach, and tell me in plain language what you're seeing

Tell me when an idea is bad or a hook is weak. I'd rather argue for ten minutes than post something flat



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



Someone who thinks like a creator, not a service provider.



Real short-form editing experience with links to prove it

You use TikTok and Reels yourself and have opinions about what's working

Strong written English. You'll be writing hooks and captions in an American voice

Organized and self-directed



You don't need a film degree, a jewelry background, or expensive gear. Most of our footage is shot on a phone on purpose.



WHO I'M NOT LOOKING FOR



An editor who slaps auto-captions on a clip, cuts wherever, adds a trending sound for no reason, and sends it back. That's the job I'm trying to stop doing myself.



I'm also not looking for someone who only ever agrees with me.



WHY THIS IS A GOOD ONE



Full time, stable, long term, with a real budget behind it

Tools and subscriptions paid for

You work directly with me. No layers, no account manager, no client calls

Your ideas actually get shot. This is a creative seat, not a queue

A luxury brand and a category you'll be proud to put in your portfolio

Raises tied to results

Path to leading a small content team



HOW TO APPLY



Two or three links to short-form videos you edited. One line each on what you were going for.

Answer this: pick any jewelry or luxury brand on TikTok or Instagram. Tell me one thing they're doing that works and one thing you'd change. Three sentences.

Start your message with the word DIAMOND.



Anything missing all three gets skipped.

title: Airbnb AirCover / STR Damage Claims Specialist
description:
# Airbnb AirCover / STR Damage Claims Specialist



**Remote | Philippines | Part-Time / Per-Claim**



I own and operate a **13-unit short-term rental property in Tacoma, Washington** and am looking for a highly experienced **Airbnb AirCover / Short-Term Rental Damage Claims Specialist**.



**This is NOT a general virtual assistant position.**



You will NOT be responsible for guest messaging, reservations, pricing, cleaning schedules, or day-to-day property management.



**Your primary responsibility is claims and reimbursement recovery.**



We have a separate Operations Manager and an established local cleaning team.



## What You Will Handle



You will take documented guest i
 and manage the reimbursement/claim process from beginning to end, including:



* Airbnb AirCover damage claims

* Airbnb Resolution Center reimbursement requests

* 
 guest-damage/reimbursement cases

* Smoking and marijuana remediation claims

* Excessive-cleaning claims where eligible

* Broken furniture

* Damaged beds and mattresses

* Damaged televisions/electronics

* Missing property

* Damaged linens and furnishings

* Unauthorized guest-caused damage

* Supporting documentation

* Repair/replacement estimates and receipts

* Guest reimbursement requests

* Platform follow-ups

* Claim escalations and appeals

* Tracking open claims until resolved

* Recording amounts claimed, approved, denied and recovered



## How Our System Will Work



Our local cleaning team will inspect units immediately following checkout.



When they discover damage or a serious violation, they will:



1. Stop before cleaning or removing the evidence.

2. Take photographs/video.

3. Document what they found.

4. Report the i
 through our operating system.



Our Operations Manager will handle the immediate property issue and make sure the unit is ready for the next guest.



**You take over the reimbursement side.**



Your job is to review the evidence, determine what additional documentation is needed, prepare the strongest legitimate claim possible, submit it correctly and follow it until there is a final resolution.



## I Am Looking for a Specialist



I strongly prefer candidates with:



* Extensive hands-on Airbnb AirCover experience

* Airbnb Resolution Center experience

* Experience handling STR property-damage claims

* Experience with smoking/remediation claims

* Experience appealing denied or underpaid claims

* Strong knowledge of Airbnb's documentation and claim deadlines

* Experience with 
 claims/reimbursement procedures

* Excellent written English

* Strong documentation and organizational skills



### Former Airbnb employees are strongly encouraged to apply.



I am particularly interested in former:



* Airbnb Resolution Center representatives

* AirCover support specialists

* Airbnb claims representatives

* Airbnb escalations representatives

* Airbnb Trust & Safety/support personnel with reimbursement experience



## Compensation



I am open to:



* Hourly compensation

* A fixed amount per claim

* A monthly part-time arrangement

* Another structure that makes sense based on actual claim volume



This is **not intended to be a full-time position**.



I am more interested in finding someone exceptionally good at recovering legitimate claims than hiring someone for a certain number of hours.



## To Apply



Please answer **all** of the following:



1. How many years have you handled Airbnb/STR damage claims?

2. Approximately how many Airbnb AirCover or Resolution Center claims have you personally handled?

3. Were you ever employed directly or indirectly supporting Airbnb? If yes, what was your position?

4. What types of claims have you handled?

5. What is the largest claim you have personally managed?

6. Have you handled smoking or marijuana remediation claims?

7. Have you handled 
 guest-damage cases?

8. Have you appealed denied Airbnb claims?

9. Give an example of a difficult claim that was initially denied or disputed and explain what you did to resolve it.

10. What documentation do you want from a cleaner when guest damage is discovered?

11. What evidence would you require for an indoor-smoking remediation claim?

12. How do you determine the appropriate amount to claim for damaged property?

13. How do you track claim deadlines and follow-ups?

14. Approximately what percentage of the legitimate claims you've handled resulted in reimbursement?

15. What compensation structure would you prefer?



### Scenario



A guest checks out at 11:00 AM.



Our cleaner enters the unit and immediately reports a strong marijuana odor. She photographs ash and smoking evidence. She also discovers that the bed frame has been broken.



Another guest is checking in that afternoon.



The Operations Manager handles getting the property ready for the incoming guest.



**Your responsibility begins with the claim.**



Please explain exactly what evidence you would request, what reimbursement claims you would pursue, how you would document the amounts requested, and how you would handle the case if the guest denies everything.



Please answer based on **your actual claims experience**, not a generic explanation of how AirCover works.



Begin your application with the words:



**CLAIMS SPECIALIST**



Applications from general VAs without substantial claims experience will not be considered.

title: California Government Contracts & Procurement Specialist
description:
About the Role



KoreVia Solutions is seeking an experienced California Government Contracts & Procurement Specialist to help our organization navigate state and government contracting opportunities.



We are specifically looking for someone with direct, hands-on experience with the California Department of General Services (DGS), Procurement Division, Cal eProcure, statewide contracts, or other California public-sector procurement processes.



This position may be structured on a part-time, per diem, consulting, or project-based basis, depending on experience and availability. The ideal candidate will work directly with our leadership team to provide procurement walkthroughs, identify requirements, review opportunities, and help ensure contract and proposal submissions are complete, compliant, accurate, and competitive.



Key Responsibilities

- Procurement Leadership: Guide leadership through California state procurement and contracting processes.

- Portal & Agency Navigation: Assist with navigating DGS Procurement Division and Cal eProcure.

- Solicitation Review: Review statewide contract opportunities, RFQs, RFPs, IFBs, and other solicitations.

- Compliance & Requirements: Help determine eligibility and submission requirements for individual opportunities.

- Checklists & Timelines: Develop submission checklists, timelines, and required-document lists.

- Proposal & Bid Audits: Review bid and proposal packages for completeness and compliance.

- Registrations & Certifications: Assist with vendor registrations, certifications, and government documentation.

- Opportunity Identification: Help identify applicable statewide contracts and government purchasing opportunities.

- Team Training: Provide hands-on walkthroughs and training to our internal team.

- Tracking & Management: Assist with tracking deadlines, renewals, amendments, and contracting requirements.

- Process Development: Help KoreVia Solutions establish a repeatable internal process for future government contract submissions.



Qualifications

- Prior experience with California state government procurement, contracting, purchasing, or vendor management.

- Working knowledge of California DGS Procurement Division and/or Cal eProcure.

- Experience reviewing or responding to government solicitations.

- Strong understanding of government contracting documentation and compliance requirements.

- Excellent organizational and written communication skills.

- Ability to explain complex procurement requirements in a clear, practical manner.

- Comfortable working directly with company leadership on an as-needed basis.



Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following is highly desirable:



- California statewide contracts

- DGS Procurement Division & Cal eProcure

- CMAS (California Multiple Award Schedules)

- Small Business (SB) / DVBE contracting

- Healthcare or medical staffing contracts

- Professional services contracts

- Federal government contracting (
, U.S. Dept of Veterans Affairs, RFP/solicitation responses)



Engagement Structure

We are open to candidates seeking:

Part-Time | Per Diem | Independent Consulting | Project-Based Support



This is an excellent opportunity for a current or former government procurement professional, contracts specialist, procurement consultant, or experienced public-sector contracting professional looking for flexible project-based work.



How to Apply

To be considered, please submit:



1. Current Resume: Highlight relevant California government procurement, contracting, DGS, Cal eProcure, or federal contracting experience.



2. 1–2 Minute Video Introduction: Tell us why this position would be an ideal fit for your experience, what you can bring to our government contracting efforts, and why you would like to be part of KoreVia Solutions.



3. Experience Summary: Briefly describe your experience with DGS, Cal eProcure, statewide contracts, government solicitations, or proposal submissions (including successful government contracting projects where applicable).



4. Availability: Let us know whether you are interested in part-time, per diem, consulting, or project-based work.



We are looking for someone who can bring both hands-on government procurement expertise and a genuine interest in helping KoreVia Solutions expand our public-sector partnerships.

title: Healthcare Staffing & Registry Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented, and fast-paced Healthcare Staffing & Registry Coordinator to join our team. In this role, you will be the vital link between our client healthcare facilities and our pool of registry clinicians (RTs, RNs, LVNs, CNAs, and Allied Health professionals). You will manage daily scheduling requests, ensure 100% credentialing compliance, and handle real-time staffing adjustments to ensure seamless patient care.



Key Responsibilities

- Scheduling & Coordination: Coordinate and schedule registry clinicians (RNs, LVNs, CNAs, Allied Health) to effectively meet daily and contract facility staffing requests.

- Communication Hub: Serve as the primary point of contact to communicate shift details, confirmations, cancellations, and real-time updates clearly with both clinicians and facility managers.

- Compliance & Credentialing: Maintain highly accurate clinician profiles, credentials, and compliance documentation. Proactively monitor expirations for professional licenses, certifications, and medical requirements.

- Logistics & Problem Solving: Manage last-minute staffing needs, unexpected call-offs, and immediate replacements in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment.

- Quality Assurance: Ensure all clinician assignments strictly meet facility-specific requirements and state/federal regulatory standards.

- Data Management: Accurately document all scheduling activity, shift adjustments, and communication logs within the workforce management system.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with recruitment, compliance, and operations teams to streamline onboarding and maximize staff readiness.

- Clinician Retention: Build strong, trust-based relationships with our healthcare professionals through consistent, supportive communication and prompt issue resolution.



Job Requirements

- Experience: 1–3 years of proven experience specifically in healthcare staffing, registry coordination, or healthcare scheduling.

- Industry Knowledge: Solid understanding of medical terminology, nursing credentials (RN, LVN, CNA), and healthcare compliance standards.

- Tech-Savvy: Experience working with scheduling software, Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), or workforce management systems.

- Soft Skills: Outstanding communication, sharp multitasking abilities, and a calm-under-pressure demeanor to tackle last-minute schedule changes.



How to Apply

To be considered for this position, please submit the following:



1. Updated CV / Resume: Highlighting relevant experience in healthcare staffing, scheduling, or registry operations.



2.  1–2 Minute Video Introduction: Introduce yourself, share your relevant experience, and explain why you are an ideal fit for managing fast-paced healthcare scheduling and clinician coordination.



3. Availability & Preferred Schedule: Let us know your availability and readiness to start.

title: Senior C++ Software Developer – ZEA Platform Maintenance & Enhancement
description:
Phanium LLC seeks an experienced Senior C++ Software Developer to update, maintain, and enhance our existing Zero-Exposure Architecture (ZEA) platform codebase. You will work on improving performance, adding enterprise features, refactoring legacy code, and implementing security enhancements to our quantum-resistant encryption software. This role focuses on continuous improvement and optimization of production code rather than greenfield development. Remote position with flexible hours accommodating US business schedules.



Responsibilities: Review and analyze existing Visual C++ codebase to identify optimization opportunities and technical debt; refactor code for improved maintainability, performance, and security; implement feature enhancements and bug fixes prioritized by product roadmap; integrate new cryptographic libraries and post-quantum algorithms into existing architecture; optimize USB driver code and hardware integration layers; improve multi-threading and memory management efficiency; conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members; collaborate with product and security teams to prioritize updates; maintain comprehensive documentation of changes and architectural decisions; ensure all modifications comply with FIPS 140-2 and security standards.



Required Experience:



8+ years professional C++ development experience

Expert-level proficiency in Visual C++ (MSVC) and modern C++ (C++17/20)

Proven experience maintaining and refactoring large, production codebases

Strong understanding of Windows development (Windows API, Visual Studio, WinAPI)

Demonstrated expertise in software optimization and performance tuning

Experience with memory management, debugging memory leaks, and profiling tools (Valgrind, AddressSanitizer)

Knowledge of multi-threading, synchronization primitives (mutexes, condition variables), and thread-safe design patterns

Proficiency with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines

Strong debugging skills using Visual Studio debugger and platform-specific debugging tools

Experience writing and maintaining unit tests (Google Test, Catch2, or similar frameworks)

Excellent communication skills and ability to document code changes clearly

Highly Valued Experience:



Cross-platform C++ development (Windows, Linux, macOS)

Experience with cryptographic libraries (OpenSSL, libsodium, Botan)

Familiarity with post-quantum cryptography or quantum-resistant algorithms

Knowledge of FIPS 140-2 compliance and secure software development practices

Experience with embedded systems or hardware driver development

Background in cybersecurity or security-focused software

Experience with CMake, build system optimization, and dependency management

Proficiency with static analysis tools (Clang, Cppcheck, Coverity)

Prior code optimization work on performance-critical systems

Experience refactoring legacy C++ codebases

Responsibilities in Detail:



Code Analysis & Refactoring



Analyze existing Visual C++ codebase to identify performance bottlenecks

Refactor code for improved readability and maintainability

Eliminate technical debt while maintaining backward compatibility

Modernize legacy code patterns to C++17/20 standards

Performance Optimization



Profile code using Visual Studio Performance Profiler

Optimize memory allocation and data structure usage

Improve algorithm efficiency

Reduce CPU and memory footprint for embedded/hardware components

Feature Implementation



Add new enterprise features to existing architecture

Integrate new cryptographic capabilities (post-quantum algorithms)

Expand cross-platform support (Windows, Linux, macOS)

Implement API enhancements for customer requirements

Security Hardening



Review code for security vulnerabilities and fix findings

Implement secure coding practices

Enhance memory safety and buffer overflow protections

Maintain FIPS 140-2 and FedRAMP compliance standards

Testing & Validation



Write comprehensive unit tests for modified code

Execute regression testing to ensure changes don't break existing functionality

Conduct memory leak detection using debugging tools

Validate changes against security requirements

Documentation & Communication



Document architectural decisions and code changes

Maintain code comments and inline documentation

Communicate technical decisions to cross-functional teams

Create technical specifications for major refactoring efforts

Tools & Technologies:



IDE: Visual Studio 2022 (primary), VS Code (secondary)

Languages: C++17/20, C

Build Systems: CMake, MSBuild

Debugging: Visual Studio Debugger, gdb, Valgrind

title: One-Time Recruiter VA
description:
One-Time Recruiter VA — $160 Project



I’m looking for an experienced Recruiting / Hiring Virtual Assistant to help me find and screen a strong Lead Generation & Sales VA for my business.



This is a one-time recruiting project, not a permanent position.



Compensation





* Up to 20 hours total

* Maximum project budget: $160

* This project ends once the recruiting assignment is completed.



Your Job



I already know the type of salesperson I need. I need you to handle the time-consuming part of finding and screening candidates.



You will:



* Review applications and resumes

* Identify candidates with real sales and lead-generation experience

* Conduct short screening interviews

* Evaluate spoken English and communication skills

* Look for candidates who are confident on the phone

* Verify experience with cold calling, prospecting, appointment setting, follow-up, and closing

* Ask candidates sales-based interview questions

* Eliminate weak or unqualified applicants

* Organize and score the strongest candidates

* Deliver 3–5 highly qualified finalists for me to personally interview

* Provide notes explaining the strengths and weaknesses of each finalist

* Recommend who you believe are the strongest candidates



Who I Need You to Find



The person you’re recruiting should be able to:



* Generate their own leads

* Cold call and conduct outbound outreach

* Follow up consistently

* Qualify potential customers

* Book appointments and estimates

* Help close sales

* Maintain an organized lead pipeline/CRM

* Speak excellent English

* Work independently

* Be highly motivated by commissions and performance



Experience recruiting salespeople, appointment setters, cold callers, closers, or lead-generation VAs is strongly preferred.



What Success Looks Like



At the end of this project, I don’t want 50 random applicants.



I want 3–5 strong candidates who have already been screened and are worth my time interviewing.



Your job is to do the first round of recruiting so I only have to speak with the best candidates.



To Apply



Please answer:



1. How much recruiting experience do you have?

2. Have you recruited salespeople or lead-generation VAs before?

3. How would you determine whether someone is actually good at sales instead of just saying they’re good?

4. What would you ask during your screening interview?

5. How would you narrow a large applicant pool down to the best 3–5 candidates?

6. Can you complete the project within the 20-hour / $160 maximum budget?



Start your application with “TOP RECRUITER” so I know you read the entire posting.

Build landing pages for Google Ads that lift conversions and Quality Score

Create and improve service pages and suburb pages for local SEO

Keep everything mobile-first, since most of our traffic is on phones

Optimise page speed and Core Web Vitals

Place calls to action, click-to-call, forms and trust signals where they convert

Test forms, links and tracking before anything goes live

Keep both brands consistent using the brand kits we provide



**Must have**



5+ years building WordPress sites with Elementor, with live examples you can show us

Real conversion-focused design: CTA placement, trust signals, clean section flow, mobile-first

Strong page speed discipline. Image compression, lightweight builds, no slider bloat

Solid understanding of local SEO page structure, including service pages, suburb pages, headings, internal links and FAQs

Clear written English and reliability with deadlines

Core Web Vitals and performance tuning

GA4 and Google Tag Manager, or comfort embedding tracking and testing it

title: AI Video Creator & Editor (Higgsfield, CapCut, ElevenLabs)
description:
Read this first: this is not a general video editing job. You must already be creating videos with AI tools. If you have never generated a shot with AI yourself, this is not for you.



THE WORK



We are a new European jewelry brand, launching soon. Video is how we reach customers, and you will make all of it.



I write the brief — concept, angle, references. You turn it into a finished video. Multiple styles: AI UGC (a person on camera talking about the product), cartoon and animated pieces, product shots, ASMR, and formats we have not tried yet.



AI generation is the most important part of this job. Editing can be learned. What is rare is knowing how to pull a specific shot out of an AI tool — the right prompt, the right references, the right model, and the patience to regenerate until it is actually good instead of "close enough."



You get a paid Higgsfield account from us. You never pay for tools or credits.



WHAT YOU DO



Generate video shots with AI (mainly Higgsfield) from written briefs

Build finished short-form videos: hook, pacing, structure, ending

Edit in CapCut

Create and sync voice overs in ElevenLabs

Design text overlays that are readable and correctly timed

Choose and edit music and sound

Deliver the right formats and ratios for social and paid ads

Iterate on feedback and keep your files organized



MUST HAVE



Provable experience generating video with AI. Higgsfield preferred; Veo, Sora, Kling, Runway and Hailuo also count — as long as you personally made the work.

CapCut, at a level where editing is not your bottleneck

ElevenLabs or similar AI voice tools

A portfolio of short-form video you made yourself

An eye for what makes someone stop scrolling in two seconds

Good written English, fast replies, able to work from a written brief

Reliable internet and a computer that handles video work



NICE TO HAVE



Jewelry, fashion or beauty experience · Meta and TikTok ad creatives · AI image generation (Nano Banana, Midjourney, Flux) · After Effects · a sense for sound design



HOURS



Full-time, 40 hours minimum. If you can do 50, I want that, and I pay for every hour. One person, one brand — not five clients at once. Long-term.



PAY — READ CAREFULLY, IT IS UNUSUAL



The hourly rate is low. On purpose.



Base: $3/hour. About $520 per month at 40 hours a week, $650 at 50.



That is not meant to be your salary. It is the floor under a bonus structure far more aggressive than anything else on this site, because I want you earning from results, not from hours logged.



Every video you make runs as a paid ad. You get paid on what it sells:



10 sales ? $25

25 sales ? $70

100+ sales within 30 days ? $250

50,000+ organic views ? $25 (paid separately, on top)



The milestones stack. You are paid every tier your video passes, not only the highest one. 30 sales = $25 + $70 = $95. A winner doing 100+ sales in 30 days = $345 in total.



No cap on how many of your videos can hit these. One real winner pays you more than a month of hourly work.



These numbers are a starting framework, not carved in stone. We are brand new and have no historical data yet. Once we see real numbers, the structure may be adjusted, or tied to different benchmarks — output volume, or a mix of volume and sales. We d
 that together, in conversation. What will not change: strong results get paid well.



Two rules so we never argue about a payout. Sales are counted in Meta Ads Manager, per creative. A re-edit of an existing video does not count as a new video unless it genuinely becomes one.



You see every number — sales, spend, views. No black box.



Why the bonuses are this high: we are at the very start. No revenue, no proven funnel, no brand recognition. I cannot pay a big salary right now, so instead I give away a far bigger share of the upside than someone joining in two years will ever get. This is a founding-team deal.



The trade, stated plainly: you carry some of the risk with me now, and you get paid disproportionately when it works.



This job is for someone who thinks like an owner. Someone who asks what the video is supposed to DO, watches the results, notices which hook worked, and comes back with a better idea before I ask for one. If you want to clock in, execute the brief exactly, and clock out, please apply somewhere else — honestly, no hard feelings.



Not for you if you need a guaranteed high income starting next month. The upside is real, but it is not instant.



HOW TO APPLY



No portfolio = deleted unread. Sorry, I get too many.



Send me:



Your portfolio. Links to short-form video you made. Say what your role was on each one.

Proof of your AI work. Two or three videos where you generated the footage yourself. Which tool, and what your process was. A raw generation next to the finished edit is even better.

Which tools you use, and for how long.

How many hours a week you can commit, and confirm you have read the pay structure.

The word GOLDFISH at the top of your message, so I know you read this.



Answer these as well:



What is the last video you made that you are proud of, and why?

When an AI tool keeps giving you the wrong shot, what do you actually do about it?

Have you ever made a video that measurably sold something?

Any experience with jewelry, fashion or beauty?



Process: portfolio shortlist ? one short unpaid test (a single AI-generated shot, roughly 30 minutes) ? a paid trial project at your full rate ? ongoing full-time role.



I reply to everyone who follows these instructions.

title: Full-Cycle B2B Sales Closer | Source, Cold Call and Close | CAD $2,150-2,500/mo OTE (base + 10% commission)
description:
# Full-Cycle B2B Sales Representative



**Wholesale, Marketing Services & Subscription Software**



**Employment:** Full-time, 40 hours per week

**Schedule:** Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time

**Location:** Remote



## About Us



Wick of Hope is a Canadian candle company selling wholesale to retailers across Canada and the United States. Our customers include gift shops, boutiques, home stores, and larger accounts that reorder every season.



The same owners also run Launch & Found. One side of the business is a marketing agency serving local businesses across Canada and the US through websites, Google and Meta advertising, and SEO.



The other side is software. We build our own subscription products in-house. Some are already selling, several are approaching launch, and future products will take us into markets beyond the local businesses we serve today.



One small team supports both companies. Most of your week will be spent growing Wick of Hope’s wholesale business. The rest will be focused on selling Launch & Found’s marketing services and growing portfolio of software products.



## The Role



This is a full-cycle outbound sales position. You will be responsible for building the pipeline, creating the opportunity, and closing the deal.



On the wholesale side, you will own the buyer relationship from the first cold call through the first purchase order and then keep that account reordering. You will identify suitable independent retailers, reach the person who d
 what goes on the shelf, present our line sheet, handle pricing and margin conversations, and close the order.



On the marketing side, you will book and run your own 30-minute demos with realtors, contractors, and home-service business owners across Canada and the US. One owner may need a website, another may need advertising, and another may need SEO. Working out what they actually need is half the job. You will present the solution over screen share, explain what it costs and why it is worth it, answer objections, and ask for the sale.



You will also sell our subscription software. Some products already have customers; others will be brand new to the market. Depending on the product, you may be selling into entirely different industries and customer profiles. You must be comfortable learning a new market, understanding the outcome the product delivers, and building the sales approach without years of case studies or testimonials behind you.



Both companies rely heavily on outbound calling. You will build the entire pipeline yourself: researching prospects, creating lead lists, making calls, getting past gatekeepers, booking meetings, running demos, following up, and closing.



If you have only worked leads that someone else handed you, this position will not suit you.



Nobody is going to build the process for you either. If something in the pipeline is not working, we expect you to identify it, speak up, and help fix it.



## What You Will Own



* A self-generated pipeline across both companies

* New wholesale accounts, from the first cold call to the first purchase order

* Reorders and ongoing relationships for every wholesale account you open

* Every marketing or software demo you book—and the deal that comes from it

* Consistent follow-up until each opportunity is won, lost, or disqualified

* A CRM that accurately reflects what happened on every call, what comes next, and when

* Your daily activity, pipeline health, and sales results



## What You Bring



* Cold-calling ability that produces results. You can engage someone who did not ask to hear from you, hold their attention past the first ten seconds, and secure a clear next step.

* The ability to build targeted lead lists from scratch using Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Google Maps, or whatever tools you prefer. Nobody is handing you a finished list.

* Several years of experience closing B2B deals by phone and video, with real numbers you can walk us through.

* Confidence running live product demonstrations over screen share.

* Experience selling to owner-operators, independent retailers, or small-business buyers who may ask about price within the first two minutes.

* Clear, easy-to-understand spoken and written English. Our customers are in Canada and the US, and many will take your call from a job site or behind a retail counter.

* The discipline to manage your own desk without someone constantly checking in on you.

* Comfort selling something new. Some of our products are approaching launch, so you will need to sell the outcome without relying on an established name, years of case studies, or a library of testimonials.

* The resilience to handle rejection, adjust your approach, and keep making quality calls.



## Experience That Counts in Your Favour



We can train the right person, but the following experience would be an advantage:



* Selling software, SaaS, memberships, or other subscription products where customers pay monthly and can cancel

* Selling into real estate, including realtors, brokerages, contractors, and the trades

* Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, or a similar CRM

* Selling wholesale products to independent retailers

* Knowledge of websites, Google Ads, Meta Ads, or SEO enough to hold a credible conversation with an owner who may have been burned by an agency before

* Helping launch a new product or opening a market without an established sales playbook



## What We Offer



* CAD $8–$10 per hour, depending on experience

* Payment twice monthly

* 10% commission on everything you close, including wholesale orders, marketing services, and software

* For anything sold on a subscription basis, commission is calculated on the customer’s first month

* Expected total earnings of approximately CAD $2,150–$2,500 per month at target

* Uncapped commission

* Full-time, set working hours

* A fully remote team

* Direct access to the owners, without layers of management



The wholesale book is still young, which means the accounts you open are accounts that would not have existed without youand they are yours to develop into long-term customers.



There is also plenty to sell. You will have wholesale accounts on one side and websites, advertising, SEO, and a growing portfolio of subscription software on the other. A slower month in one area still leaves you with opportunities elsewhere in the pipeline.



More products are coming. Several subscription products are expected to launch over the next year, and you will be the first person responsible for selling them. That is a different challenge from inheriting a mature product with five years of case studies behind it, and we want someone who finds that opportunity exciting.



## How to Apply



Please send us all three of the following:



1. A 60–90 second voice introduction so we can hear how you communicate on a call. Tell us who you are, what you have sold, and why this role interests you.

2. Two or three sentences about the hardest deal you have ever closed, including what nearly killed it and how you got it across the line.

3. A short explanation of why you believe you would be a strong fit for this role.



We review every application ourselves. Applications that include all three items will be considered first.

You’ll work closely with our writer, editor, and founder to help communicate complex ideas through visuals that educate, explain, and keep viewers engaged.



Every visual should strengthen the story.

-- Read documentary scripts and understand the story being told.

-- Select and organize visual assets that strengthen the documentary.

-- Build visual sequences that help explain complex ideas.



* Asset Research

-- Shutterstock

-- Public domain resources

-- Government imagery

-- Historical archives



to locate high-quality visual assets.

This may include:



-- AI images

-- AI video

-- Concept illustrations

-- Maps

-- Visual explanations



Experience with current AI creative tools is a plus, but a willingness to continuously learn is even more important.



* Graphic Design



Occasionally create simple:



-- maps

-- timelines

-- callouts

-- comparison graphics

-- basic infographics



to help explain documentary topics.



/// What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who is:



-- Creative

-- Curious

-- Detail-oriented

-- Organized

-- Reliable

-- Able to work independently

-- Passionate about visual storytelling



You do not need to be an expert in every AI tool.



Technology changes quickly.



We’re looking for someone who enjoys learning and experimenting with new creative tools.



/// Required Skills



-- Excellent English reading comprehension

-- Strong organizational skills

-- Experience sourcing stock footage

-- Basic graphic design skills

-- Photoshop (or equivalent)

-- Ability to clearly communicate with a remote team



/// Bonus Skills



Experience with:



-- AI image generation

-- AI video generation

-- Documentary production

-- Premiere Pro

-- Motion graphics

-- YouTube production

-- Thumbnail design



are all considered a plus, but are not required. 



/// Compensation



-- Approximately 10–15 hours per week

-- Around $800 USD/month, depending on experience

-- Long-term opportunity with room for growth

-- Paid test for finalists



/// Our Hiring Process



* Step 1



Submit your application.



* Step 2



If selected, we’ll schedule a short interview.



* Step 3



Finalists will complete a paid creative test.



We believe your time has value, so everyone who completes the test according to the instructions will be paid.



/// How to Apply



To help us identify applicants who pay close attention to detail, please include the word:



Beehive



as the first word in your
 subject line.



Please include:
