title: Etsy VA – Customer Service, Operations & Design
description:
I'm looking for a reliable, proactive and detail-oriented person to become part of my growing e-commerce business.



This is a varied role. You'll be working with customers, products, social media, design, AI and eventually Shopify and order fulfillment. I don't want someone who simply waits for a list of tasks. I'm looking for someone who enjoys figuring things out, notices when something needs attention, and takes pride in doing things really well.



You don't need to know everything from day one. I'm looking for the right person who is curious, learns quickly and can grow with the business.



Etsy & Customer Care



You'll help make sure our customers have a great experience:



- Respond to Etsy messages professionally, warmly and promptly

- Help customers with products, personalization, orders and shipping

- Handle problems and follow up until they are actually resolved

- Monitor orders and proactively follow up when something looks delayed or unusual

- Communicate with customers with empathy, good judgment and positive written energy



Social Media & Community



Help us become more visible where our customers already spend time:



- Search and monitor relevant
 groups?

- Participate in appropriate conversations and communities?

- Engage with relevant accounts on Instagram through thoughtful likes, comments and interaction?

- Help identify interesting trends, conversations and potential customers?

- Create Pinterest pins using 

- Canva and existing product assets?

- Write appropriate Pinterest titles/descriptions using AI where useful?

- Pin products/content consistently and keep boards organized?

- Research Pinterest trends and relevant keywords?

- Help maintain a consistent visual presence?

- Engage naturally with relevant Instagram accounts and potential customers?

- Look for content ideas, trends and opportunities that fit the brand



This isn't about spamming people. I want genuine, thoughtful engagement that feels natural.



AI & Smart Ways of Working



AI is an important part of how I work, so you should be comfortable using it.



- Use AI tools for research, writing, ideas and everyday problem-solving

- Find ways to make repetitive tasks faster and more efficient

- Be curious about new AI tools and technologies

- Think: "Is there a smarter way to do this?"



POD & Orders - as you grow into the role



Once you're comfortable with the business, you'll gradually take on more responsibility:



- Communicate with our printing / POD partners

- Follow up on production and shipping issues

- Monitor orders and help resolve problems

- Eventually assist with day-to-day order fulfillment

- Prepare personalized customer files accurately using Photoshop and Canva



Etsy Listings & Design



You don't need to be a professional graphic designer, but you must have a good eye for aesthetics and detail.



- Create and update Etsy listing images in Canva

- Work with existing mockups to create attractive, cohesive listing presentations

- Make personalization and product adjustments in Photoshop

- Maintain a consistent visual style across the shop



Shopify - future opportunity



I'm also building a Shopify store, so Shopify experience is a big plus, although it isn't required to start.



As the business grows, there may be opportunities to help with:



- Product uploads and updates

- Product images and content

- Collections and basic store organization

- Day-to-day Shopify tasks

- Learning new tools and systems as we expand



The person I'm looking for



You might be a great fit if you are:



- A self-starter who doesn't need constant instructions

- Extremely detail-oriented

- Organized and efficient

- Naturally curious and willing to learn

- Comfortable working independently

- A strong written English communicator

- Kind and empathetic when dealing with customers

- Someone with a good aesthetic eye

- Fast at learning new tools

- Proactive about noticing problems and solving them

- Able to handle repetitive work without becoming careless

- Someone who genuinely enjoys finding better and smarter ways to work



Must-have

- Etsy experience

- Canva

- Adobe Photoshop

- AI tools

- Excellent written English

- Strong attention to detail

- Strong aesthetic sense



E-commerce / POD experience is a strong advantage. Shopify experience is a plus.



How we'll work



We'll primarily communicate through WhatsApp.



At the beginning, you'll work directly with me and I'll show you how the business works and how I like things done.



As you become comfortable with the systems, I want you to take more ownership rather than needing me to explain every little task.



Working hours will be tracked using a time-tracking app, and you'll be expected to accurately record your time and provide a brief summary of completed work when requested.



Pay



$5/hour



The first 30 days are a trial period so we can see whether we're a good fit.



After that, we'll review your performance, reliability, accuracy, efficiency and overall fit.



This is intended to be a long-term position. As the business grows and the role takes on more responsibility, there may be opportunities for increased hours and compensation.



Interested?



Please tell me:



Tell me briefly about your Etsy / e-commerce experience.

How comfortable are you with Canva and Photoshop? Please share examples.

Which AI tools do you use regularly?

Have you worked with Print-on-Demand? If yes, which platforms?

Do you have Shopify experience?

What is your availability and preferred working schedule?

What do you enjoy most about this type of work?

Please share examples of Etsy listing images, Canva work, Photoshop work or anything else you think shows your eye for aesthetics.



I'm not looking for someone who needs to be micromanaged.



I'm looking for someone who wants to become genuinely useful to the business, learn along the way, and eventually take ownership of things.

title: ERP Systems Administrator / Technical Analyst — NetSuite, Shopify & Integrations
description:
ERP Systems Administrator / Technical Analyst — NetSuite, Shopify & Integrations

FLUENT ENGLISH AND US WORKING HOURS REQUIRED



When applying - please answer the following questions: 

What NetSuite administration have you handled and for how long?

Describe one difficult NetSuite or ERP problem that you personally investigated and solved. What was wrong and how did you find it?

What experience do you have coding, troubleshooting and maintaining SuiteScript, JavaScript, REST APIs or integrations?

Have you worked with Shopify, Celigo or another integration platform? Please describe.





------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 



We are a growing U.S.-based equipment and services company looking for a long-term ERP Systems Administrator / Technical Analyst to support our business systems and users.



Our primary systems include Oracle NetSuite, ManagerPlus (M+), Shopify and system integrations/APIs.



This is a hybrid systems administration + business systems + technical support role. It is NOT a virtual assistant position and is NOT purely a programming role.



We are looking for someone who enjoys figuring out how systems work, troubleshooting problems, supporting users, improving processes and doing light development/automation when needed.



What You Will Do



NetSuite Administration



Provide day-to-day NetSuite user and administrative support

Manage forms, fields, custom records, roles and permissions

Create and maintain saved searches, reports, dashboards and KPIs

Support workflows / SuiteFlow

Assist with imports, data cleanup and master-data maintenance

Troubleshoot transaction, configuration and user issues



Integration & Systems Support



Monitor and troubleshoot integrations between NetSuite, Shopify, ManagerPlus and other applications

Investigate failed or incorrect data synchronization

Review logs and error messages and identify root causes

Troubleshoot APIs, data mappings and integration processes

Test system changes and integrations before deployment

Coordinate with developers when more complex programming is required



Technical / Development



Create or modify basic SuiteScript / JavaScript where appropriate

Work with REST APIs, JSON and web services

Build simple automations and workflows

Understand existing scripts sufficiently to troubleshoot problems and make minor changes

Assist with testing and documenting more complex development performed by other developers



User Support & Adoption



Work directly with Finance, Operations, Purchasing, Service and Ecommerce users

Help users understand and correctly use the systems

Troubleshoot user-reported problems

Create clear process and system documentation

Help develop training materials

Identify repetitive manual processes that can be automated

Help us improve system adoption and standardization

Required Skills

Hands-on NetSuite administration experience

Saved Searches and reporting

Custom forms, fields, records, roles and permissions

SuiteFlow / workflows

Strong ERP troubleshooting skills

Understanding of common ERP processes such as purchasing, sales orders, inventory and accounting

Experience working with system integrations

Basic understanding of APIs, REST, JSON and data mapping

Ability to read and understand JavaScript or similar programming

Strong problem-solving skills

Strong written and spoken English

Preferred Skills

SuiteScript 2.x / JavaScript

Shopify

Celigo or another integration/iPaaS platform

SuiteAnalytics / SQL

API integration experience

Experience with CMMS, work-order, field-service or equipment-management systems



ManagerPlus experience is NOT required. We will train the right person on this system.



Who Will Be Successful



We want someone who takes ownership of problems.



If a user says:



“This order did not transfer correctly from one system to another.”



We want you to be able to investigate the transaction, check the configuration and integration, review the logs, determine where it failed, fix what you can, and clearly explain what needs to happen next.



You should be comfortable moving between business users, ERP administration, data, integrations and code.



Position



Regular overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours will be required

How to Apply





Please answer the following:



How many years have you worked directly with NetSuite?

What NetSuite administration tasks do you personally handle?

Describe one difficult NetSuite or ERP problem that you personally investigated and solved. What was wrong and how did you find it?

What experience do you have with SuiteScript, JavaScript, REST APIs or integrations?

Have you worked with Shopify, Celigo or another integration platform? Please describe.







Please do not send a generic application. We are specifically interested in understanding what you personally have configured, troubleshot, automated or developed.

title: Marketing Assistant (VA) — SEO, Influencer & Paid Media Support
description:
## Role Overview



We are a fast-growing US-based ecommerce brand generating over $50M in annual sales, selling globally through Shopify, Amazon, and Walmart.



We are hiring for a long-term position and you will be joining an established team of 13 full-time team members in the Philippines already working with us.



Our company operates with high standards, strong systems, and a commitment to fully training and supporting team members for long-term success.



This is a full-time role with complete training provided. You will work directly with our Head of Growth to support our marketing across SEO, paid ads, influencers, affiliates, and reporting. You will help keep our campaigns organized, our content optimized, and our data accurate.



If you enjoy structured work, staying organized, and digital marketing, this role is a great long-term opportunity.



## Compensation + Schedule



- $1,300 USD per month

- Full-time: 40 hours per week

- Equivalent to $8.125/hour

- Paid Time Off (PTO)

- Yearly Salary Increases & Bonus

- Full Training Provided



## How To Apply (IMPORTANT)



The ONLY way to apply is through this link:



** => 
/s/apb4look **



You must complete the assessment (takes up to 43 minutes max).



Your resume MUST be submitted through that link. Applications sent any other way will not be considered.



## Why We Require This Test



We receive hundreds of applicants, and resumes alone don't tell us who is truly smart, detail-oriented, and able to solve problems independently.



This assessment is the fastest and fairest way for us to filter applicants based on cognitive aptitude (how quickly you learn, follow instructions, and troubleshoot issues). That matters a lot in marketing work where accuracy and follow-through are everything.



If you do well, you'll be prioritized for a long-term, full-time role with $1,100/month pay, PTO, and full training.



## What You'll Be Responsible For



### 1) SEO Support



- Assist with recurring technical SEO audits and maintain an issue tracker

- Help optimize product pages, collection pages, landing pages, and blogs

- Conduct keyword research and update titles, metadata, headings, internal links, alt text, and page copy

- Review blog and product content for search intent, structure, and SEO best practices

- Monitor organic traffic, rankings, and indexing



### 2) AI Search Optimization (AEO)



- Optimize content so our brand shows up in AI search, voice search, and answer engines (ChatGPT, Google AI results, etc.)

- Research common customer questions and help build FAQ, comparison, and educational content

- Write clear, concise, conversational answers backed by credible information

- Support schema markup (Product, FAQ, Article, Review, Breadcrumb)

- Monitor how our brand appears in AI-generated search results



### 3) Paid Media Creative Operations



- Collect content from agencies, creators, affiliates, TikTok Shop, and influencer platforms

- Maintain the paid media content tracker and keep raw and finished assets organized

- Share footage, briefs, references, and feedback with video editors

- Track asset status, revisions, approvals, usage rights, and delivery dates

- Keep the creative library organized and flag content gaps for upcoming campaigns



### 4) Marketing Planning



- Assist with monthly and quarterly marketing briefs

- Gather details on promotions, launches, inventory priorities, audiences, and deliverables

- Maintain campaign calendars, trackers, meeting notes, and deadlines

- Coordinate with creative, ecommerce, retention, merchandising, and agency partners



### 5) Influencer & Affiliate Support



- Communicate with creators and affiliates across TikTok Shop and third-party platforms

- Support outreach, onboarding, product seeding, campaign briefs, and deadlines

- Track deliverables, content status, links, codes, commissions, and performance

- Follow up on missing content and identify top-performing partners

- Route approved creator content into the paid media workflow



### 6) Reporting



- Support weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual marketing reports

- Gather data from Shopify, GA4, ad platforms, SEO tools, and creator/affiliate platforms

- Update dashboards and track metrics like revenue, ROAS, CPA, AOV, and conversion rate

- Flag data discrepancies, unusual trends, risks, and opportunities

- Help write short summaries of performance and next steps



## What We're Looking For



- Strong written English (near-native)

- 2–5 years of experience in digital marketing, ecommerce, SEO, content, influencer, or affiliate marketing

- Highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented

- Comfortable with spreadsheets, dashboards, and trackers

**SKILL REQUIREMENT TAGS:** SEO, Ecommerce, Social Media Marketing, Microsoft Excel

title: Talent Sourcer / Recruitment Specialist – Australian Trades & Field Service
description:
# Talent Acquisition & People Coordinator



**Remote – Philippines**

**Part-Time: Approximately 20 Hours Per Week Initially**

**Long-Term Position With Opportunity to Increase Hours**

**US$7–10/hour depending on experience + performance incentives**



## About the Role



We are a growing Australian business based in Adelaide, South Australia, looking for an experienced **Talent Acquisition & People Coordinator** to take ownership of our recruitment pipeline and assist with employee onboarding, training administration and people operations.



This is intended to be a **long-term position**, not a short-term recruitment project.



Our immediate priority is recruiting reliable field-service technicians for our Australian operations. However, as our business grows, you will also assist with recruitment for administration, sales, technology, management and offshore positions.



We are specifically looking for someone with genuine professional experience in:



* Recruitment

* Talent acquisition

* Candidate sourcing

* Headhunting

* Passive candidate outreach

* Candidate screening

* HR/people administration



This is **not a general VA position**.



You will work directly with the business owner and progressively become responsible for maintaining our recruitment systems, candidate database, onboarding processes and employee administration.



---



# Your Primary Responsibility: Recruitment & Headhunting



Traditional job advertisements do not always produce the calibre of candidates we require.



A major part of your role will therefore involve **proactively finding and approaching people who are already successfully employed**, rather than simply waiting for job applications.



You will:



* Research and identify suitable candidates

* Build targeted candidate lists

* Use LinkedIn and other platforms for candidate sourcing

* Conduct Boolean searches

* Identify passive candidates

* Directly approach potential employees

* Send personalised candidate outreach

* Follow up prospective candidates

* Conduct initial screening interviews

* Review employment histories

* Assess employment stability

* Identify reasons for previous job changes

* Assess communication and cultural fit

* Shortlist suitable candidates

* Coordinate management interviews

* Conduct reference checks where requested

* Maintain detailed candidate records

* Build a long-term talent pipeline



Our current Australian field-service recruitment particularly values candidates with:



* Stable employment histories

* Mechanical aptitude

* Field-service experience

* Ability to work independently

* Good customer communication

* Reliability

* Strong work ethic

* Long-term career intentions



Direct industry experience is helpful but **not always required**, because we have developed our own structured training program.



---



# Talent Mapping



We want to develop our own internal talent database rather than starting recruitment from zero every time we need an employee.



You will systematically identify potential employees across industries including:



* Pool and spa servicing

* Irrigation

* Pumps

* Water treatment

* Pest control

* Maintenance

* Facilities management

* Landscaping

* Field service

* Appliance servicing

* Technical services

* Trades and related industries



You will maintain records including:



* Candidate name

* Current position

* Current employer

* Employment tenure

* Previous employment

* Location

* Skills

* Contact history

* Interest level

* Salary expectations where known

* Suitability

* Follow-up dates

* Interview history

* Recruitment notes



Some candidates may not be ready to move immediately.



Your responsibility will be to build relationships and maintain a pipeline so that suitable candidates can be approached again in the future.



---



# Recruitment Across Our Business



Over time, you may assist with recruitment for:



### Australian Operations



* Field Service Technicians

* Senior Technicians

* Supervisors

* Operations staff

* Sales employees

* Account managers

* Administration

* Management roles



### Philippines / Remote Team



* Virtual Assistants

* Customer service employees

* Developers

* Designers

* Marketing employees

* Sales staff

* Other remote contractors



### Technology Businesses



Our company is also developing software products and technology businesses.



You may assist with sourcing:



* Full-stack developers

* Mobile developers

* UI/UX designers

* QA testers

* Product staff

* Customer success employees

* Sales representatives



---



# Employee Onboarding



Once a candidate is hired, you will help coordinate their onboarding.



Responsibilities may include:



* Preparing onboarding checklists

* Collecting required employee information

* Coordinating employment documentation

* Ensuring documentation has been returned

* Reference-check administration

* Licence/check verification

* Coordinating uniforms and equipment

* Scheduling onboarding activities

* Creating employee files

* Creating internal accounts/checklists

* Coordinating training

* Following up incomplete onboarding tasks

* Ensuring new employees are ready before commencement



You will not be responsible for providing Australian employment-law advice or making legal employment decisions.



---



# Training & Learning Administration



We have developed our own internal technician training program.



You will help administer the training system by:



* Enrolling employees in training

* Tracking module completion

* Tracking quiz results

* Identifying overdue training

* Maintaining training records

* Coordinating practical assessments

* Recording competencies

* Maintaining employee training files

* Scheduling refresher training

* Producing training progress reports

* Following up employees who fall behind



You will work with management and technical staff who provide the technical training and assessments.



---



# Employee Review Administration



You will help ensure employee reviews happen consistently rather than being forgotten during busy periods.



This may include organising:



* 7-day check-ins

* 30-day reviews

* 60-day reviews

* 90-day/probation reviews

* Six-month reviews

* Annual reviews



You may:



* Prepare review documents

* Gather employee feedback

* Collect manager feedback

* Maintain records

* Track agreed actions

* Schedule follow-up reviews



Final performance decisions remain with management.



---



# Employee Retention



As the role develops, you may assist management in understanding why employees stay or leave.



This may include:



* Employee check-ins

* Satisfaction surveys

* Identifying recurring concerns

* Exit interviews

* Recording resignation reasons

* Reporting employee-retention trends

* Identifying potential retention risks

* Monitoring employee tenure



The objective is to identify problems early rather than discovering them only when an employee resigns.



---



# Recruitment Marketing



You may also help improve how our businesses present themselves to prospective employees.



This could include:



* Writing and maintaining job advertisements

* Updating recruitment templates

* Managing careers-page content

* Creating employee testimonials

* Coordinating recruitment social-media posts

* Managing employee-referral programs

* Reviewing competitor job advertisements

* Researching salary ranges

* Tracking which recruitment channels produce the best employees



---



# Recruitment Reporting



We want recruitment decisions to become data-driven.



You will maintain reporting on metrics such as:



* Candidates sourced

* Candidates contacted

* Response rate

* Screening interviews

* Management interviews

* Offers made

* Offers accepted

* Cost per hire

* Time to hire

* Source of successful candidates

* Probation success rate

* Employee retention

* Reasons candidates reject offers



You should be comfortable working with spreadsheets and recruitment databases.



---



# What We Are Looking For



You MUST have genuine recruitment, talent acquisition or candidate-sourcing experience.



Strong candidates will have experience with:



* LinkedIn Recruiter

* LinkedIn sourcing

* Boolean search

* Passive candidate sourcing

* Headhunting

* Cold candidate outreach

* Screening interviews

* Candidate databases / ATS systems

* Reference checking

* Recruitment reporting

* HR administration



Experience working with **Australian businesses** would be highly regarded.



Experience recruiting:



* Tradespeople

* Field-service employees

* Blue-collar workers

* Technical employees

* Engineers

* Construction workers

* Maintenance employees



would be particularly valuable.



---



# Personal Characteristics



We are looking for someone who is:



* Highly organised

* Proactive

* Persistent

* Comfortable approaching people

* An excellent written communicator

* Confident speaking with candidates

* Good at assessing people

* Detail-oriented

* Able to work independently

* Comfortable challenging poor-quality candidates rather than simply progressing everyone

* Interested in building systems rather than simply completing individual tasks



We value **quality over activity**.



Sending 100 generic LinkedIn messages is not success.



Finding five excellent potential employees is.



---



# Hours & Long-Term Opportunity



The role will initially involve approximately **20 hours per week**.



For the right person, there is potential for:



* Increased hours

* Additional responsibility

* Full-time employment

* Greater ownership of recruitment

* Progression toward a People Operations / Talent Acquisition leadership role



We want someone who can grow with the business over several years.



---



# Compensation



**US$7–10 per hour**, depending on demonstrated experience.



Additional performance incentives may be offered for outcomes including:



* Successful hires

* Difficult-to-fill roles

* Employees successfully passing probation

* Long-term employee retention



---



# How to Apply

title: Graphic Designer (Web Design + Ad Creative)
description:
About the Role



We are an SEO agency serving local service businesses and ecommerce brands across the US. We are hiring a full-time Graphic Designer who can build beautiful, conversion-focused websites and brand assets for our clients, with SEO built into every page from the start rather than bolted on afterward.



This is not a "make it pretty" design role. You will be building real pages, mainly on WordPress with some Wix and Squarespace, that are designed to rank and convert. You will also create ad creative for paid campaigns and support our internal marketing materials.



If you like ownership, variety, and seeing your work drive actual results for real businesses, this is a good fit.



What You'll Own



1. Client Website and Page Design



Design and build client website pages on WordPress, Wix, and Squarespace

Structure pages with SEO fundamentals in mind: heading hierarchy, image optimization, page speed, mobile responsiveness, and internal linking opportunities

Mock up new website designs for existing clients and for new SEO sites

Work from client briefs and brand direction to create pages that look professional and turn visitors into leads



2. Ad Creative



Create ad graphics for paid campaigns, including static display ads, social ad creative, and multiple variations for A/B testing. Work on campaign creative, which means you should be comfortable taking direction and turning around several concepts quickly.



3. Brand Guidelines and Identity



Build brand guideline documents for new clients as they onboard, covering color palettes, typography, logo usage, and voice and tone direction. Create brand systems from scratch for companies that do not have one. Keep every page and asset we produce for a client visually consistent.



4. Speed and Systems



Use automation and AI tools to build pages faster. We are not looking for someone who designs every page by hand from scratch. We want someone who builds reusable templates and components, works efficiently inside page builders and automation tools, and is always looking for ways to cut production time without cutting quality.



5. Internal Design



Support internal marketing design, including social graphics, ad creative, presentation decks, and sales materials

Help keep the brand sharp across every touchpoint.



What We Need From You

- Several years of real design experience. Not a beginner, and not "I took a course." We need someone who has actually shipped client work.

- A portfolio you can show us. This is required with your application, not optional. No portfolio, no consideration.

- Strong working knowledge of WordPress, Wix, and Squarespace page building

- A practical understanding of on-page SEO. You do not need to be a technical SEO expert, but you should know why heading structure, alt text, and page speed matter.

- Hands-on experience with automation, AI design tools, or templating systems to speed up output. Tell us specifically which tools you use and how they have cut your turnaround time.

- Confidence building brand guidelines from scratch for a brand new client

- Strong written and verbal English communication

- Add design26 to your application to be considered

- Reliable, deadline-driven, and able to manage several client projects at once



Bonus Skills



- Shopify store design and theme customization

- Logo design for clients who need one built from the ground up

- Familiarity with Claude's AI design features as part of your workflow



Schedule and Pay



Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time

Base Pay: $1,000 per month



Bonuses on top of base for:

- Client retention

- Completed tasks and fast project turnaround

- Exceptional work quality

- Shopify design projects

- Use of Claude's AI design tools in your workflow



How to Apply



Send all of the following:

- Your resume or CV

- Your design portfolio, with the link included directly in your application

- A short cover note explaining why you are a strong fit for this specific role

- A section titled "Why I Stand Out." This is your chance to show us what separates you from every other applicant. Be specific, be confident, and point us to your best work.



Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.



By applying, you consent to us reviewing your portfolio and application materials, and contacting any references you provide.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us. Real client work, real creative ownership, and a clear path to more responsibility and more pay as you prove yourself.

title: Meta Lead Conversion Specialist
description:
Meta Lead Conversion Specialist



**Location:** Remote

**Employment:** Full-Time

**Department:** Sales / Customer Experience

**Platform:** Sprout Social / Meta

**Reports To:** Marketing Manager / Customer Experience Manager



## ABOUT TAYLOR CONTRACTORS



Taylor Contractors is a rapidly growing New Zealand trade services company operating across multiple regions throughout the country.



Our brands provide plumbing, drainage, gasfitting, leak detection, electrical and infrastructure services to residential and commercial customers.



Our social media network currently generates significant customer attention across
 and Instagram, including more than **220,000 content views and 1,500+ link clicks** during the current reporting period.



We are looking for a highly motivated **Meta Lead Conversion Specialist** whose responsibility is simple:



**Turn social media conversations into qualified customers.**



This is NOT a social media content creation role.



This is a customer engagement and sales role.



You will work inside **Sprout Social**, monitoring incoming messages, comments, enquiries and relevant customer interactions across our Meta network.



Your job is to engage quickly, understand what the customer needs, gather the required information and move qualified customers into our booking and sales process.



---



# THE ROLE



You will actively monitor:



*
 Messenger

* Instagram Direct Messages

*
 comments

* Instagram comments

* Meta advertising enquiries

* Responses to advertisements

* Relevant customer interactions

* Existing conversations requiring follow-up



Every genuine customer enquiry represents a potential job.



We expect enquiries to be handled quickly, professionally and commercially.



You should not simply answer questions.



You should **progress conversations toward an outcome.**



---



# PRIMARY OBJECTIVE



The objective is:



**ENGAGEMENT**



?



**CONVERSATION**



?



**QUALIFICATION**



?



**CUSTOMER DETAILS**



?



**FORM COMPLETED / LEAD CREATED**



?



**TAYLOR CONTRACTORS CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE / SALES**



?



**JOB BOOKED**



Your success will ultimately be measured by the number and quality of customers you move into our sales pipeline.



---



# KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



## 1. Respond to Meta Enquiries



Monitor Sprout Social throughout your shift.



Respond promptly to genuine customer:



* Messages

* Comments

* Questions

* Advertising enquiries

* Service enquiries



Customers should receive fast responses during operating hours.



---



## 2. Convert Conversations Into Leads



Do not allow genuine enquiries to become endless conversations.



Determine what the customer needs and move them toward the next step.



Example:



Customer:



"My drain keeps backing up. Do you guys come to Lower Hutt?"



Response:



"Yep, absolutely — we cover Lower Hutt. Is the drain completely blocked at the moment or still draining slowly?"



Customer:



"Completely blocked."



Response:



"No problem, we can help with that. I'll get this through to the team as urgent. Can you please send through your address and best contact number?"



?



**Qualified Lead**



?



Immediately escalate to Customer Experience.



---



# 3. CUSTOMER INFORMATION



Where appropriate, obtain:



* Name

* Phone number

*

* Property address

* Region

* Service required

* Description of issue

* Urgency

* Photos

* Videos



Where Taylor Contractors uses an enquiry form, direct the customer to complete the form and follow up to ensure it has been completed.



Do not simply send a link and forget about the customer.



---



# 4. CONVERSATIONAL SELLING



We want natural conversations.



Communication should sound:



* Friendly

* Confident

* Helpful

* Direct

* Human

* Professional

* New Zealand appropriate



Avoid robotic corporate responses.



### Good:



"Yep, we can definitely help with that. Would you have a couple of photos you could send through? I'll get the team to have a look and we can work out the next step for you."



### Good:



"That's something we deal with regularly. If you send through your address and contact number I'll get this through to the team."



### Good:



"If sewage is currently overflowing, I'll mark this as urgent and get someone onto it now. What's the best number to reach you on?"



### Avoid:



"Thank you for contacting our esteemed organisation. We greatly appreciate your enquiry."



Communication must feel like a real member of a New Zealand company is helping the customer.



---



# 5. FOLLOW-UP



Many customers will not respond immediately.



Qualified prospects must be followed up appropriately.



Example:



"Hey James, just checking whether you still needed a hand with that blocked drain? Happy to get the team onto it for you."



The objective is persistent professional follow-up without annoying or misleading customers.



Every active conversation should have:



**A response, a next action, or a final outcome.**



---



# 6. URGENT LEADS



Immediately escalate enquiries involving:



* Burst pipes

* Sewage overflow

* Completely blocked drains

* Major active leaks

* Flooding

* No water

* Emergency plumbing

* Urgent commercial failures

* Customers wanting immediate attendance



Do NOT spend 20 minutes messaging an emergency customer.



Get their:



**Name + Phone + Address + Problem**



and immediately hand the opportunity to the New Zealand team.



---



# 7. HIGH-VALUE LEADS



Immediately flag potential:



* Drain replacements

* Sewer repairs

* Water main replacements

* Major leak repairs

* Hot water cylinder replacements

* Commercial work

* Property management opportunities

* Hydro jetting

* CCTV and drainage investigations

* Larger plumbing projects

* Repeat commercial maintenance



These opportunities should be handed to Customer Experience / Sales quickly.



---



# 8. LEAD HANDOVER



A lead should not simply be described as:



"Customer needs plumber."



The handover should contain:



**Customer:** James Smith

**Location:** Lower Hutt

**Phone:** 021 XXX XXXX

**Service:** Blocked Drain

**Issue:** Main sewer appears completely blocked

**Urgency:** Urgent

**Photos:** Received

**Source:**

**Status:** Customer ready for call



The New Zealand team should be able to immediately pick up the lead and close it.



---



# 9. SPROUT SOCIAL MANAGEMENT



You are responsible for maintaining a clean and organised social inbox.



This includes:



* Responding to genuine enquiries.

* Clearing completed conversations.

* Tagging conversations correctly.

* Assigning conversations where required.

* Flagging urgent enquiries.

* Maintaining customer notes.

* Ensuring unanswered enquiries do not disappear.

* Following up active prospects.

* Keeping the inbox organised.



---



# STRICT KPIs



This is a performance-based role.



Performance will be measured weekly and monthly.



## RESPONSE TIME



**Target:** Under 5 minutes during rostered operating hours.



**Minimum Standard:** 90% of genuine enquiries responded to within 10 minutes.



---



## INBOX COVERAGE



**Target:** 100%



Every genuine service enquiry must be:



* Responded to

* Qualified

* Escalated

* Followed up



or



* Correctly closed as irrelevant / lost



No genuine enquiry should remain forgotten in the inbox.



---



## QUALIFICATION RATE



**Initial Target:** 60%+ of genuine service enquiries progressed to a qualified lead where the customer is serviceable and has genuine intent.



This KPI will be reviewed once sufficient Taylor Contractors baseline data has been collected.



---



## LEAD HANDOVER QUALITY



**Target:** 95%+



Qualified leads handed to the New Zealand team should contain the required customer and job information.



---



## FOLLOW-UP COMPLIANCE



**Target:** 100%



Every active sales conversation requiring follow-up must receive the required follow-up.



---



## FORM COMPLETION



Where customers are directed to an enquiry form:



The salesperson remains responsible for progressing the conversation until:



* Form completed

* Customer declines

* Customer becomes unresponsive after the approved follow-up sequence

* Lead is handed directly to Customer Experience



Sending the form link alone does NOT count as a conversion.



---



## SALES PIPELINE CONTRIBUTION



Primary monthly performance metrics will include:



* Qualified leads generated

* Qualified lead rate

* Form completions

* Jobs handed to Customer Experience

* Booked jobs originating from Meta

* Revenue originating from Meta leads

* Average response time

* Follow-up completion

* Lost lead reasons



**Revenue and booked jobs matter more than message volume.**



---



# IMPORTANT KPI PRINCIPLE



We will NOT judge performance based purely on:



* Number of messages sent

* Likes

* Comments

* Followers

* Views



Those are marketing metrics.



This is a **sales role**.



The ultimate measurement is:



**How much genuine customer opportunity did you create from our Meta audience?**



---



# WHAT YOU WILL NOT BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



* Creating social media content

* Designing graphics

* Editing videos

* Running Meta Ads

* Google Ads

* SEO

* Website development

* Technical plumbing advice

* Creating your own pricing

* Dispatching technicians

* Technician management

* Accounts



Your responsibility is:



**ENGAGE ? QUALIFY ? CONVERT ? HANDOVER ? FOLLOW UP**



---



# IDEAL CANDIDATE



We are looking for someone who:



* Has excellent written English.

* Can communicate naturally with New Zealand customers.

* Is confident selling through chat.

* Is persistent without being aggressive.

* Responds extremely quickly.

* Understands customer intent.

* Can recognise buying signals.

* Is comfortable asking customers for their details.

* Can manage multiple conversations simultaneously.

* Is highly organised.

* Is commercially minded.

* Takes ownership of outcomes.

* Enjoys targets and measurable performance.

* Can work independently.



Previous experience in:



* Chat sales

* Appointment setting

* Lead generation

* Customer service

* Meta Messenger sales

* Social selling

* Trade services

* Home services



would be highly regarded.



---



# PERFORMANCE REVIEW



Performance will be reviewed weekly during the initial employment period.



We will review:



**Enquiries**



?



**Conversations**



?

?



**Form Completions**



?



**Booked Jobs**



?



**Revenue**



The objective is continuous improvement in conversion throughout the funnel.



---



# CAREER OPPORTUNITY



As Taylor Contractors grows, this role has the opportunity to progress into:



**Meta Lead Conversion Specialist**



?



**Senior Lead Conversion Specialist**



?

?

We intend to build a larger digital sales function as our advertising reach and regional operations expand.

# TAYLOR CONTRACTORS

If you are competitive, organised, confident communicating with customers and enjoy converting conversations into sales opportunities, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Claude / AI Automation Expert to Help Build Our Organic Content Machine (8-Figure Health Brand)
description:
ey, I'm Isaac, founder of ecommerrce brand



Quick version: we're a health brand (supplements) out of Australia, and we're doing really well on the paid ads and creative side. That part's handled. The reason I'm hiring is our organic content, and I want someone who's genuinely a beast with Claude and AI automation to come help me turn it into a machine.



Right now I run pretty much everything through Claude. I've already built a bunch myself, scrapers to pull viral weight loss accounts, systems to find viral concepts and formats, all of it. But I need someone in the trenches with me who can take it way further.



What we're actually doing



We've got a small organic team, about 4 video editors right now, making AI influencer content. Mainly real AI avatars, but there's a ton of organic animation content crushing it too. We're going hard on the weight loss niche.



How it works now: I manually research viral AI influencers, download the videos doing 100k+ views, pull the scripts, organise the URLs, and feed all of that to the editors each week. They take the scripts and inspo and build the videos. It works, but it's a lot of manual grind and I know we can systemise most of it.



What I want you to help build



Research tools that go deep on these organic accounts and surface the viral concepts, hooks and formats we should be running, fresh every week, on tap.

Ready-to-go briefs for the editors. I've used a storyboard flow before that turns a script into text-to-image and image-to-video prompts, and it worked great. I want that dialled in so editors get finished briefs with all the prompts done, instead of building it all by hand. This one's important.

Automations across the whole editor workflow so they move faster and make more.

Overseeing our auto-publishing (we use Publer) so content actually goes out smoothly across all the accounts.

And one I literally thought of today while talking this through:



Comment-to-DM automation. On some of my viral videos I tell people to comment a word (like "protein") to get a free recipe book. I've had hundreds and hundreds of comments and NO automation to actually send it. I want it so the second someone comments, they get a DM pitching the free book, and once they reply, we send the product link. That's straight-up sales sitting on the table right now. Getting that live fast would be massive.

The bigger vision (this is the real thing)



I want to build an AI influencer commission program that basically runs itself. A setup where creators genuinely make money, move off a base salary as we scale, and we get thousands of people all over the world posting for the brand. Real educational content, free tips in the DMs, driving sales, and the creators making great money doing it.



I genuinely believe we can change a lot of lives with this, theirs and the people watching. That's the goal. We're building an 8-figure+ company and the right person is a huge part of that.



Who I'm looking for



Someone on the throne with this. A true Claude expert, a pro at Claude, coding, AI agents, MCPs, all of it, who can build automations that make our whole operation better. But not JUST a builder, someone with a creative strategy brain who's done marketing or run Meta ads before and now loves Claude, automation, and marketing.



You'd also help lead some of our editors, so you need to be someone people can actually follow.



What I care about, and this is non-negotiable:



Communication. Your English needs to be excellent and you need to over-communicate. Poor communication drives me absolutely crazy.

Long-term and loyal. I want someone in this for the long haul who isn't quietly working for other people behind my back. I need someone I can fully trust and rely on.

Speed and passion. Fast replies, heart in the work, and you genuinely see how big this can get, how much money's in it, and how many lives it can change.

I don't care where you are. I'm in Australia, you might be in the Philippines, doesn't matter. If you fit this and you want to build it with me, that's all I care about.



The test, and how to apply



Message me on WhatsApp: 
I want to actually talk to you. The real test is getting on a call with me, telling me how you see this role, how you think about what I'm building, and what you'd do with it. I want to hear that you get the vision and you want to be a long-term player in a big, growing, 8-figure Australian health brand that's out to change a lot of lives.



Start your message with the word AUTOPILOT so I know you actually read this properly

COMPENSATION

Confident reading Keepa charts (sales rank drops, price history, seller count over time)

Comfortable with a profit calculator like SellerAmp SAS or RevSeller

Solid understanding of Amazon fees, FBA vs FBM economics, variations, and brand restrictions

Every lead must be your own find. No recycled leads from lead lists, 
, or
 groups. We check.

Reliable internet and consistent daily availability

Strong written English and attention to detail



CONFIDENTIALITY



We see this as a collaborative, long-term working relationship, and we take confidentiality seriously on both sides. We are prepared to sign a confidentiality agreement to protect both parties' interests. Your work is protected, and our leads and process stay private.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word "GREEN" so we know you actually read this post, then include:



How long you've been sourcing OA leads and who you've sourced for

The tools you use (Keepa, SellerAmp, etc.)

One or two example leads you've found in the past (old or expired leads are fine, we just want to see how you think)

Your expected rate and your daily availability with timezone



Consistent GREEN performers get steady daily work, on-time pay, and first priority as we expand the team.

title: Remote Sales Rep / Appointment Setter | $1,200+ Monthly Earning Potential + Uncapped Bonuses
description:
Remote Sales Rep / Appointment Setter | $1,200+ Monthly Earning Potential + Uncapped Bonuses



Are you good at sales, confident on the phone, and motivated by the opportunity to make more money based on your performance?



We are a growing US-based short-term rental property management company looking for a hungry, resourceful Sales Representative to help us grow our portfolio.



This is a 100% performance-based role with uncapped earning potential.



Our target is for a successful rep to earn $1,200+ USD per month, with the opportunity to earn significantly more as you generate larger clients and build your pipeline.



What Are You Selling?



We provide full-service management for Airbnb and short-term rental property owners.

Our clients own the properties and pay their ownership expenses.

We handle essentially everything else.

Guest communication, pricing, revenue optimization, cleaning, maintenance coordination, supplies, listing management, property operations, and more.



Our ideal clients are property owners who:



Currently use another management company but aren't happy with their results

Own short-term rentals but are tired of managing everything themselves

Live outside the city and need a trusted local team

Own multiple properties and want a better management partner



Your goal is simple:



Find great potential clients, start conversations, qualify the opportunity, and get them on a call with our team.



How You Make Money



We want this position to reward RESULTS.



Qualified Meetings ? You Get Paid



Book a qualified meeting with a legitimate property owner who fits our criteria and attends the call, and you earn a flat appointment fee.



We Sign the Client ? You Get Paid AGAIN



If your lead becomes a client, you receive an additional bonus based on the size of the opportunity.



Recurring Management Client ? Bigger Bonus



If the client signs an ongoing property management agreement, you receive an additional bonus equal to 50% of our first month's management revenue from that client.



The bigger the opportunity you bring us, the more money you can make.



Our initial target for a successful rep is approximately 6–8 qualified meetings per month and 1–3 new clients per month.



We are targeting approximately $1,200+ USD/month in earnings for a productive rep, but there is no fixed earnings ceiling.



Who We're Looking For



You don't need to be an Airbnb expert.



We can teach you our business.



What we DO need is someone who can sell.



You should be:



Confident speaking English with US customers

Comfortable cold calling

Experienced in sales, appointment setting, lead generation, or business development

Resourceful enough to research and find potential customers

Persistent with follow-up

Comfortable hearing "no"

Competitive and motivated by commission

Organized with your pipeline

Hungry to make money and grow with a company



Previous experience in US sales, real estate, Airbnb, hospitality, property management, or B2B sales is a big plus.



Why This Opportunity Is Different



We aren't selling a $20 product.



One good conversation can turn into a client worth thousands of dollars per year to our company.



Some owners have one property.



Others have 5, 10, or more.



That's why we want our sales rep participating in the upside.



Find better opportunities. Build relationships. Bring us valuable clients. Make more money.



As you prove yourself, there will also be opportunities to take on more of the sales process and earn larger commissions.



How to Apply



Send us through WhatsApp: 
A short introduction about yourself

Your previous sales experience

Your cold-calling experience

The biggest sale or client you've helped generate

Why you prefer a performance-based opportunity

A 60–90 second video recording introducing yourself and telling us why you think you'd be good at this role

We're looking for someone who wants more than just another online job.



If you're confident in your ability to generate business and want your income tied to your results, we want to hear from you.

title: Client Success Account Manager - $2,000 Base p/m + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage

This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

HOW TO APPLY

???? Photo Organization & Digital Archiving

Beautifully designed

Fun and visually interesting

Well organized

Embellished appropriately

Written with engaging captions and storytelling

Historically and geographically accurate

Ready to upload/order through Shutterfly or another approved photo-book service

This is a major performance expectation of the position.



???? Travel Content & Storytelling

Writing destination-focused captions

Researching locations, wildlife, history, museums, attractions, and landmarks when necessary

Using photographs of signs, exhibits, and informational displays from our travels as source material for accurate storytelling

Creating educational travel content

Developing content that is useful and interesting to other traveling families

???? Photography & Content Monetization



Help develop the archive into an income-producing digital asset.



Potential opportunities include:



Stock photography

Stock video

Editorial licensing

Commercial licensing

Tourism licensing

Educational licensing

Direct image licensing

Prints and wall art

Calendars

Postcards

Books

Digital products

Social-media revenue

Affiliate revenue

Other approved photography/content opportunities

Who We’re Looking For



The ideal person is:



An excellent photo editor

A capable video editor

A beautiful and creative layout designer

Extremely organized

Detail oriented

A strong English writer

Comfortable researching unfamiliar destinations and subjects

Able to tell a story visually

Interested in travel, wildlife, history, and photography

Able to work independently

Comfortable making creative decisions

Reliable with weekly deliverables

Interested in a long-term position

Determine how we should use:




Instagram

TikTok

YouTube

Pinterest

LinkedIn


SMS

Influencers

Creators

Customer lists

Retargeting

Marketing automation

Landing pages

CRM data



Do not advertise somewhere merely because it exists.



You must explain:



Why we're using it

Who we're targeting

What outcome we expect

How we're measuring it



2. CUSTOMER & MARKET SEGMENTATION

We sell products that can appeal to very different customers.



For custom shirts, examples may include:



Schools

Sports teams

Restaurants

Contractors

Churches

Companies

Events

Clubs

Nonprofits

Family reunions

Gyms

Retail businesses



For yard signs:

Realtors

Contractors

Landscapers

Schools

Events

Graduations

Businesses

Political campaigns where appropriate

Property services

Community organizations



These audiences should NOT all receive the same advertisement.



Develop distinct:

Audiences

Messages

Offers

Creative briefs

Landing pages

Retargeting

Follow-up



3. CUSTOMER PERSONAS & BUYING INTENT



Understand:

Who buys

Why they buy

What problem they're solving

How quickly they need it

What prevents them from buying

What competitors they're considering

What matters most: price, speed, quality, convenience, service or customization

How often they reorder

What else they may purchase



Turn customer knowledge into marketing strategy.



4. META ADVERTISING



You must be highly experienced with:

Meta Business Manager

Meta Ads Manager

 Ads

Instagram Ads

Meta Pixel

Events Manager

Conversion API concepts

Custom audiences

Customer lists

Website audiences

Engagement audiences

Video audiences

Prospecting

Retargeting

Catalog ads where appropriate

Advantage+ tools where appropriate

Lookalike/similar audience strategies where available



You should know how to build campaigns from scratch and improve them over time.



5. TIKTOK MARKETING & ADVERTISING



Understand both organic TikTok behavior and TikTok Ads Manager.



Know how to:



Identify TikTok-native creative

Select objectives

Build campaigns

Develop audiences

Retarget

Test creative

Read performance

Use Pixel/Events data

Scale winners

Kill poor performers



Work closely with the Creative Lead to produce platform-native assets.



6. YOUTUBE



Develop opportunities through:



YouTube content

YouTube Shorts

Video advertising

Retargeting

Product demonstrations

Educational content

Customer-intent content



Determine which videos are brand-building and which are direct-response assets.



7. PINTEREST



Evaluate and utilize Pinterest when appropriate for visually driven products including:



Apparel

Signs

Design inspiration

Events

Weddings

Business branding

Promotional materials



Understand the difference between Pinterest content strategy and paid Pinterest acquisition.



8. LINKEDIN / B2B DIGITAL MARKETING



Develop B2B opportunities where economically justified.



Potential audiences include:



Companies

Marketing managers

Restaurants

Franchises

Schools

Organizations

Event companies

Contractors

Procurement teams



Determine when LinkedIn advertising makes financial sense and when organic outreach/content is more appropriate.



9. PAID SOCIAL MEDIA STRATEGY



Own:



Campaign architecture

Audiences

Objectives

Budgets

Placements

Bidding/optimization strategy

Prospecting

Retargeting

Testing

Scaling

Exclusions

Frequency

Creative rotation

Campaign analysis



The Creative Lead makes the creative.



You make sure the right creative reaches the right person.



10. CREATIVE BRIEFING



You must understand creative even though you are not our primary creative producer.



Example:



Instead of telling the Creative Lead:



"Make me five
 ads."



You should be capable of saying:



"We're targeting youth baseball-team managers. Price is not their biggest problem—ordering 15 different names and numbers correctly is. I want three 15-second videos built around simplifying team ordering. Give me one testimonial angle, one problem/solution angle and one demonstration."



THAT is marketing.



You provide the business/customer insight.



The Creative Lead turns it into excellent creative.



11. CREATIVE PERFORMANCE FEEDBACK



You will provide the Creative Lead with data.



Example:



Creative A:

High hook rate, low CTR.



Creative B:

Lower watch time but excellent purchase rate.



Creative C:

Strong CTR but terrible conversion rate.



Creative D:

Excellent ROAS but beginning to fatigue.



Your job is to interpret those results and request the next round of creative intelligently.



12. RETARGETING SYSTEMS



Build sophisticated retargeting journeys.



Examples:



Website visitor



Viewed shirt page.



> Shirt benefit advertisement.



Repeat visit



Still did not buy.



> Testimonial/social-proof advertisement.



Added to cart



Didn't purchase.



> Cart-recovery advertising +
/SMS.



Purchased



Remove from new-customer acquisition advertising.



> Cross-sell.



60/90/180 days later



> Reorder/win-back campaign where appropriate.



Different behavior should trigger different marketing.



13. FIRST-PARTY CUSTOMER DATA



Develop strategies around properly obtained customer data.



Segment by:



Product purchased

Purchase date

Frequency

Order value

Customer type

Geographic area

Lifetime value

Engagement

Lead vs. customer

Lapsed customer



Use appropriately on supported platforms for:



Customer Match

Custom audiences

Exclusions

Retention

Reorders

Cross-selling

Prospecting/modelled audiences where supported



Follow applicable privacy and platform requirements.



14.
 MARKETING



Own
 strategy and deployment.



Build automated flows such as:



Welcome



New subscriber> introduction > value > proof > offer.



Abandoned Cart



Cart > reminder > benefits > proof > incentive if justified.



Browse Abandonment



Visited repeatedly > relevant product reminder.



Post Purchase



Confirmation > education > review > cross-sell.



Reorder



Expected replenishment/reorder timeframe > reminder.



Win Back



Customer hasn't purchased recently > targeted return campaign.



VIP



High-value customer > special treatment/offers.



15. SMS MARKETING



Build compliant SMS programs for:



Abandoned carts

Promotions

Limited-time offers

Reorders

Product launches

VIP customers

Customer lifecycle campaigns



Avoid destroying customer trust through excessive messaging.



16. CROSS-SELLING & UPSELLING



Customers buying one product may need another.



Examples:



Business cards > flyers.



Yard signs > banners.



Custom shirts > signs.



Event printing > apparel.



Restaurant menus > uniforms/signage.



Develop data-driven cross-sell and upsell campaigns.



17. CUSTOMER LIFETIME VALUE



You must think beyond the first transaction.



Understand:



CAC

First-order value

Average order value

Purchase frequency

Repeat purchase rate

Customer lifetime value

Gross margin where provided

Payback period



Sometimes spending $100 to acquire a $75 first order can make sense.



Sometimes spending $20 to acquire a $75 order is terrible.



The answer depends on margin, repeat purchases and lifetime value.



Think like a business owner.



18. FUNNEL DEVELOPMENT



Create complete funnels.



Examples:



Social Ad > Landing Page > Purchase



or:



Video > Lead Form >
/SMS > Quote ? Sale



or:



Educational Content > Retargeting > Product Page > Purchase



or:



Customer List > Reorder Offer > Purchase



Every campaign should have an intentional next step.



19. LANDING-PAGE STRATEGY



You do not need to code the pages.



You DO need to understand what makes them convert.



Recommend:



Headlines

Offers

Layout

Social proof

Videos

Reviews

Calls to action

Forms

Product presentation

FAQs

Urgency

Guarantees

Mobile improvements



Work with our SEO/web team on implementation.



20. OFFER STRATEGY



A great advertisement cannot always overcome a bad offer.



Develop and test:



Percentage discounts

Dollar discounts

Quantity breaks

Free shipping

Bundles

Free design assistance

Limited-time offers

First-order incentives

Reorder incentives

Referral offers

Volume pricing

Seasonal promotions



Measure actual profitability.



21. A/B AND MULTIVARIATE TESTING



Develop disciplined experiments around:



Creative

Hooks

Audiences

Offers

Landing pages

Headlines

CTAs

 subject lines

SMS

Retargeting windows

Campaign structures



Do not change ten things and then claim you learned something.



Test intelligently.



22. MARKETING AUTOMATION



Design automated workflows using systems such as:



Zapier

CRM systems

/SMS platforms

Lead forms

Webhooks/integrations where available

ManyChat

Other automation platforms



Example:



 Lead >



CRM >



Immediate SMS >



Immediate
 >



Sales notification >



Follow-up >



Retargeting audience >



Conversion tracking.



23. CRM STRATEGY



Help organize customers/leads by:



Source

Product interest

Stage

Customer type

Purchase history

Value

Follow-up status



Marketing should become smarter as our customer database grows.



24. INFLUENCER & CREATOR MARKETING



Own the business side of influencer/creator campaigns.



You determine:



Which creators make sense

Audience fit

Expected economics

Compensation structure

Affiliate opportunities

Tracking

Offers/codes

Content usage rights

Performance



Creative Lead owns/supports creative direction.



25. ORGANIC SOCIAL STRATEGY



Our VAs can perform repetitive posting.



You determine:



Platform strategy

Posting priorities

Content mix

Frequency

Campaign themes

Promotions

Audience development

Growth opportunities



Do not spend your entire day manually posting.



Your value is strategy and growth.



26. SOCIAL MEDIA VA MANAGEMENT



Create documented systems our VAs can execute.



Examples:



Posting calendar

Group-posting instructions

Response templates

Escalation rules

Comment procedures

Lead-capture procedures

CRM entry procedures



Use lower-cost execution resources intelligently so your own time remains focused on high-value marketing work.



27. ANALYTICS & ATTRIBUTION



Understand:



GA4

Meta attribution

TikTok attribution

Platform attribution differences

UTMs

Conversion events

CRM source data

Call tracking

Post-purchase surveys where useful

First-touch vs. last-touch

Assisted conversions



Do not blindly believe one dashboard.



Understand how measurement works.



28. CORE PERFORMANCE METRICS



You should be highly comfortable with:



Revenue

ROAS

MER

CPA

CAC

CPL

Cost per purchase

Conversion rate

Average order value

Customer lifetime value

Repeat purchase rate

CTR

CPC

CPM

Frequency

 revenue

SMS revenue



You must be able to explain these numbers to management in plain English.



29. BUDGET ALLOCATION



Recommend how marketing dollars should be distributed.



Example:



If Meta is producing 5X ROAS and TikTok is producing 1.2X, do not continue equal budgets because the original spreadsheet said so.



Evaluate:



Scalability

Incremental performance

Margins

Acquisition cost

Customer quality

Lifetime value

Seasonality



Move money intelligently.



30. SCALING



You must understand the difference between:



"A campaign works at $50/day" and: "We can profitably scale this campaign to $5,000/day."



Scaling requires monitoring:



Audience saturation

Frequency

CPA

Creative fatigue

Conversion rate

Inventory/capacity

Customer economics



31. COMPETITIVE INTELLIGENCE



Continuously study competitors.



Analyze:



Offers

Advertisements

Creative

Landing pages

Promotions

Social channels

Reviews

Positioning

Customer complaints

Influencers

Funnels

 capture

Retargeting



Find gaps we can exploit.



32. NEW GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES



We expect you to continually ask:



"What aren't we doing?"



Examples could include:



New customer segments

New channels

Affiliate programs

Referral programs

Partnership marketing

Creator partnerships

Lead magnets

New funnels

Reorder programs

Loyalty

B2B campaigns

Geographic campaigns

Seasonal opportunities



We want proactive thinking.



WHAT YOU OWN



You OWN:



Digital marketing strategy

Social marketing strategy

Paid social

Audience strategy

Customer segmentation

Retargeting

Customer-list marketing

Campaign architecture

Media buying

Budget allocation

Funnel strategy

Offers

 strategy

SMS strategy

Lifecycle marketing

Marketing automation

CRM marketing strategy

Influencer economics

Conversion analysis

Attribution

Social marketing reporting

ROAS/CPA optimization

Growth experiments

WHAT THE CREATIVE LEAD OWNS



The Creative Strategy & Advertising Content Lead owns:



Creative concepts

Scripts

Hooks development

Photography direction

Static advertisements

Video advertisements

Reels

Shorts

TikToks

UGC creative direction

Editing

Creative variations



You provide the marketing requirements.



They turn those requirements into exceptional advertising.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



We prefer 5+ years of serious digital/performance marketing experience.



You should have substantial experience with:



Meta Ads

Ecommerce

Retargeting

Customer audiences

Conversion tracking

 marketing

SMS marketing

Funnels

Analytics

Marketing automation

Campaign testing

Scaling

TO APPLY



Do NOT send a generic marketing cover letter.

1. PDF Resume

2. Advertising Results



Provide examples showing:

Revenue

ROAS

CPA

CAC

Leads

Purchases

3. Biggest Account

Platforms

Your responsibilities

title: AI Marketing Fulfillment Lead
description:
Digital Transformations AI is hiring a reliable fulfillment specialist to help us launch and support marketing systems for real estate professionals.



You’ll initially work alongside our founder and fulfillment lead, completing clearly assigned client work. As you learn our systems, the goal is for you to eventually own the launch and ongoing fulfillment of an entire real estate client package—from the initial AI Blueprint and onboarding through website, CRM,
 marketing, social media, and launch.



Real estate experience is strongly preferred, but not required. We care most about your ability to learn our systems, follow instructions, take ownership, and consistently finish high-quality work.



THE WORK

GoHighLevel and CRM

• Set up and organize client GoHighLevel subaccounts

• Build pipelines, calendars, forms, surveys, funnels, and landing pages

• Configure workflows,
 and SMS campaigns, triggers, and automations

• Import and organize contacts, tags, custom fields, and opportunities

• Test every part of the system before launch

Websites and Funnels

• Build websites and funnels in GoHighLevel

• Use AI-assisted website builders to create initial layouts and prototypes

• Build or finish websites in WordPress

• Work from our approved briefs, examples, copy, and brand guidelines

• Make revisions and complete pre-launch quality checks



Real Estate Marketing Fulfillment

• Create and schedule social media content

• Prepare monthly real estate
 newsletters

• Build buyer, seller, expired, probate, and database nurture campaigns

• Update property, market, and agent information when needed

• Help maintain consistent marketing across each client’s website, CRM,
, and social channels



Client Launches

As you grow into the role, you will help manage complete launches:

• Review the client’s AI Blueprint and fulfillment plan

• Organize the required assets and information

• Track every deliverable using our checklists and systems

• Coordinate work with our internal team

• Build, test, revise, and prepare the client’s systems for launch

• Help manage ongoing monthly fulfillment after launch



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• Hands-on GoHighLevel experience

• Experience building websites or funnels in GHL or WordPress

• Comfortable creating and scheduling social media content

• Able to build
 campaigns and basic CRM automations

• Strong attention to detail and quality control

• Excellent written English and communication

• Self-directed, dependable, and comfortable asking questions

• Able to follow a detailed brief, checklist, and established process

• Interested in taking greater ownership as you learn the role



REAL ESTATE EXPERIENCE IS A PLUS

Experience supporting a real estate agent, team, brokerage, investor, or marketing company would be especially valuable.



Helpful knowledge includes:

• Real estate lead generation and follow-up

• Buyer and seller pipelines

• Listings and property marketing

• Monthly database newsletters

• Expired, probate, FSBO, or sphere campaigns

• Real estate social media content

• CRM database organization and nurture

You do not need real estate experience if you are a strong builder who is willing and able to learn.



WHAT YOU DON’T NEED

• Advanced custom coding experience

• Responsibility for strategy on day one

• Direct client management when you first start

• Knowledge of every part of the role before applying



We have systems, templates, briefs, examples, and training. We need someone who can learn them, execute carefully, and gradually take ownership.



THE OPPORTUNITY

This is intended to become a long-term position.



You will begin by supporting our existing fulfillment team. The right person can grow into owning the complete launch and ongoing fulfillment of assigned real estate clients from start to finish.



We are looking for someone who wants responsibility, consistency, and an opportunity to become an important part of our team—not someone looking for occasional short-term projects.



TO APPLY

Please include:



1. Two or three examples of GoHighLevel funnels, websites, automations, or WordPress sites you have completed.

2. Any experience you have working with real estate agents or real estate marketing.

3. Your strongest skills among GoHighLevel, WordPress,
 marketing, automation, and social media.

4. Your weekly availability and preferred working hours.

5. A brief example of a project you personally took from assignment through completion.

6. The phrase “Real Estate Fulfillment” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the full post.



We’re hiring immediately and will begin with a paid trial project.



JOB DETAILS

• More than 30 hours per week

• Long-term position: more than six months

• Intermediate experience level

• Starting rate: $4 per hour

• Opportunity for increased responsibility and compensation based on performance

title: Hiring for VA Call Handling Full Time or Part Time [Start in 48 HR if Selected]
description:
**IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING**



We are currently hiring for a long-term Remote Receptionist position. Responsibilities include answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, de-escalating complaints, and completing administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment. This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance.



For candidates who may be a stronger fit outside of a call-handling role, we also have a few non-voice positions available, subject to availability and overall fit. If you are interested, please clearly state that you are interested in a non-voice role and submit a brief three-sentence introduction about yourself along with your portfolio or work samples.



Please note our application process: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unable to respond individually to every applicant who is not selected. If you do not receive a response from us within 24 hours with information about the next step in the hiring process, you were not selected to move forward to the next round. We appreciate your interest and thank you for taking the time to apply.



————————————————————



**To apply:** Please copy the questions below, paste them into your reply, and answer each question thoroughly. Please answer based on your own personal experience and provide specific, real examples whenever requested. Incomplete, vague, generic, or copied responses may not be considered.



**(1)** Which city and region in the Philippines are you currently located in? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



**(2)** Please submit a link to a screenshot of your internet speed and links to a few samples of your previous work output or portfolio. Please indicate what work you personally completed.



**(3)** Please submit links to two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund.



**(4)** Are you currently employed or engaged in any other work, business, freelance projects, or income-generating activities? If yes, please briefly describe your current commitments and typical weekly availability.



**(5)** Are you able to commit to a fixed 7-day, 6-hour work schedule during Central Standard Time (CST) hours? What is your expected hourly or monthly pay rate and earliest physical start date if hired?



**(6)** Describe three work tasks you have personally completed at least 100 times in a real job. description:

Rated 4.8/5 across nearly 1,000 customer reviews, sold globally at 
. The brand targets people who want to disconnect from screens and capture real
