You can check out our account 
 on Instagram



About the Role

We are looking for a Social Media Manager & Creative to own and grow KLIK’s social presence across channels. This is not just a scheduling role — it’s a creative leadership position. You’ll build real channel strategies, manage our accounts, curate and post UGC content, and contribute to broader brand creative work.



We have a team to support the editing for simple Instagram posts, which is handled within this role. Beyond social media, this is an overall creative role where we’d love to do more brand work.





What You’ll Do

Manage the accounts

Keep track of all KLIK social media accounts. Curate and filter the UGC posts we currently have, post them, and give credit where credit is due. Maintain a consistent posting schedule across all active platforms.



Build channel strategies

 cross-posting)

 — not a priority, we simply cross-post from Instagram

TikTok — dedicated strategy



Create

Beyond social media management, this is an overall creative role. We’d love to do more brand work — visual identity work, creative campaigns, brand storytelling, and original content that captures the authentic, nostalgic KLIK aesthetic.



Full Responsibilities

Manage all KLIK social media accounts — Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, and

Curate and filter UGC content from the existing library, post and credit creators appropriately

Develop and execute dedicated channel strategies for Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest

Create, plan, and manage a consistent content calendar across all platforms

Produce or oversee simple Instagram post edits (editing support team available)

Write compelling captions, hooks, and copy that match the KLIK brand voice

Monitor and respond to comments, DMs, and community engagement

Track and report on social media performance metrics — reach, engagement, follower growth, saves

Stay updated on social media trends, platform algorithm changes, and competitor activity

Contribute to broader brand creative work — campaigns, visual identity, and storytelling

Collaborate with Video Editors, Creative Strategists, and the wider marketing team



Must-have

Proven experience managing social media accounts for a DTC or ecommerce brand

Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest — what works, what doesn’t, and why

Experience building social media channel strategies from scratch, not just scheduling posts

Strong eye for visual content, brand aesthetics, and UGC curation

Excellent copywriting skills — captions, hooks, and brand voice

Comfortable working independently and managing your own content calendar

Organized, reliable, and data-aware — tracks performance and adjusts strategy accordingly

Experience managing or growing a brand account from early stage

Understanding of UGC creator communities and how to engage and credit them

Authentic and real — not over-produced or overly polished

Nostalgic and film-like — vintage tones, grain, candid 
nts

Community-driven — UGC is at the heart of the content

Lifestyle-first — trips, parties, everyday life, human connection

Emotionally resonant — content that makes people want to pick up a camera

Think: someone at a festival pulls out a KLIK, shoots without looking at the screen, and the photos come out beautifully imperfect. That feeling is what the feed should communicate.



Hiring Process

Initial Interview - Background, experience, and creative approach discussion

Trial Period/1-Month Evaluation -  Part-time or direct hire depending on test outcome. Full output and performance evaluation over one month

title: Studio Growth & Enrollment Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**



We are a growing dance studio with a strong reputation in our community. We believe dance is about far more than movement. We build confidence, leadership, friendships, and lifelong skills through the art of dance. We are looking for someone who genuinely wants to help share that mission and welcome new families into what we are building.





**What This Role Is**



This is a remote, part time position and it is heavily sales focused. The core of this role is outbound outreach to warm leads who have already expressed interest in the studio. These are real people who opted in. Your job is to connect with them, build genuine rapport, and move them toward enrollment through real conversations.



This role is built for someone who can own it. We will give you the structure, the tools, and the direction. After that, we expect you to run with it. The goal is for the right person to own this role fully with little to no hand holding from management. If you need to be micromanaged, this is not the right fit.



This role will evolve. The core is outreach and enrollment, but the scope will grow and shift based on what the studio needs. Some days that means following up with leads. Other days it might mean hunting for new ones, supporting a campaign, creating content, or finding creative ways to generate interest in the community. Whatever drives growth is fair game, and the right candidate will embrace that rather than push back on it.





**What You Will Do**



- Call new leads as fast as possible the moment they come in. The first studio to make contact almost always wins.

- Follow up with prospective families and adult students through calls, texts, and
s using a structured outreach system

- Manage leads through a full follow up cadence and know where every lead stands at all times

- Log all activity and report daily on outreach and lead responses

- Hunt for new leads through social media, community groups, and online platforms

- Support seasonal campaigns, content creation, and community outreach as needed

- Take on additional tasks as the role grows and studio needs shift





**What We Are Looking For**



- English level C1 or higher, spoken and written. We will assess this.

- Exceptionally strong phone presence. This is the number one filter for this role. You need to sound calm, confident, and in control on every call. Prospects can feel hesitation and uncertainty immediately, and it kills trust before the conversation even starts. If you are smooth, natural, and able to guide a conversation without fumbling, you will thrive here. If phone calls make you nervous or unsure, this is not the right fit.

- Experienced in sales, lead follow up, or relationship based outreach

- Highly organized, dependable, and able to work independently without daily oversight

- Motivated by results and energized by conversations

- Experience with CRM tools or lead tracking systems is a plus

- A background or genuine interest in dance is a bonus, not a requirement





**Schedule**



- Part time, 20 hours per week spread across 7 days

- Availability required during Pacific Standard Time business hours

- Payment is made bi weekly via Wise





**Why This Role Matters**



Every family that reaches out is looking for something real for their child or for themselves. Your job is to make sure they find it here. The faster you respond, the more genuine your follow up, and the better you understand what they need, the more lives this studio gets to impact. This is not a job where you clock in and clock out. It is a role where the right person makes a real difference.



**To Apply**



Send your resume and a short introduction explaining why you would be a great fit. Tell us about a time you followed up consistently with someone and it made a real difference.



Put **Blue Elephant** in the subject line or message title. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter for US Medical Sales (Full-Time, US Central Hours, Night Shift)
description:
I sell medical aesthetic devices to doctors' offices in the US. I need one full-time cold caller who will work directly for me (not an agency) making outbound calls to medical practices in Oklahoma and Texas, talking past the front desk, identifying the practice owner or decision maker, and booking lunch meetings for me.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Log every call outcome in my CRM (simple, I will train you)



SCHEDULE (READ CAREFULLY)

Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time. That is 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine time. This is a night shift job. Only apply if you can genuinely work these hours long term.



PAY: $800/month base, paid every 2 weeks via Wise or similar. Plus performance bonuse paid monthly for meetings that happen and go well. A good month of bonuses can add several hundred dollars. 13th month pay included after your first year.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken English with a neutral, American-friendly accent

- Cold calling or appointment setting experience with US customers

- Quiet workspace, reliable computer, stable internet, good USB headset

- Reliable. This is a long-term, direct-hire position for one person.
